You get back in line and at 2.30pm after entering the afternoon reservations let a certain number of people pass through without reservations who have been waiting for about 45 minutes under the sun we are in Africa what is the point of all this? Yes to the reservation but absolutely no to the shifts with which you also risk a heart attack at 1.30pm for the ascent and also not even prompt medical assistance in case of need for these reasons after 5 years I gave up on Lampedusa leaving a piece of my heart for the sea and for the Lampedusians who are wonderful people!! I forgot if you go up at 1.30pm and want to venture to other beaches all full of umbrellas from the establishments and considering that they are all very small you don't even have room to put a towel so I advise anyone who had the brilliant idea of ​​the shifts to see something again, it's a shame to miss out on yali beauties

reviews.title: Spiaggia meravigliosa, ma organizzazione da rivedere !
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, but organization to review! You can't expect to park a kilometer away and go back and forth both to pay and to display the coupon, why not have the staff go around with the coupons?

reviews.title: Espero volver !
reviews.text: An unforgettable experience! Fishing village, typical of Italy. Wonderful sea and sandy beaches!!! We rented a small boat (Euros: 50/day) without needing to have a helmsman's registration and we sailed through the calm waters of the Mediterranean without any problem. Coniglio beach: beautiful! (In season it is convenient to make an appointment: morning or afternoon. Nature reserve does not allow many people to enter) Rest of the beaches, also to enjoy! It's worth it !!!

reviews.title: Meraviglia delle meraviglie!
reviews.text: Why go looking for the Caribbean, Maldives etc etc when we have such beauty here in Italy.. An island and wonderful places.

reviews.title: Attenzione ai conigli
reviews.text: Magnificent place, pay attention to the tortuous path but I fractured my ankle in the fantastic Lampedusa, it doesn't seem Italian

reviews.title: Bellezza straordinaria
reviews.text: A dream, a sea that declines blue in all its shades.  For those of us who were unable to book entry on the Lega Ambente website, we need to arrive early in the morning (8am) and queue to be sure of being among the 150 places available without reservation. It is not only the most beautiful sea on the island, it is a place of extraordinary beauty. Enchanting.

reviews.title: Il Paradiso
reviews.text: It is a remote inlet with overhanging rocks, a very white beach and a turquoise sea. After walking for about 15 minutes, a tortuous path with a rocky and slippery surface, so you need to wear suitable shoes, you arrive at the rabbit cove rightly considered among the most beautiful in the world and rightly protected and looked after by the Lampedusa volunteers who work for Legambiente. You cannot believe the wonder of this Paradise. The photos and stories don't justify it.

reviews.title: La riserva è un PARADISO TERRESTRE
reviews.text: I arrived and was welcomed divinely, the descent towards the reserve was very rapid, the ascent also but I must admit that we were made easier by the breeze that was circulating. It is managed by Legambiente who understood us very well and provided us with information, in fact on the beach you can mostly hear the sound of the sea because those who access it are asked to respect first and foremost the reserve but also those who access it. The sea, the sea is spectacular, far surpassing the Caribbean, transparent water, breathtaking colors and the fish swimming near the bathers in a serene way. I would have liked to return but as I could only access by reservation I no longer found space

reviews.title: Che meraviglia!
reviews.text: A splendid place, a beach rightly considered among the most beautiful in the world and rightly protected and looked after by Legambiente volunteers. Access, which is free, is only permitted in two daily time slots, with online booking or, for 150 people, with free access. At 7.45 (access is permitted from 8.30) there were already three of us waiting to enter freely. The path is initially all rock, then the surface is better arranged. It takes about half an hour to walk down to the beach. The whole area is enchanting, the sea is amazing. This wonder of nature is truly worth the effort of climbing up.

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: It's a real paradise. You suffer a little on the way back because there's a climb to climb but the view is really impressive. There are 2 shifts to enter the beach (one in the morning and one in the afternoon) and this allows us to keep this beach uncontaminated. There is parking and it's paid for both scooters and cars! Don't be smart, there are controls and fines too!!

reviews.title: Top beach!
reviews.text: I have been living by beach places for almost all my life, but this location definitively caught my attention! What an amazing place!

reviews.title: Sicuramente da visitare
reviews.text: There must be a reason if it is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Although it is not the type of beach I like, I must say that it has beautiful water. Went before there was the need for a reservation and even though it was mid-June the beach was unlivable. There is no space between one umbrella and another. The walk that leads to the beach does not present any major difficulties.

reviews.title: Un ricordò più unico che raro
reviews.text: It was a day in the first ten days of June. Around nine in the morning the breeze pleasantly caressed my hair. The colors were vivid and bright. Everything pointed to something magical. Even before arriving there, from the top of the path, it appeared in all its naturalness. A marvel to take your breath away. A silence that filled the heart, a peace that satiated the soul. This was my thought the first time I saw the rabbit beach in Lampedusa. No other beach has yet given me this memory. Anna

reviews.title: UNA MERAVIGLIA DELLA NATURA
reviews.text: we went in June 2023 and as you go down towards the sea your eyes can't believe the reality that you will see after a few minutes, a spectacular oasis of colors and views that will leave you breathless. Beautiful!

reviews.title: Senza fiato
reviews.text: Access to the beach is intelligently organised. The guys from Legambiente are special, very good and kind at enforcing the rules of the beach. Obviously the place, like many others in Lampedusa, leaves you breathless. I recommend the afternoon session given the rather long and steep climb, not for all ages, towards the evening it is much cooler. I would say a 10 with honors.

reviews.title: Lampedusa nel cuore
reviews.text: There is only one word to describe the beauty of this place: "Wonderful". From the promontory overlooking the beach you can admire the various shades of color from transparent to intense blue, if you then turn your gaze to the east you can admire the famous tabaccara where the boats seem to float in the void. When you arrive for the first time you are literally left speechless here, nature has truly given its all. The quotas and the various prohibitions that serve to preserve this place are good.

reviews.title: Un sogno ❤️
reviews.text: A dream! But those who preceded me have already written this, therefore, since I have just left the island, I would like to communicate a note regarding parking: cost per car €1.50 per hour or €7.50 for the whole day. If you don't pay the ticket, the fine is guaranteed

reviews.title: Acqua cristallina😍
reviews.text: Lovely beach, crystal clear water. We saw lots of fish. We took lots of photos

reviews.title: Vacanze bellissime da fare assolutamente
reviews.text: The beach is spectacular the colors of the sea are beautiful places so they are a must visit

reviews.title: Vista da togliere il fiato!
reviews.text: Heaven exists! Crystal clear, shallow water! The staircase which takes about 20 minutes to descend seems to go back to prehistoric times, white rocks and splendid vegetation. As soon as you arrive there are wonderful light blue and blue colors! It takes your breath away. Go equipped with an umbrella and protective cream so that you get burned.... Everything else disappears as soon as you jump into the water... GO THERE

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: It is the pearl of the Mediterranean, one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. This is a paradise to visit in the periods from October to May

reviews.title: Un raro diamante
reviews.text: Completely enchanting...despite the windy day we had, it was really worth the joy, a small glimpse hidden and set like a rare diamond in a perfect outline of sand and rock...clear and crystalline water despite it being cold. Deserving of its awards without a doubt! Goodbye from Ugo and Diletta

reviews.title: Esperienza da ripetere, la consiglio
reviews.text: Beautiful beach in a natural park... wonderful beach and wonderful, clean and uncontaminated sea... the only problem is too many people, full to capacity even if there is a limited number of places. An experience to be repeated for sure...

reviews.title: Se dovessi immaginerei il paradiso, me lo immaginerei più o meno così
reviews.text: When it emerges from above it is enchanting: it dazzles and enchants you. The maintenance activity carried out by Legambiente is commendable. Better from land than from the sea

reviews.title: Meraviglia!
reviews.text: WOW effect along the descent: crazy colors, a celestial vision. Little fish and some jellyfish.... I hope to return... always out of season.

reviews.title: Spattacolo
reviews.text: Excellent beach... From the photos I didn't really believe it and instead I changed my mind... it takes 15 minutes on foot.... and already from above you see a spectacle... Sandy beach, transparent and calm sea and as you walk you come across fish 🤣🤣🤣 beautiful... I would return just to swim there....

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: Stunning beach and sea with exceptional colours, just as Modugno says in the blue painted blue, the descent is in some places steep, slippery and still rocky, I recommend shoes and hat, especially for going up especially if on the first turn in full heat

reviews.title: Di una bellezza indescrivibile
reviews.text: The beach is of indescribable beauty. To access it you have to book via the appropriate app or you have to arm yourself with patience and queue, in the hope that some of those booked do not show up on time at the chosen time. I, who had not found any more available seats via the app, waited in line for about 30 minutes and managed to get off. The route is not easy, so you have to arrive with comfortable and above all closed shoes to avoid sprained ankles, but the effort is rewarded by a panorama, a sea and sand that are unique in the world and that excite

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella
reviews.text: For me one of the most beautiful beaches in Italy. Nothing to add. You have to see it. We have to go there. Limited entry in summer is good

reviews.title: Disastro....troppa gente
reviews.text: I wonder...what's the point of booking if the beach is very crowded...a disaster! Luckily Nature always wins with its spectacular panorama.

reviews.title: Un carnaio meraviglioso
reviews.text: The beach itself is wonderful in terms of context, it seems huge, but it isn't. Many parts are inaccessible and dangerous. Even 500 people is too many for my taste. And it's the end of September. It is right to limit access. The most beautiful beach in the world, oh well. Maybe in February.

reviews.title: Meravigliosaaaaaaa
reviews.text: A true paradise, fantastic beach with transparent water.  You reach the beach after a walk of about 10 minutes, I recommend closed shoes. It can be visited by reservation and is absolutely worth it.

reviews.title: Bellissimi colori
reviews.text: The colors are unforgettable even when the sun is not at its best. I had some doubts about the route to take since I'm not trained to do difficult walks, but I have to say that I thought it would be much more difficult. And the route presents us with views worth photographing, not to be missed

reviews.title: INCANTEVOLE
reviews.text: You follow a path on foot but it is absolutely worth visiting. You must make a reservation even if entry is free, you pay for parking and you need the vehicle's license plate number.

reviews.title: sempre il top del top
reviews.text: it remains one of the most beautiful beaches ever, it remains in the heart for the view, the atmosphere, the colors, the sand, the location... everyone should go there once in their life!!

reviews.title: Bellissima ma troppo piena!
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, among the most beautiful I have seen in my travels....unfortunately despite the limited number of accesses (which is apparently not respected) there were too many tourists for the size of the beach, it felt like being in Rimini, even worse!

reviews.title: La migliore spiaggia di lampedusa
reviews.text: Stunning beach in a fairytale setting. You need to book but it's worth it. 30 minutes on the path with suitable shoes and you will find paradise

reviews.title: UNICA!
reviews.text: Caribbean beach in a unique context and protected by the island of the same name. Thanks to the presence of the nests of the "Carretta-Carretta" turtle, its extraordinary nature is rightly protected by Legambiente. In the summer months it is necessary to book the visit, but no worries, there are always places dedicated to those who have not booked. On days with a lot of wind, it is useless to rent umbrellas because they flutter like kites and you risk causing damage to tourists who find themselves in its path.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: I had always heard good things about it and I must say that it was all true, wonderful beach!!!! The route is not difficult as I had read in some reviews, the descent and ascent are easy, and the view from the top is wonderful! You can't go to Lampedusa and not go to this beach!

reviews.title: Spiaggia bella ma sopravvalutata
reviews.text: The beach is wonderful, crystal clear water and golden sand but the path to reach it is very long and very uncomfortable. It is dangerous for the elderly and small children both going down and going up. You can't reach it if you have a stroller. A few meters of beach for all the umbrellas and tourists... either reduce the access further or extend the beach "for the umbrellas". Once you have managed to set up the umbrella it is almost useless to spread the towels on the ground because they will be crushed and filled with sand no matter how many people there are, the same thing to reach the water from the umbrella: you are forced to pass over other people's towels and under the small umbrellas.  For the rest, breathtaking view, two small turtles were even born while we were on the beach. Unfortunately there are many people who feed the fish despite the ban.

reviews.title: Closer to the sun and sea
reviews.text: Can be Maldives, it could be an island of nowhere in the Indian Ocean… it could be but is not. It is the Italian territory of Lampedusa, just an hour flight from Napoli. The place is absolutely non-European all the way, and it should not be, 155 km away from North Africa. On a more pragmatic matter, the sea is green smarald & blue and it is heavienly. Beech fairly regular and I am not keen on Italian style of people sitting on top of each other on the sand. I suggest not taking an umbrella and spend the time just in the water … at the end ne of the day, this is the real attraction!

reviews.title: Vacanza con mia moglie
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, a little difficult to reach but it's really worth it, the boys and girls of Lega Ambiente are to be thanked for what they do, thank you thank you

reviews.title: Una bolgia
reviews.text: They take reservations but for what? An infernal bedlam, one on top of the other, with times to respect before leaving the beach. After a tiring road you arrive and find the Romagna Riviera

reviews.title: Bella Bella Bella
reviews.text: Those who come to Lampedusa come to visit the rabbit beach and obviously it is really worth it. White sand, crystal clear sea full of fish. Excellent management of Lega Ambiente volunteers. It is a world heritage site. It is accessed via an easy path that takes about 15 minutes, more when you go up. Important, keep in mind that when there is a sirocco wind it loses much of its beauty, a visit is not recommended.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with stunning sea, we were there on August 22nd, accessed with a simple walk. The only negative note was too many people.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Book well in advance on the isoladeiconigli.it website, otherwise you will have to queue for the 150 seats for those who have not booked. The beach is divided into 2 sectors, only in the 1st is the use of an umbrella allowed, which you can rent before going down at a cost of €5 + €10 deposit which will be returned to you upon return. Paradise beach to visit at least once in your life and if possible when the sirocco is not blowing.

reviews.title: Un sogno
reviews.text: Mandatory stop in Lampedusa. I thought it was overrated but I was wrong. It definitely exceeded expectations, nothing to envy of tropical seas. 15 minute wait to enter and 5/10 minute walk but it's worth it.

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: The place is breathtaking even though there is a long uphill walk under the sun on the way back.. the water was choppy so the bottom wasn't perfectly crystal clear but nevertheless spectacular!!!!

reviews.title: Incantato
reviews.text: Lovely place, beautiful beach. First time in Sicily, loved to return next year.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa!
reviews.text: A wonderful beach!! The walk takes about 25 minutes. It's quite hot but there are some "houses" in the shade to take shelter or sit. It is worth going with children because the water is shallow and very clear....you can bring umbrellas but they can only be placed on one part of the beach....

reviews.title: Senza fiato
reviews.text: When you arrive you will be truly amazed. You would never expect that after those 100 meters of slightly flat road there will then be a descent that will drop you into paradise on earth. Double uaoh with pike dive. Nothing to say. Congratulations also to those at legambiente who take care of it.

reviews.title: la spiaggia più bella
reviews.text: wonderful! finally managed with the necessary attention to protecting the environment! she's beautiful!

reviews.title: Da non perdere
reviews.text: Try different times of day to see the variation in colors throughout the day. Unique experience

reviews.title: Spettacolare ma…
reviews.text: Remaining one of the most spectacular beaches of Lampedusa. Unfortunately there is a small flaw... It is really packed every day in both shifts, both morning and evening... In short, you spread your towel over other people, to reach the sea you step on other people's towels. Unfortunately I don't feel like giving it a full rating because the hours of waiting under the scorching sun were hellish.

reviews.title: paradisiaca
reviews.text: A visit to the beach is mandatory during your stay in Lampedusa (even more than one!). Stunning sea, lovely place.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa!
reviews.text: An essential stop when you go to Lampedusa, the most beautiful place on the whole island. Entry to people is limited, but much better than a few years ago.

reviews.title: Top top top
reviews.text: Stunning Caribbean beach, anyone who comes to Lampedusa absolutely must visit it. Although you have to walk quite a bit to reach it, it is certainly worth it!!

reviews.title: posto bellissimo ma stipato di gente
reviews.text: the place is enchanting, the Lampedusa-type sea is extraordinary and blue, sandy seabed but, even with a limited number of people, too many, too many, too many people

reviews.title: Splendida
reviews.text: Beautiful. It alone is worth the holiday. If you don't have a reservation, it's best to arrive at least 1 hour and a half early with an umbrella and bottles of water. The wait is long…

reviews.title: Una delle cose da vedere assolutamente a Lampedusa
reviews.text: We arrived at 1.15pm for the afternoon shift (entry from 2.30pm), as we had not been able to book entry. We queued and entered among the last places of the 150 that remain available daily, in both shifts. The wait is absolutely worth the spectacle that awaits. The beach is divided into two: a part dedicated to umbrellas (umbrellas only, no tents or similar) and a part forbidden to umbrellas. If you arrive and do not have an umbrella, you can rent it before going down to the beach at a price of €5, with a deposit of €10. Unfortunately on the day we went there were a lot of jellyfish, but that doesn't change our opinion on the matter.

reviews.title: Spettacolo
reviews.text: SPECTACULAR. Nothing to add. The only flaw is the queue to enter, but it's worth waiting HOURS.

reviews.title: Spiaggia Caraibica
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, crystal clear sea and uncontaminated environment. One of the few places on the island where there is still Mediterranean scrub. I recommend visiting it in the afternoon, so the "climb" on the way back will be less tiring as the sun will be much less scorching.

reviews.title: "nella media" delle straordinarie cale di Lampedusa
reviews.text: The three stars is compared to the general 5 stars of the Lampedusa coves. So to confirm how wonderful all of Lampedusa and not just Spiaggia dei Conigli are.  Indeed, this famous beach with its coves sees its most beautiful parts further away from the beach... swim towards Tabaccara and you will understand. Other coves of Lampedusa and especially that "northern" side which is not very accessible but incredible in colours, the coves and caves will make you understand better than the "relative judgement". Three stars of the rabbits is the 5 stars of the stack to the north west. you can only get there by boat but then you will understand.

reviews.title: Assolutamente da vedere
reviews.text: For those who come to Lampedusa, the rabbit beach cannot be missed. I find the reservation and limited number system excellent, and also very good is the fact that there are still places for those who want to get off (and get back on) several times a week, despite having already made a reservation.

reviews.title: Spiaggia meravigliosa   immersa in un ambiente integro.  Ricordate di prenotare
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with wonderful water, surrounded by nature, well managed by Legambiente volunteers, with maximum attention to environmental aspects, even if a bit of effort is required to get there, and limitations in the use of some areas of the beach, due to the presence of turtle nests and protected flora. Don't forget to book your visit well before you go.

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: In my experience as travelers there is almost all of Sardinia, Ibiza, Formentera, Cancun etc. etc. I can confirm that the beach of Rabbit Island is definitely in the top 3 positions in my personal ranking. Simply lovely! If you can, don't go in August.

reviews.title: La piscina di Dio
reviews.text: To say it's a paradise is an understatement, in fact it's nicknamed God's swimming pool. It leaves you enchanted at every point, you've never seen such a wonder. I give the 5 stars to paradise. Unfortunately, the management absolutely needs to be reviewed: you book with a choice of 2 shifts either morning or afternoon, the problem is that there is no possibility of going there at the time you want even if you choose one of the 2 shifts, in the morning if you want to get off at 11 for example it is not possible until 9.30 at the latest and the same in the afternoon. With all the reservations too many people and not even the possibility of putting up an umbrella, no basket to throw waste, it is true that it is a protected reserve but if they let people in you cannot fail to have a minimum of services. Among other things, an elderly person or a disabled person cannot even access it due to the route which could however be solved by also placing a wooden platform given that there are posts and rest areas with benches. I propose to pay for a ticket even with a symbolic amount and limit the number of people and review the flexibility of the times. Congratulations to the girls from the environmental league who protect the place but they too made me tender. They didn't even have a chair or toilets because rightly there are no means to then climb everything necessary. A paradise to be safeguarded and also to be experienced with the right means.

reviews.title: Improponibile…
reviews.text: The place is beautiful but....but really a mess of people despite the limited number...too much...500-600 people in 300 meters of beach is really too much! We are in a nature reserve... with turtle nests... children making sand castles and groups of people making noise cannot be seen. Charge €5 per person, have a limited number of 200 people and with the proceeds invest in improving the island and its infrastructure!

reviews.title: Paradiso terrestre
reviews.text: Crazy. Years of Sardinia forgotten thanks to this earthly paradise. 15 minute walk on a dirt road that opens onto an almost surreal islet. Wow!

reviews.title: Spettacolo divino ❤
reviews.text: Spectacular, excellent, wonderful, water that looks like a swimming pool, how clear it is, really ok 👌 I had never seen a sea like this, both my boyfriend and I will definitely go back with our families ❤

reviews.title: Jolie
reviews.text: Very pretty beach. Own. Turquoise water. it feels like you're in the Caribbean. Be careful if you have children, you have to walk about 20 minutes....Otherwise it's magnificent. We could see the fish clearly.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: A paradise, that's the right word for this place. Shoes should be used for comfort, especially when going up.

reviews.title: Magnifica
reviews.text: Absolutely worth seeing... fabulous beach and sea.  You can also admire the villa in Modugno... it was there that he got the inspiration for the song "in the blue painted blue" it couldn't be otherwise!!!                   Reservations are required to visit it.

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei conigli
reviews.text: Amazing one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen, too bad we didn't know about the reservation and so we did it twice but it was definitely worth it

reviews.title: Favoloso
reviews.text: A fairytale place, crystal clear water, going out of season would make you enjoy the spectacular nature of the place more

reviews.title: Spiaggia incantevole
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Lampedusa. Access can be booked online but you can also access without a reservation (max 150 people). To get there you have to walk 15-20 minutes downhill. Possibility of paid parking (€3.50) and umbrella rental at the Onda Blu kiosk. I consider it the most beautiful beach in Lampedusa, simply enchanting.

reviews.title: Almeno una volta nella vita!
reviews.text: Beautiful and evocative! To get there you have to take a small "rocky" path but it is absolutely worth the effort!

reviews.title: Indescrivibile
reviews.text: Not having been able to book entry, we arrived around 2.00pm for the 2.30pm entry, when they started to let in those who had reservations and finally us. The wait is under the sun except for the first to arrive who manage to stand under the gazebos, the descent challenging but not feasible even with flip flops. A show not to be missed!

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Even though we hadn't booked, we still managed to get in by showing up in the morning before 8.30am. There is little to say about the beach, exceptional is to say little, a fairy tale. Crystal clear sea, certainly one of the most beautiful beaches in Italy. Mandatory stop if you visit Lampedusa.

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei Conigli .
reviews.text: Limited entrances with reservation.    Always and in any case the Top of the beaches of Lampedusa. Stunning crystal clear water.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: From a naturalistic point of view it is a spectacle. I dived with my mask on and thought I was in a swimming pool. The guys from LegaAmbiente who monitor it do a wonderful job to keep it clean and make it suitable for what the beach is really reserved for, namely the laying of turtle eggs. Since you have to access with a reservation and you have to choose between the morning and afternoon shifts, I would recommend the afternoon shift which goes from 2pm to 7.30pm, so that you don't go up the hill during the hottest hours of the day (which would happen if you chose the morning shift). It is better to arrive before the established time so as to stay under the gazebos in the shade and not have to queue in the sun and also be able to get off first to choose your favorite place on the beach. I also recommend wearing sneakers. Access is still allowed to people without reservations but in that case in my opinion it is better to arrive a lot earlier or try your luck and arrive well after the start times of the shifts, hoping that someone has already gone back up. However, in my opinion it is mandatory to visit it.

reviews.title: bella e impossibile
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in the world, without risk of being denied, but difficult to reach, we had taken the morning shift which meant that at 1.30pm we had to go back up with a terrifying temperature and risk of heat stroke! Well done to the guys who checked it!

reviews.title: Piscina naturale
reviews.text: There is little to say from a naturalistic point of view that hasn't already been said, spectacular sea, it feels like diving into a swimming pool. Qlc precisely for those who plan to visit in the hottest periods, both climatically and due to crowding. We did the morning shift, booking on the site. Unfortunately the alarm didn't go off, and we arrived just at 9.30am. We need to travel about 20 minutes (1 km) on a dirt road, well maintained, but it's better to travel it with tennis shoes (not that it isn't possible in flip flops... but closed shoes are certainly better). The road is in the sun, there are a couple of shaded stops, the descent is done without too much difficulty, the climb at 1.30pm under a practically African sun at the end of July is certainly more demanding, perhaps I would recommend the afternoon shift. The beach, small and despite the limited access, still very crowded, is divided into three parts: area with umbrellas, the smallest, all crowded together in search of a minimum of shade which otherwise cannot be found. The part only towels, larger a minimum of more space. Some inaccessible areas where the turtles go to lay. Conclusions: beautiful to spend a few hours bathing in a natural pool with some nice big fish trying to avoid the heat and crowding.

reviews.title: il paradiso!
reviews.text: Without words! A wonderful fantastic beach and sea! It's worth the 15 minute walk to get there and then return.. 🤩

reviews.title: Esperienza da fare
reviews.text: The colors of this sea leave you speechless, it seems like you are in paradise! Beach kept very well by the Legambiente volunteers, to whom we also asked questions about the laying of eggs by turtles (in fact, there are many small nests protected by a fence). I suffered a lot on the way back on foot even though we were in the afternoon, I found myself in a bit of difficulty due to the scorching sun, the whole uphill route full of salt and with the umbrella and backpacks on my shoulders was a considerable slog. But at least once in your life it is worth doing.

reviews.title: Una meraviglia da preservare
reviews.text: An enchantment, nothing to say, a marvel that will take your breath away, colors of the sea ranging from transparent to intense blue, fish of all kinds, very fine light sand which allows for a unique play of colors in the sea, sheer cliffs, in short, a unique beauty. Well done to the guys at Lega Ambiente who keep order and booking helps you enjoy it more with the reserved number. I confirm the ranking, it is certainly the most beautiful in Italy and among the most beautiful in the world

reviews.title: Un paradiso all’improvviso
reviews.text: A dream beach just a few hours' flight from home! The access regulated and controlled by Lega Nothing volunteers is impeccable! Even though it was July and therefore full, I never felt the feeling of being crowded. We were also able to appreciate a caretta caretta turtle nest. Descent and ascent are easy even with small children. It is recommended to organize yourself with umbrellas, food and water as they are not available in the reserve but only on the road before the descent.

reviews.title: Imperdibile
reviews.text: There's little to say, it's paradise. We chose the morning shift more than anything else to manage the return at 1pm under the sun. The journey downhill in the morning is a walk, the return must be done with a good supply of water. The beach is sensational and the water even more so.

reviews.title: CARAIBICA!!! DA VEDERE
reviews.text: Fabulous, a beach to absolutely see. wake up at 7, queue to enter the first 150 at 8.30. You go down on foot and find yourself faced with a unique spectacle. Crystalline Caribbean sea, white beach, part of which is reserved for turtle egg-laying. A myriad of fish!!! Unica.ps take a bath before going back up at 1.30pm!!

reviews.title: Paradiso sudato
reviews.text: Breathtaking beach, wonderful sea, beach, nature around. The road ahead is tiring, full of rocks, sunny and steeply sloping. But in the end....PARADISE!

reviews.title: Il paradiso in Terra...che rimanga incontaminato per sempre!
reviews.text: The emotion that this enchanted corner of the world gives to the heart as soon as you start to descend is incredible... magnificent, sublime 360° panorama... comfortable, beautiful white sand beach, crystal clear sea of ​​various colours... looking towards the tobacconist... breathless. They take baths that I will never be able to repeat in my life... quite easy and tidy access, thanks to the Legambiente volunteers.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: A marvel! You absolutely can't miss it, it's worth it...we booked the beach for a morning and an afternoon. We parked the car along the street and paid. To get there you have to walk for a while, so it's best to have comfortable shoes and not be too full... the 15 minute walk is worth it... The beach is small, but spectacular, crystal clear, warm, clean water... Superb, a place that will remain in my heart!

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: Second time in Lampedusa, the rabbit beach is a must. On the southern coast of the island, the view is spectacular as you pass the first part of the road to descend, the colors of the sea are unique, a true naturalistic oasis monitored by Lega Ambiente volunteers, who do a priceless job in keeping clean and supervising the swimmers (sometimes a little undisciplined). Limited entry, with the possibility of booking. You can't holiday in Lampedusa without going to the rabbits. I absolutely recommend it.

reviews.title: Un SOGNO ad occhi aperti!
reviews.text: A daydream! Already when you see it from above you understand that you have arrived in paradise, you really remain to admire it in religious silence! Then when you dive into its waters you are truly surrounded and dazzled by splendid shades of blue and turquoise! A fairytale to swim from the beach to the isthmus of the Isolotto dei Conigli and continue towards Tabaccara....in short, the Isola dei Conigli alone is worth the plane ticket to Lampedusa! <3<3<3

reviews.title: Altro che Maldive!!
reviews.text: Amazing place!! the most beautiful beach I have ever seen. From this year you must book entry where it is only allowed once a week or for the morning or afternoon. However, there are 150 daily places together with the places of those who have booked and did not show up, available to those who have not booked, clearly first come first served. We went once with a reservation and once without. Extraordinary!

reviews.title: MERAVIGLIOSO
reviews.text: You can't miss it, it's an oasis of paradise. It's a shame about the many people and the queue before entering but it's really worth it. advice: go in the afternoon

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: Spectacular. Crystal clear water, not cold and sinking gently, a practically uncontaminated landscape except for the Villa of Modugno... During our visit we were lucky enough to find perfect weather, zero algae and zero jellyfish, which apparently we frequent. If I have to find a flaw and that is that dirt comes from the sea, I brought back to shore several paper cups that had almost certainly flown away from passing boats....

reviews.title: Il paradiso esiste anche in Italia
reviews.text: Place to leave you speechless, colors of the sea comparable only to the Maldives. Something extraordinarily UNIQUE. Daydreaming

reviews.title: STUPENDA!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach to see because it is worth a visit!!! There is a refreshment point only when you park.... There is no refreshment point on the beach!!! Bring food and water!!!

reviews.title: Un paradiso
reviews.text: Absolutely worth seeing... this place literally leaves you speechless, how beautiful it is, in fact you find yourself in front of an intense blue sea with clear water. What about the fish that pass between your legs? Even if you have to walk part of the way, it's really worth it. The only problem is that the people they let in by reservation (1000) per day in 2 shifts are too many. In fact, on the beach you are practically very close between umbrellas. However, well managed by Lega Anbiente who I thank for their presence and for protecting this wonderful place.

reviews.title: Splendida
reviews.text: A wonderful beach without boats anchored in the sea with splendid white sand. Reservation, even if it creates a bit of problems, allows for a liveability that would otherwise be impossible. If you manage to get off at the beginning of the shift (morning or afternoon) it allows you to see it practically empty and even more suggestive.

reviews.title: Vacanza
reviews.text: Fabulous beach well organized with entry and exit times. dream beach to absolutely see

reviews.title: Non delude le aspettative !!
reviews.text: As described she is. For this beach alone, the trip to Lampedusa is worth it. You need to book a maximum of half a day in a week on the legambiente website. This is the bad thing but also the good thing that allows you to avoid crowding. An obligatory stop obviously

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Paradise..in the morning clearer water (or maybe as they say it depends on the winds?) a sight for the eyes..unforgettable..I recommend everyone to go there once in their life

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: Fantastic beach, white sand and sea with a thousand shades from light blue to blue. Reservations are required in high season (this year from June 20th) and there are two shifts, in the morning from 8.30am to 1.30pm and in the afternoon. Unmissable!

reviews.title: SPETTACOLO
reviews.text: This year it is necessary to book and we chose the morning (there are two shifts). Better this way as you avoid too many people and can enjoy everything better. It is accessed via a path that can be done even with slippers and which lasts about 10 minutes. The spectacle that opens up before us is truly speechless. I understand why it is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Thanks to the Legambiente volunteers for their work. Since there are no deckchairs or services on the beach, I consider half a day to be sufficient. Instead, there is a kiosk also stocked for lunches at the entrance. Super highly recommended.

reviews.title: Il paradiso può attendere
reviews.text: Paradise. It far surpasses the photographs. Bathtub type water (even too much) snorkeling around the suggestive island. Fish, friends of man, feel protected there, and they are! It must be seen once in a lifetime, everything else is boring (but not the beaches of Lampedusa)

reviews.title: La spiaggia dei conigli un incanto, dire che il paradiso esiste è poco, poi i ragazzi lega ambiente molto gentili
reviews.text: Rabbit Island is a marvel, the kids are very kind and attentive, everything is super organised, top top

reviews.title: Esperienza unica!
reviews.text: There are no words to describe the sensations you feel when you arrive at Spiaggia dei Conigli... it feels like you're in a fantasy world! It takes a little time to go down (be careful, the road is bumpy) and a lot of effort to go back up, but it's definitely worth it, you have to go there at least once. Bathing in that sea so clear and clear is wonderful, and even if there are a lot of people - always limited - you have the sensation of being alone. Not surprisingly it is one of the 10 most beautiful beaches in the world! I forgot: you need to book, the demand is now so high that you can only go to the beach for half a day, morning or afternoon, but I highly recommend coming down and enjoying this beach!!!!!

reviews.title: Bella da togliere il fiato
reviews.text: Breathtakingly beautiful, we arrived after leaving our bikes and walking about a quarter of an hour on a beautiful path, wearing trekking sandals. We are not interested in beach life, we stopped for about an hour and a half, time to do a bit of swimming with the fish, accompanied by the sound of the seagulls. Luckily Lega Ambiente does an excellent job and reminds swimmers how to behave. It is the most beautiful marine environment I have seen so far, not only the beach and the island, but the entire landscape, including Tabaccara. The choice of limiting attendance and monitoring by the staff is perfect, making this corner of paradise accessible even to those who, like us, are absolutely not interested in bringing us an umbrella. Sincere congratulations for the organization.

reviews.title: Il simbolo di Lampedusa
reviews.text: You can't come to Lampedusa without seeing the island and the rabbit beach, its symbol. When there are no controls the beach is packed, but by choosing the time well I was able to enjoy it to the full... I've never seen such large fish that get close to people. Unique!

reviews.title: Troppa gente
reviews.text: Access is free upon reservation, but they accept too many people worse than Rimini, one umbrella on top of the other. Being contingent it should be managed better. But the place is heavenly.

reviews.title: Un paradiso
reviews.text: Paradise beach, the view from above takes your breath away, truly wonderful! An impressive set of colours!

reviews.title: niente di più bello
reviews.text: a real open-air museumWe traveled around a lot, but we had never seen such beautySUPER SUPER SUPERunforgettable

reviews.title: Ottimo  tutto
reviews.text: Thanks to the excellent work of the guys from the environmental league who control the beach. Beach and Caribbean waters

reviews.title: Caraibi
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with fine sand and crystal clear water, it's a bit of a hike but it's definitely worth it. Comparable to the Calamosce beach in Vendicari in Sicily

reviews.title: Paradisiaca e ben venga il numero contingentato
reviews.text: We went when there wasn't a limited number yet... and it was the only flaw because even though it was June and we arrived at 9.15... the umbrella area was already invaded, we were practically enjoying the shade of those nearby... but on the sea there is no doubt that it is a marvel

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: Spectacular beach to say the least, fantastic panorama, crystal clear sea, congratulations to the environmental league for the excellent work done and for the care of this corner of paradise

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: How can you not give 5 stars to this place? The photos speak for themselves, but they do not give an idea of ​​the beauty of this place. Accessible until the 20th without reservation, after which entry is only allowed to a limited number of people (around 300).

reviews.title: Bellissima ,ma scomoda ....
reviews.text: The place is simply wonderful. The small beach of fine sand bordered on both sides by areas closed to bathing, a sea that looks like a natural swimming pool that slopes gently and therefore suitable for children, but which in our opinion, having gone there for the first (and last) time, caused too many inconveniences. Being an area with landscape restrictions, the construction of any structure is not permitted, therefore no toilets, no bar, no showers, no lifeguard, and almost no cell phone connection. To get there to the beach, after having parked on the side of the only possible road, you have to walk for about 25 minutes, a downhill dirt path full of stray pebbles. Despite the inconveniences, we found the place crowded with families with small children in tow, and it was difficult to find a place for us. In fact, in the afternoon, given the excessive crowding that was increasing, we left facing the tiring climb under the heat of 3pm. Luckily they built some rest points with shelter from the sun along the way to get to the top where luckily there is a refreshment point. The place is definitely worth seeing at least once, but we will definitely only return by sea.

reviews.title: Top top top
reviews.text: They told me it was one of the nicest beaches in the world... but once I saw it... I CONFIRM. Don't let us discourage you

reviews.title: La casa di Modugno uno scempio
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world reminiscent of the Caribbean, certainly the first, Italy is the most beautiful beach I have ever seen in my life, it's a shame that the house in Modugno was illegal and which, according to the inhabitants, could also be used for a refreshment point and toilets given that it was built illegally. Now it is Modugno's former house and they throw parties there so much so that we saw a snotty girl go out and say ''this is Domenico's house' Modugno'' with an air of superiority these things must never happen again

reviews.title: La più bella spiaggia del mondo.
reviews.text: The best beach in the world for water and charm. One part is reserved for caretta caretta turtles that lay their eggs.

reviews.title: Unica, forse troppo!
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach ever! Maybe too much. So beautiful that we human beings should perhaps avoid passing by! Go there, but be aware that you must not leave any trace of your passage. It belongs to nature, not to man! No smoking, no eating, no umbrellas (up to a certain limit) if you go there just show a lot of respect!!!  And above all, demand it!!

reviews.title: Troppa gente
reviews.text: Beautiful place but invaded by people for whom being in Lampedusa or Rimini changes nothing... The most total ignorance... Little protected by the municipal administration, in the name of the God of Tourism... Very happy that from mid-June, we will start with the limited number...

reviews.title: Luogo bellissimo gestito malissimo
reviews.text: I would like to point out straight away that my unconventional assessment is related NOT to the place itself but to my latest experience as a whole. I returned after 20 years to Lampedusa and obviously to Isola dei Conigli and I found a situation that had radically changed for the worse. Let me start by saying that I am a true lover of nature and I am always very careful to preserve it and that I have visited several parks and natural areas of particular interest and beauty, so I can speak with knowledge. The place is truly beautiful, the beach and the Isola dei Conigli are truly unique and deserve to be at the TOP in the world, unfortunately, however, in recent years the management of Lega Ambiente has been criticized by many. I definitely criticize it. I agree with being careful to preserve the place but often you reach levels of extremism that don't make much sense (like not using stones on the beach to stop the beach towel otherwise you'll ruin the environment!), but what really infuriated thousands of tourists is the way of managing and limiting access to the place. You have to book a long time ago, the number of tourists allowed is very limited, the portal doesn't work at all, telephone numbers that never answer, hours-long queues to go through the "check in" at the entrance, from this year the quota starts on 20 June and until 15 October. !! A family that goes to Lampedusa risks not being able to "enjoy" this beautiful place. It's a shame for this tourist policy which, in my opinion, ultimately penalizes the island. It would be enough to take example from other natural beauties and how they are managed (different places and lakes in the Dolomites for example - ) where the tourist is a treasure for the area, while in Lampedusa I didn't have this feeling.

reviews.title: Spiaggia dell’isola dei conigli
reviews.text: It is a fabulous beach, fine sand and crystal clear sea. The walk to the beach is magnificent and shows it to you from above. The beach is small and there are a lot of people, it is best to arrive early and leave before the afternoon as it gets very crowded. Caribbean or even better, on the level of Sardinia

reviews.title: Magica Spiaggia dei Conigli
reviews.text: The place, given that I have been coming back for years, is magnificent, I am sorry for the rudeness of the tourists who, despite the no smoking signs, arrive on the beach with lit cigarettes that magically disappear into thin air. Hurry to limit the number of those who can access otherwise we will also lose this beautiful beach

reviews.title: Da non perdere
reviews.text: Stunning beach especially if visited early in the season without crowds. Very clean fresh water, unmatched colours.

reviews.title: Incantevole ma caotica.
reviews.text: There is no doubt that the beach and the sea in front of it are wonderful, but it's a shame that overcrowding doesn't allow them to be fully appreciated. Bring along an umbrella and comfortable shoes or sandals to walk along the path.

reviews.title: Semplicemente MAGIA
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach we have ever seen.... Crystal clear water😍😍😍 I recommend wearing very comfortable slippers because you have to take a few steps to get there….

reviews.title: UN SOGNO
reviews.text: A spectacle of nature! lovely. Access is permitted upon reservation and is perfectly right to be able to enjoy this beach to the fullest.

reviews.title: La più bella al mondo
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in the world, a unique paradise. The path, a little tiring to reach the beach, is made easier by the fact that what awaits you is God's swimming pool. Crazy colours, white sand and lots of little fish swimming around you.

reviews.title: top

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: When you get to see the sea you are breathless. Wonderful colors. A big thank you to the environmental league for the work to safeguard this corner of paradise

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei Conigli
reviews.text: The Spiaggia dei Conigli is undoubtedly the strongest attraction of Lampedusa, and in fact it does not disappoint. Seen from above and below it is always a marvel. An honor to have been here.

reviews.title: La grande bellezza
reviews.text: What can I say, words are not enough to describe this wonder of nature. From this year the beach, rightly, is accessible to a limited number of people. I recommend booking in advance to spend more than an hour under the sun or get up early.... Please respect what nature has lovingly created.

reviews.title: Spiaggia da sogno
reviews.text: This beach is really fantastic, you need to book to go but it's absolutely worth it. Arm yourself with strength to face the route that comes to get there but absolutely worth visiting. The sea offers an absurd amount of marine life. Truly beautiful

reviews.title: La bellezza in assoluto
reviews.text: The most beautiful ever 🥰. An indescribable emotion, a paradise. I can't wait for summer to arrive so I can go back immediately

reviews.title: Un paradiso
reviews.text: This beach looks like paradise. An almost enchanted place dominated by blue in all its shades. To get there you have to take a slightly tortuous path that takes about 20 minutes but it's absolutely worth it!

reviews.title: Vacanza a Lampedusa
reviews.text: I know this beach which for me is really beautiful: this year I was a bit disappointed, with the reservation I thought I would find fewer people, unfortunately it was very crowded as always. I didn't understand the point of the reservation! However, always a magical place, the colors of the sea are unique, spectacular, worth seeing

reviews.title: INCANTEVOLE
reviews.text: There are few words to describe this spectacle of nature. BEAUTIFUL beach, not to be missed.

reviews.title: spettacolo puro ....ed emozioni
reviews.text: made the reservation on the site (not exactly slender) for the morning, we go ... we go down a path for a good 15 minutes and finally I see ... the sensations you feel when you arrive on the sand are often attributable to paradise, never used better than in this circumstance, the blue envelops you and after the interminable bath you almost have the sensation of still having it on you .... spectacular

reviews.title: Accesso limitato alla spiaggia dovrebbe essere per sempre!
reviews.text: Rabbit Beach is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world and must be preserved. This year what I appreciated most was the limited access which allowed us to stay in this paradise in total serenity. They should keep access restricted forever. It is the only way to preserve this nature reserve.

reviews.title: da toglierti il fiato
reviews.text: truly heavenly to take your breath away, among other things it is the ideal beach for children, shallow seabed and sand. It may be a negative point not to have refreshment points but it is right to preserve this corner of paradise. Mandatory stop for those visiting Lampedusa...so if necessary book in time otherwise the queue can become prohibitive, like the one in August.

reviews.title: Meraviglioso
reviews.text: Now I understand why I called it God's beach. It truly is a corner of paradise. It's a shame that from this year they have made reservations mandatory

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: They were in October, I managed to get in even without a reservation. Breathtaking place after the descent along the cliff you are faced with this wonder of nature with all its colors. The only flaw is too many people, they should be let through less and at a cost. A few steps away is the Modugno residence almost on the rabbit beach. Worth visiting

reviews.title: Rilassante
reviews.text: I can only write what I believe is the thought of everyone who comes here. A paradise on earth that, seen from above, takes your breath away

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: I have been lucky enough to visit beautiful beaches and seas in many parts of the world (including the Maldives)... but this beach and the sea that bathes it have nothing to envy. Water colors that leave you breathless with their beauty. Very fine white sand beach. I found the access organization very good. Absolutely worth going for a swim in one of the most beautiful waters in the world.

reviews.title: SORPRENDENTE
reviews.text: Giving the maximum rating is also an understatement, a place that takes your breath away, at the sight of the landscape I was enchanted... upon leaving I think I left a piece of my heart there... I will definitely return.

reviews.title: paradiso
reviews.text: I may be repetitive to many who have already reviewed it, but I assure you that just like that, the work of Legambiente volunteers is a fundamental value

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: Truly beautiful, sea ranging from intense blue to green to turquoise, the walk is worth it. Don't miss it!

reviews.title: Giustamente Famosa
reviews.text: This place is truly incredible! It looks like a natural swimming pool in a fairytale setting! The water, the sand, the colours, the islet... emotion!!!! Thank goodness there is a limited number of entries! Too much tourist influx is bad!!!

reviews.title: Più bella cosa non c'è
reviews.text: We went to this beach in September..... Unfortunately they take morning or afternoon shifts to access it... The path to reach it is comfortable and wide, sneakers are recommended but you can do it comfortably in slippers. The sea in front of us is splendid.... a Caribbean transparency.... warm water with an almost white seabed...... Absolutely worth seeing!!!!

reviews.title: Sabbia finissima
reviews.text: What can I say... super fine beach, wonderful sea, it looks like a swimming pool, the only flaw is having to book and only being able to stay for half a day all week!

reviews.title: Che acqua!
reviews.text: It's impossible not to be struck by so much beauty...transparent water, which takes on every shade of turquoise, white sand as fine as talcum powder, nothing to envy of the Caribbean and if you're lucky you can even see turtles laying their eggs...It's like being in paradise

reviews.title: Tutto bello ma...
reviews.text: I didn't have the wow effect... the beach is of fine sand and the sea is crystal clear. You can reach Rabbit Island by walking because the water is shallow but perhaps too many people despite entrances by reservation certainly make you lose the charm. Everything is beautiful but...I'm not sure it's the most beautiful beach

reviews.title: Spettacolo
reviews.text: Hi, I was on Sunday and I was speechless, it's a beach contaminated only by us tourists who are looked at by sight but without showing it by the WWF volunteers, the sea is a wonderful blue full of fish that play with you to see

reviews.title: troppa gente
reviews.text: to be a dream place with limited entry, the mass of people present was really too much to enjoy the landscape

reviews.title: Ultimo giorno, 3 ore di seguito in acqua!
reviews.text: I remembered Conigli beach as the Italian Maldives, and after 30 years this is still the sensation. We hadn't booked, too busy with diving, but we managed to do it on the last day. Even though the sea was a little rough due to the Sirocco, the temperature was 29 degrees, and the clarity of the sea, full of fish, and the fine sand gave us a last day of holiday to remember. Wonderful!

reviews.title: Avevo aspettative più alte
reviews.text: Notwithstanding the fact that it is a beautiful beach, I didn't find that something extra that I would have expected by reading the reviews online. In my opinion it is not very different from other places on the island.

reviews.title: L'armonia mentale
reviews.text: I took a thousand images in my mind so that I can return to them in my memory when rainy and cold days predominate in central Italy. My eyes saw shades of blue that seemed to have been painted by a painter... a good one!!!, my mind witnessed all this and was enraptured... but... alas... so many, so many people... really too many!!!, in any case it is worth visiting at least once in your life... in my opinion, in Italy... it doesn't exist no beach so beautiful

reviews.title: Sempre stupenda!
reviews.text: Always gorgeous beach! This year, when they decided to limit income, it is very liveable! Always beautiful and good the Legambiente volunteers!

reviews.title: Semplicemente ... L Eden
reviews.text: It's incredible that there is such a beautiful place that leaves you breathless, unique and worth all the effort to get there, go there twice or three times and it's unique The water, the fish, the cliffs, everything

reviews.title: Una delle spiagge più belle d’Italia
reviews.text: Beautiful beach that can be reached with a short panoramic walk. Sea of ​​indescribable colours, home to turtles laying their eggs. The attendance quota is good but it is unthinkable to be able to book just one day during the week

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful Italian beaches. Accessible with online booking (150 free places without) after a short road that is easy to follow once you arrive you will have the vision of a paradise for those who love the sea. White sand beach and on the left the possibility of snorkeling in a unique place. For those who want, possibility of renting an umbrella at the top of the street. If you are on the island you cannot miss it.

reviews.title: Da non credere
reviews.text: They say it is the most beautiful beach in the world. Before arriving I had seen many photos and so I knew what awaited me. But once I got there to you, the impact I had was devastating. Faced with so much beauty I was left speechless, almost in disbelief. It's a feeling I can't describe, I even struggle to remember it. The way it made me feel, I will remember it forever. The most beautiful beach I have seen in my entire life.

reviews.title: Uno scenario mozzafiato
reviews.text: The wonderful scenery that your eyes are preparing to admire from the rabbit viewpoint is indescribable. A sea with emerald turquoise colours, fine white sand, a unique landscape.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: Just one sentence can mean so much. Wonderful!!!!!!! You can't describe what you feel when you see it for the first time....Enchanted by its natural beauty and its shades of blue.

reviews.title: Sempre fantastico
reviews.text: It wasn't the first time, but 35 years ago, the area was totally wild. Now the pavement and the stairs help the descent and especially the ascent. Fantastic place, crystal clear and very warm water. Not to be missed.

reviews.title: Oramai un'attrazione
reviews.text: Undoubtedly the most beautiful sea, a splendid beach with a fairytale inlet. Too bad about the umbrellas planted everywhere.

reviews.title: Negli anni una certezza
reviews.text: Always a beautiful island which, after 20 years, always shows its territorial beauty for the first time, but unfortunately it is now prey to mass tourism with places abandoning the traditional fishing source for restaurants which now source their supplies from the continent. The Isola dei Conigli with nearby Tabaccara, however, remain eternal with their beauty protected by the new access rules which limit access in the peak season (be careful that the descent lasts 15 minutes and the ascent is sweaty). From the street where you park the sad deployment of hundreds of vehicles....

reviews.title: Lampedusa è persa...
reviews.text: Reviewing the Spiaggia dei Conigli I want to give a rating to all the beaches on the island. We are no longer here, unfortunately according to the residents the island is prey to mass tourism from the beginning of June until the end of September, this causes the impossibility of enjoying the beauties of nature that Lampedusa offers and the Spiaggia dei Conigli is no exception. The beach and sea are certainly of superior quality, but too many too many people. For those who are lucky enough to be able to travel, within a 10-hour flight a totally different world opens up to you... whoever has been to this beach, close your eyes and imagine it populated with no more than 4/6 people... that's what I mean. Sin.

reviews.title: Angolo di PARADISO
reviews.text: The pearl of Lampedusa! Worth it for the whole holiday... we entered without a reservation with a wake-up call at dawn, but without any effort for the landscape we found ourselves in front of! Thanks to Legambiente for preserving this corner of PARADISE! 😊😊

reviews.title: Bellissima ma scarsa organizzazione
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I've ever seen! However, I feel like making a note. From July this year it is only possible to access via reservation. Those without the latter can queue from 7am for the morning shift or from 1.30pm for the afternoon shift, all under the scorching sun (Max 150 people per shift). Now I ask myself, what does it take to provide those who don't have a reservation with a number from 1 to 150 in order to avoid those who ultimately won't be able to get in from queuing needlessly?

reviews.title: La più bella del mondo
reviews.text: Fortunately in my life I have traveled (to say the least) a lot, numerous cruises, reports, hotel villages etc. etc. seeing beaches, mountains, cities, towns, villages, states among the most beautiful and present in all the world rankings. But going after a hike of about 15 minutes downhill to this earthly paradise I can still say that I am moved, amazed and ecstatic. An authentic wonder in a dream setting: a promontory with a beach of very fine white sand with very clear water with blue shades in an enchanted atmosphere that led me to exclaim that I had seen the most beautiful beach in the world

reviews.title: Mare meraviglioso
reviews.text: The rabbit beach is a must for anyone staying in Lampedusa.  Rightly regulated by Legambiente volunteers.  2 shifts: 8.30/13.30 and 14.30/19.30. You can book online or queue for those who have not booked. I woke up very early and was the first in the queue for those who had not booked...... tiring, but for this sea I would wake up early every morning of the holiday. Stupendous!!!

reviews.title: Riserva naturale!
reviews.text: Visited twice with completely different experiences (which I personally still found fun and pleasant). First time: sun (very light veil of clouds), very calm sea. The colors of the sea were splendid, the temperature of the water quite warm: a real natural swimming pool with lots of fish. With the limited number of people, the beach is also more liveable, even if I personally spent 4 hours in the water. Second time: sun, rough sea (due to the sirocco). Unfortunately, the sea was "dirtied" by the presence of numerous algae, however we had a lot of fun with the waves. Not a recommended day for those hoping for a very calm sea, personally it's been a long time since I had so much fun at the seaside! A place absolutely worth seeing (I highly recommend booking on the site to avoid long waiting lines): be careful in case of sirocco if you don't like rough seas.

reviews.title: Vacanza
reviews.text: Too bad we can only stay for half a day! Beautiful beautiful beautiful Go organised, the beach is natural.

reviews.title: Un paradiso!
reviews.text: Holidays with friends in Lampedusa, a visit to this wonder of nature is a must! Arriving from above you find yourself faced with a breathtaking view, the fact of being able to stay for only a few hours and having to respect the rules imposed to preserve this naturalistic area made me absolutely fall in love with this place!!! Unmissable if you go to this island!

reviews.title: fantastica
reviews.text: The white beach mirrors the crystalline sea: The most beautiful beach on the whole island!!!  Unfortunately in August the crowding is inevitable but it is the Top

reviews.title: Pazzesca!
reviews.text: It lived up to expectations, one of the most beautiful beaches in the world! I recommend booking to avoid long queues. Absolutely worth visiting!!

reviews.title: Veramente Bella
reviews.text: Remember to book, do a quick online search to find the dedicated site, because the beach has limited access, around 300 people are expected to enter but in August there were certainly at least double that number. Entrances are at 8.30am and 2.30pm, those who have booked pass in the row on the left and all the others in the row on the right, the wait can be long and unnerving especially if you opt for the 2.30pm entry when the sun is beating down!! The beach is a nature reserve, it's allowed the use of the umbrella only in a limited part of the beach... the umbrella can be rented at the bar at the entrance. To reach the beach you have to walk about twenty minutes downhill and then uphill to get back...remember to pay for parking for motorbikes and cars........already!!!

reviews.title: Colori indescrivibili
reviews.text: Every year it is a fixed and always exciting stop. It is mandatory to experience it from land and sea. The colors that can be seen from the natural terrace are enchanting to say the least. The sea of ​​Lampedusa is among the most beautiful in Italy and perhaps in the world...

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella del mondo
reviews.text: The most beautiful in the world... there are no words to describe this CORNER OF PARADISE... now that the number is limited it is even more special. The view from above alone fills your heart. An enchanting place

reviews.title: Bellissima ma la signora in carne ricciola della lega ambiente rovina tutto, personaggio scomodo e arrogante che va sostituita
reviews.text: Fantastic beach, the most beautiful ever seen in my opinion, clean water and a thousand colours. I give 3 stars because of the lady with curly flesh of a certain age from the environmental league, a truly unpleasant and arrogant character who changes the booking rules for the beach in her own way and pleasure, who literally ruins the holidays of the people who had booked and she suddenly with invented excuses doesn't let certain people go so that she can let in her friends or the tours she has! Shabby management of a world heritage site! Rather make it pay, but remove that character from that paradise

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: It is the most beautiful and crystalline beach I have been to in my life, a true paradise on earth.

reviews.title: Niente da dire se non paradisiaca
reviews.text: Every time it is a unique emotion. Very well the idea of ​​the limited number allows you to enjoy the absolute beauty of this place with serenity. You absolutely must see it at least once in your life. A dream

reviews.title: paradiso
reviews.text: all the booking problems and annoyance disappeared as soon as the beach came into view halfway down the path...!! to take your breath away. being the first ones on shift, the beach was deserted, and we were able to admire its beauty without people. there are no words to describe the sea...certain emotions you just have to experience live. fortunately we managed to do two days.. both in the morning and in the afternoon.

reviews.title: Spettacolo
reviews.text: An open-air paradise. I recommend waking up early to go. Spectacular beach and transparent sea.

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: Simply spectacular: crystal clear sea, white sand beach. The idea of ​​limiting access in order to make it less crowded is excellent. It takes a bit of walking but it's worth it. I recommend booking via the website to avoid long queues under the sun.

reviews.title: Mare dalla bellezza e trasparenza unica
reviews.text: Since we were unable to book access, given the impossibility of accessing the site, we were lucky to swim to it during a boat trip moored just outside the protected area. Simply spectacular

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Every time I see those colors I get excited as if it were the first. No other beach in the world compares. Simply magnificent.

reviews.title: Uno spettacolo
reviews.text: White sand, crystal clear sea, a paradise. Access to the beach by online reservation (almost impossible) or via a long waiting list under the sun (I saw people with children queuing from 5 in the morning). You can reach the beach in about ten minutes along a slightly steep path (I recommend suitable shoes). The bar is located upstairs so take everything you need and bring it from home because then going back up is tiring. You have to pay for the car and scooter and they charge you for the whole day even if you can only stay for half a day. There is a part of the beach where you can set up umbrellas (or you can equip them yourself or you can rent them at the bar at the top), a part of the beach where you can only put towels and a non-accessible portion. The environment is present on site all the time. The reservations for access could only be improved. However, you cannot go to Lampedusa and not visit that wonder

reviews.title: Stupenda!
reviews.text: The beach is really worth visiting! Very fine sand, transparent water. Truly an evocative show!

reviews.title: MERAVIGLIA!
reviews.text: It's a marvel, no doubt about it, even if it's always very crowded. Until July 15th there was free entry, we went in the afternoon around 4.00pm / 4.30pm when the people who had been there since morning started to leave. The sea is a dream and has indescribable colors. The walk to the beach is easy, it really takes just a few minutes. Don't forget to stop at the terrace just before arriving because the view of the beach and island is breathtaking. If you don't have an umbrella you can rent one at the kiosk located at the beginning of the walk. It takes about 20 minutes to go up slowly. In the late afternoon the right side of the beach looking towards the sea slowly goes into the shade. To better admire the colors, I recommend going in the morning when they open. Booking on the site is free and simple to make. In 2 weeks we have been there at least 5 times because it is a wonder that alone is worth the trip!

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Well what can I say there is nothing to say just to admire and enjoy a true paradise. When you go down the path and find yourself in front of the view you can hardly believe it.

reviews.title: Meraviglia della natura
reviews.text: What can I say... nothing, just something to see at least once in your life. I fully agree with the decision to assign a limited number of visits. We weren't able to book and yet we got in and lined up at 7.30 in the morning. It's worth it.

reviews.title: La più bella spiaggia di Lampedusa peccato x l’attesa tutti ammassati
reviews.text: I queued 3 times as I never found a place on the booking site. In the morning it's liveable but in the afternoon being under the scorching sun at 1pm wasn't for me. It would be nice to put some notes so that people know that after 150 people there is no descent or they descend later, so that we can organize another way. So you stand in line hoping to just get in. It is the most beautiful beach on the island so you also do this to see it but in August it wouldn't hurt to organize yourself a little better.

reviews.title: LA DIMOSTRAZIONE CHE IL PARADISO ESISTE
reviews.text: This experience is worth the trip to Lampedusa. The beach is limited and everything works perfectly. The descent takes place peacefully with breathtaking views, the ascent especially in the morning is tiring and must be taken calmly. Once you reach the beach it seems like you have arrived in another fantastic world made of fine sand and crystal clear waters. Unfortunately between a swim and a walk the 5 hours fly by. Enjoy every second

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: To get to the rabbit beach, you can get there in a quarter of an hour/twenty minutes from the entrance. Sneakers or rock shoes are recommended, especially for the descent. If you don't have them, you can do it anyway. I did it myself without any particular problems. At the moment you can enter with a reservation but if you are lucky, if you wait half an hour/an hour you can visit it anyway. Bring go pro. Fantastic landscape, dream water

reviews.title: che mareeeeee !!!
reviews.text: Truly enchanting place, with crystal clear waters and a white beach. It's worth all the effort to reach it and above all to leave it

reviews.title: Miglior Spiaggia d'EUROPA
reviews.text: With the current quota the beach is much more livable and the environment is more respected. Fantastic crystal clear sea, breathtaking descent

reviews.title: Il Paradiso con una sola pecca!
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful places our country can offer. The beach can be reached with a descent of stones and cobblestones lasting about 15 minutes, so I suggest comfortable shoes and a hat! The bar at the top of the slope offers the possibility of renting an umbrella for 5 euros for the beach (very convenient, highly recommended). Once you reach it, you position yourself on the right or left based on who owns the umbrella or not. The only negative note: presence of stray dogs on the beach, also left free by LegaAmbiente volunteers, who lie down on the towels of people in the water looking for shade and rest, not very pleasant! I suggest fixing this island issue!

reviews.title: Meraviglia delle meraviglie
reviews.text: Never seen a beach and such beautiful and transparent water. A special thanks to Legambiente which regulates entrances and exits from the beach, so that everyone can admire this asset that mother nature has given to us all.

reviews.title: Acqua cristallina ma che fatica
reviews.text: I went to the rabbit beach on both the morning and afternoon shifts. In the morning it is pleasant to go down the rather tortuous path made of stones and sand (I recommend wearing comfortable shoes) while when you have to go back up at 1.30pm the sun beats down hard and the climb is quite heavy enough to make you feel sick. In the afternoon, however, if you leave around 7pm when the sun has set, it is less difficult to go back up but I advise against it for those with mobility problems. In the afternoon the sun sets behind the mountain then leaves the beach around 6pm. The sea is crystal clear turquoise so in any case it is worth a visit

reviews.title: Istruzioni per l'uso (estate 2021)
reviews.text: Instructions for use (summer 2021).To reach the beach you have to walk for about 15/20 minutes on a path, so wear comfortable shoes. The beach is sandy, there is no shade or any kiosk, bring everything you need. The sea is crazy, even with the sirocco and rough seas the water is crystal clear. To access: you must book via the online system. If, like us, you have not managed to book either of the two shifts, one in the morning and one in the afternoon, you have this option: try to get in line a few minutes before 8 in the morning because every day the people who have booked are let in and those who don't show up give way to those who have lined up "off the list". At 1.30pm the beach is cleared out and at 2.30pm the afternoon shift begins: here too, you can try to get in line to take the place of those who don't show up or of the people who come back before 7.30pm (at that time the beach is cleared again as it is a breeding ground for turtles).

reviews.title: Meraviglia!
reviews.text: Wonderful beach located on the south coast of Lampedusa which can be accessed after a walk of about a quarter of an hour. I recommend avoiding too hot times because the route is entirely in the sun and wearing comfortable, laced shoes. You can park along the road on the blue lines for a fee and, for those who wish, before getting off, you can rent an umbrella at the bar kiosk. At the entrance, two lines form: one for those with reservations (the lucky few who managed to do so) who enter immediately and another for those who are not reserved who enter in small groups until the expected number is reached. The beach and the sea are wonderful, the sand is white and the water is crystal clear and you can see sea bream, sea bream and many other fish with the naked eye. But what really leaves you speechless are certainly the colors. There are all shades of green and blue especially going towards the rabbit island, reachable by sea simply by walking and from which it is also possible to admire the splendid Cala della Tabaccara. A spectacle!

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: Wonderful island, out of this world. All spectacular, Rabbit Island is a window onto paradise. A boat trip around the island is a must.
