We boarded the ditch... they served lunch on board, a day trip in company, you can admire the beautiful coasts of the island and have fun diving into the crystal clear water. Personally, I left my heart there, I will return

reviews.title: Pessima
reviews.text: Such a peculiar and wonderful beach should be protected, but instead it is covered with umbrellas and I was able to see that, despite what people say, access is not that "contingent". People constantly violate the bans, crossing the areas delimited by ropes, even moving boulders and throwing them into the water, they smoke and it is of no use that there is a law that prohibits smoking on the beaches...

reviews.title: Molto bella
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, I fully agree with the limited entry. The best beach on the island. You can enter without queuing and booking at around 6.00 pm, then you are obliged to return at 7.30 pm.

reviews.title: Mare cristallino e panorama mozzafiato
reviews.text: Absolutely the most beautiful beach that my eyes have been lucky enough to admire! The crystalline color of the water combined with the rocks and greenery around, gives the beach a truly magical and evocative air. The sea remains low for a long stretch, making it in all respects like a street to walk on. I also recommend snorkeling activities.

reviews.title: DIVINA
reviews.text: What can I say, a review page wouldn't be enough to describe the wonder this beach offers. Caribbean colors that remain even when the sea is rough. The beach is a bit small due to the amount of people who manage to get there despite reservations. Basically the most beautiful beach I have ever seen.

reviews.title: Regalo di Dio all'uomo
reviews.text: A great gift from God, Legambiente controls it well, willing guys who lend themselves..... they should be more numerous......

reviews.title: Fantastico
reviews.text: There is no doubt, it is the most beautiful beach in the world. We arrived early in the morning because we were unable to book but if you go early you can enter even without a reservation after queuing for a while. There are two shifts, from 8.30am to 1.30pm and from 2.30pm to 6.30pm. To go down to the beach you have to take a journey of about ten minutes, not difficult but entirely under the sun. The water is fantastic, transparent and very light, when I swim you really feel like it slides over you. It comes naturally to swim for hours because it is a truly unique sea. There is no bar or services on the beach. In half of the beach it is possible to place your own umbrellas which can also be rented at the bar located at the entrance on the street. Unmissable stop in Lampedusa.

reviews.title: hanno contingentato le discese con prenotazione
reviews.text: One of the very few things that the mayor of Lampedusa did well (it is doubtful whether he was the one to do so) was to limit the number of descents in the protected area. from July 15th there were 300 people in the morning and 300 in the afternoon. Then they doubled their size, after some complaints from tourists. Beautiful place. One of the most beautiful beaches in the world.

reviews.title: Spiaggia inaccessibile
reviews.text: Too many people, it's not for me to go to a place during a holiday and stand in a queue like that under the scorching sun. They should definitely review the organization of access.

reviews.title: La spiaggia per eccellenza più bella d’Italia
reviews.text: The beach par excellence, dreamy colours, breathtaking views. The beach is free as it is a natural reserve. This year due to Covid and one side of the beach with risk of rockfall, they had to make it limited, reservations via the dedicated site are impossible to make, everything is already full. They let in 100 more people than expected, putting them on the list that same morning at the opening time of 8.30. Or another possibility to access it without a reservation is to show up at 3.30pm/4pm and wait for someone to leave to take their place. To get there you need a 30 minute walk in nature, I recommend trainers. It's absolutely worth it.

reviews.title: Favolosa
reviews.text: Just one word. FABULOUS! I never imagined being enchanted by the sight of this wonder of nature.

reviews.title: Spettacolare ma...
reviews.text: The beach is heavenly, truly among the most beautiful in the world. The only negative note is the organisation, which is terrible. I only found out on 14th July that bookings were compulsory starting from 15th July. The site was unreachable and places were all occupied until 30th July. First time in Lampedusa for only a few days, I decided to try and get in line. I only managed to get in at 6pm in the evening, only because someone was starting to leave.Once in beach, the restrictions are appreciated, very few people (about 300) however what is annoying is the injustice in the reservations. People from the same family unit who manage to book under different names on different shifts. The booking system needs to be improved!

reviews.title: Bellissima ma...
reviews.text: The rabbit beach can be said to be the only real beach on Lampedusa together with Guitgia which remains smaller, otherwise there are only small coves on the island. Furthermore, it remains the only truly free beach on Lampedusa as the remaining ones are now all privatised. The only real costs are parking of around €7 per day for a car (I recommend purchasing the ticket before parking as the license plate number is necessary) and any umbrella rental of €5 at the only kiosk present. It is possible to access the beach via a sloping path of approximately 15/20 minutes along which it is possible to take some beautiful photos at the various panoramic points. Once you arrive at the beach you will notice that half the beach is closed to the public due to rockfall and it is monitored by the Legambiente guys (luck and joy). It goes without saying that in terms of naturalistic context and colors the beach remains among the most beautiful in the world, in Italy only in Sardinia I found the same shades of blue, with the right wind (tramontane, mistral, north wind) the sea is a plain that goes from white to dark blue passing through light blue and light blue. Unfortunately, as beautiful as it is, I cannot give it 5 stars, this is mainly due to the lack of intervention by the state and the competent bodies who have done and continue to do nothing to secure the mountain behind which collapsed more than 5 years ago, making it impossible to use the other portion of the beach. As for Legambiente volunteers, it doesn't seem right to me that they should be street cleaners on the beach due to the incivility of people who still throw even just a cigarette butt on the sand. I was lucky enough to visit this beach at the end of June and beginning of July but already towards the middle of July the first restrictions began, NO to mattresses, NO to tents on the beach and from 15th July it is necessary to book access to the beach via a website, I advise you given the high turnout to book even before arriving on site otherwise in the case of weekly stays there is the risk that you arrive in Lampedusa and cannot visit this paradise on earth

reviews.title: Paradiso da conservare
reviews.text: I managed to access the beach thanks to the waiting list (arriving at the entrance around 2pm, we waited about an hour before being able to get off). Walk of about 15 minutes, also doable with flip flops. Once you arrive at the panoramic point, the spectacle you can admire is priceless: water with crazy colors, fine white sand, boats that seem to fly on the sea. I'm happy there is a limited number with reservations, it's a paradise that needs to be safeguarded!

reviews.title: Bella spiaggia, peccato per le nuove restrizioni annunciate con poco preavviso
reviews.text: The beach is very beautiful, with fine, white sand. The color of the water is crystalline blue. A few days after my arrival in Lampedusa, I discovered that from July 15th it was possible to access this reserve only through a reservation; It's a shame that this was announced with little notice!! Difficult to book on the site, I tried several times in vain.

reviews.title: Spiaggia unica al mondo
reviews.text: Unique beach in the world! Beach truly like the Maldives! Calm, low sea is wonderful! I recommend renting an umbrella for just €5 (+€10 deposit) as soon as you arrive in the car park. Their umbrellas are more resistant, as there is always a strong wind in Lampedusa. Parking cost €3.50 for scooters all day, €6 for cars. 20 min walk to reach the beach. Easy walk but I recommend trainers. Bring water and food because the beach is of no use. Arm yourself with a camera and mask and fins. And enjoy it! Please note that you now have to book your visit to the beach online for limited entry. Happy holiday!

reviews.title: Bellissima ma..
reviews.text: beautiful beach, reachable on foot through the nature reserve. crystal clear water and white beach. It's a shame that starting from July 15th, access to Spiaggia dei Conigli is only permitted in limited numbers and upon mandatory free online reservation. which is also good for protecting the environment, but those who have booked holidays will not find a place to access it due to the countless reservations

reviews.title: Spiaggia paradiso
reviews.text: Lampedusa offers spectacular nature, every corner of the island an explosion of colours, perfumes and breathtaking views but the rabbit beach is a true paradise of beauty that leaves you breathless

reviews.title: Una riserva naturale, tappa imperdibile
reviews.text: Nature reserve managed impeccably by volunteers. Be careful of any transgression of the regulations: smoking ban and absolute ban on water games, football, Frisbees, rackets. A beach of very fine sand, wonderful colours, the sound of the sea to lull the senses.  The turquoise of the pristine body of water is lost in the blue on the horizon, Rabbit Island is truly a fascinating place to enjoy for as long as possible. It is advisable to arrive early in the morning and rent (at the very affordable price of 5 euros for the whole day with a 10 euro deposit) an umbrella to be placed carefully as sometimes the wind whips the beach forcefully. Splendid photos in the morning and on the way back...the reserve closes at 7.30pm.

reviews.title: Riserva naturale meravigliosa
reviews.text: A lot of effort but it's worth it 🤩After a long walk of about 15/20 minutes you arrive at the truly beautiful but crowded nature reserve. With zero services (bring the umbrella that they give you at the entrance before going down at a cost of €5.00 for the whole day which must be brought back to get back the deposit left of €15.00). The water is crystal clear but there aren't even any bins or toilets, so you have to bring water and food and take the rubbish back with you. The experience is truly unique and worth doing but when you come back up you will regret having done it for a few moments!

reviews.title: la piu' bella del mondo
reviews.text: Without exaggerating from my experience of 20 years of travel, I think that this beach is among the most beautiful in the world that I have visited so far, passing the Maldives and Punta Matira of Bora Bora. Arriving from the top you can enjoy a panorama that will take your breath away. The sand is very fine and the water is very transparent with lots of little fish swimming around you. It is very crowded, we arrived immediately at 8.30 but we waited 20 minutes in line to get there. pay for the parking (his wife and children meanwhile went down to take the place). I recommend that you don't go off the marked routes, we respect nature and keep the beach clean. It's a shame that you only saw it once, I recommend coming after 2pm as there is a turnover of people. The number one beach in Lampedusa, if you see it first, all the others will seem "ugly".

reviews.title: meglio che nelle foto
reviews.text: you can't describe a beach and a sea like this.... you can only experience it and get excited, the effort of getting there on foot easily justifies the satisfaction upon arrival

reviews.title: Da vedere con pazienza ...
reviews.text: A must see: beautiful. 15 minute walk down. Opens at 8.30am and closes at 7pm. Unequipped beach (umbrellas can be rented above for 5 euros).  Scooters can be parked on the street (0.70 euros per hour, 3.50 euros for the whole day).   The bar is only upstairs, nothing on the beach. Be patient because there are a lot of people on the beach.

reviews.title: Imperdibile
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world, only by visiting it can you realize its natural beauty

reviews.title: Caraibi in Italia
reviews.text: Beautiful beach to say the least. Incredible colors and seabed with many fish already on the shore. Crystal clear waters. The best of the view can be enjoyed from above on the way down. Umbrella rental service (more than necessary) on the road before going down. Cost €5 + €10 deposit. Cost of parking per day, car 7.50, scooter 3.5. Crowded beach but there is still space to be found. Volunteers present by Lega Ambiente. Descent not difficult, about 25 minutes long, uphill. terrible due to the heat. You need to get there early, this morning I was there at 8.30 and the beach was already well occupied but I still found a nice place. Nothing to envy of the much advertised Caribbean beaches, I saw the Sardinian and Sicilian ones and this can easily be counted among the most beautiful. Worth a visit

reviews.title: Paradisoooo
reviews.text: Fabulous...with colors that leave you speechless......it feels like being in a paradise that leaves you speechless....

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: A huge open-air swimming pool, incredible water. It can be reached via a downhill path, which requires a minimum of effort to climb back up in the afternoon under the sun, but the place is absolutely worth it. Tip: you have to go early in the morning (it opens at 8.30am) otherwise it will get too crowded

reviews.title: Da vedere
reviews.text: It definitely deserves to be seen; then probably the greater or lesser enthusiasm also depends on taste. The beach is made up of very fine sand, so setting up the rental umbrella on days of strong wind is not so easy and this ruined the experience a bit for us. On the other hand, many people left after fighting the wind and umbrella for a few hours, so there was more space for us. This year, even in June, there were a lot of people; I think they should communicate between the beach and the road so as not to let other people get off when it's already filled up, also because many have no respect for the area that would be prohibited and settle there too. The water is crystal clear and shallow for hundreds of metres, a paradise for children. People who are a bit of a bear like me will be a little annoyed by the amount of people taking selfies and ridiculous photoshoots in the water, but these are the times we live in, and we're okay with it.

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: Alone, it's worth the stay in Lampedusa. In June I think it's livable after I don't know. We arrived at 8:45 and we were in the third row. 1/4 of the beach would be closed at the moment due to falling stones but obviously it's a certain time and after the usable part is full people get there and everything becomes full. People continue to go down but not through fault but I think that from above they should stop the flow after a while. The descent takes a bit of time, it's not that demanding but there's room for someone. little alternation and thanks to the heat it makes it difficult. There is a certain change around 1pm, those who can't resist leave and there is some space for those who arrive in the afternoon

reviews.title: L'essenza dell'isola
reviews.text: Every tourist comes to Lampedusa to see it. 1st in Europe and Italy and 8th in the world among beaches. I have traveled a lot all over the world and I think it is splendid and absolutely worth seeing, then the ranking is relative and is affected by everyone's travel experiences.

reviews.title: Ottima dalla barca
reviews.text: As I wrote above, the best thing to do is to visit this beach from the sea. Going onto the beach from the designated path, probably if it is not in May or late September, from 9.30 in the morning you are literally trampled by the crowd on the beach.

reviews.title: Faticoso ma meraviglioso
reviews.text: You will be amazed once you arrive after a moderately demanding route. But the trick is not to tackle it at peak hours

reviews.title: Paradiso terrestre
reviews.text: Rabbit Island is certainly to be counted among the best Italian beaches. It is a natural paradise, where you can relax on a sandy beach and bathe in crystal clear waters. It is not advisable to reach this beach on foot, since it is quite far from the city center. The reserve has paid parking for cars and motorbikes and also a few free parking spaces. Since this is a very popular place especially in the months of July and August, it is advisable to arrive at the opening time of the reserve (around 8:30 in the morning). Once accessed, the road to the beach is quite steep and completely exposed. Equip yourself with comfortable shoes and water because the temperature will be very high. After about 20 minutes of walking, the sight of the shades of blue of the water will make you forget any fatigue. Unmissable place!

reviews.title: Spettacolo della natura
reviews.text: A wonderful place that can be easily reached by taking about 15 minutes along a marked and easy route. Colors of the sea and particular vegetation. Worth visiting.

reviews.title: Da non perdere
reviews.text: I visited this corner of paradise, starting from the center of Lampedusa (Via Roma area) using the shuttle, ticket purchased on board for €1, there is a stop right at the beginning of the road that leads to the beach. At the beginning of the street there is also a well-stocked bar with services. From the main road to reach the beach you have to travel along a dirt road for about 15-20 minutes, sneakers are recommended. During the route, breathtaking views are guaranteed. Just before arriving at the beautiful beach you can see Domenico Modugno's villa on the right. I haven't tried it but it must certainly be spectacular to reach the beach by sea.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: An open-air paradise. Clean beach, clear sea and wonderful colors. Very fine sand. It can be reached in 15 minutes on foot. Worth seeing!

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: Beautiful beach that lives up to its fame. The sea of ​​a thousand colors is wonderful. It's wonderful to swim surrounded by fish

reviews.title: prima visita da fare a Lampedusa
reviews.text: we were there in June 2021 still with non-mass tourism. the beach has no services but it is beautiful. You cannot get there by boat because it is prohibited by the environmental league for the protection of turtles, they say.

reviews.title: Non è assolutamente la più bella d’Italia
reviews.text: Beautiful but not beautiful in Sardinia there are better ones and not as overcrowded as this ... experience never to be repeated again

reviews.title: Gita fantastica!
reviews.text: A spectacle of nature!!! Beautiful beach with sea colors that are enchanting! Maybe just a few too many people, I would limit access to keep it that way!

reviews.title: Che direeeee
reviews.text: I consider it the most beautiful beach in Italy. Water so transparent only in the Maldives. The only thing could be better was the journey down

reviews.title: Fantastica
reviews.text: Beautiful. Absolutely worth visiting at least once. The beach is beautiful with the enchanting sea. However, not everyone knows that the island is closed to tourists and cannot even be reached by swimming. The return though... what an effort 😝

reviews.title: Bellezza indescrivibile
reviews.text: Literally MALDIVES. I think I have never seen a more beautiful beach than this one in Italy. Now I understand why Domenico Modugno called it "God's swimming pool"

reviews.title: Lampedusa e isola di Conigli e unica
reviews.text: I am Venezuelan Sicilian and I say with all honor the best beach in the world is this. The Roques archipelago is paradise.

reviews.title: Ineffabile.
reviews.text: There are no words, photographs or videos to describe the place. From the Belvedere you can only be grateful for having had life and sight. Since the place does not fall within the sphere of the human world and perhaps not even the divine one, the sensations it transmits cannot be described. The only advice I allow myself to offer is to go to Conigli beach at the end of your life, because, once seen, no other beauty will be able to amaze.O 'Shah.

reviews.title: Bagno a novembre
reviews.text: Fabulous beach, crystal clear water, despite visiting in November the water was still warm, excellent experience,

reviews.title: Un paradiso
reviews.text: Absolutely worth seeing! A spectacular sea, for those who love snorkeling I suggest bringing a mask and fins and going close to the rocks. It is not an equipped beach so equip yourself with an umbrella, towels and above all food and water. Go early because the number of people is limited and the entrances could close within an hour. BEAUTIFUL!!!!

reviews.title: Spiaggia paradisiaca
reviews.text: Unique place in the world impossible to imitate. We have some under-appreciated beauties. My husband and I had a great time

reviews.title: Immensa è bella anche a novembre
reviews.text: I live on the island, I chose to live there all year round because I fell in love with this rock! working during the summer season I can't enjoy such beauty but it seems that she waits and gives endless emotions even in autumn... November 12th full summer, wonderful water, temperature 28/30 degrees!

reviews.title: il posto piu' bello del mondo!!!
reviews.text: there are no words to describe the beauty... when you go down, paradise suddenly appears, a magical place, magnificent water

reviews.title: Una certezza
reviews.text: Splendid beach within a nature reserve. The view from the rock amphitheater that surrounds it is wonderful.

reviews.title: "Il paradiso "
reviews.text: "UNIQUE beach!!! There is no comparison, and it is certainly the jewel in the crown of the island of LAMPEDUSA. Even if it is always crowded, just entering the water is enough to forget and not feel the hundreds of people lying on the sand behind you. A sensation that only those who experience it can describe. And certainly even the simple descent and arriving at the view of the beach from above is a wonderful experience, a heart sinking! I wish everyone to experience all of this at least once!!!! Paradise exists.

reviews.title: Che dire....
reviews.text: The immense, the infinite.....The arrival is not difficult at all A walk that makes you lose your eyes

reviews.title: L’ottava meraviglia
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I have ever seen.... to reach it you have to travel about 20 minutes through the middle of the reserve. Once you arrive in front of Rabbit Island, the sight you see will take your breath away.

reviews.title: la piu bella
reviews.text: Returning after fifteen years, I found it improved, with a comfortable path delimited for a safe descent to the sea. I highly recommend visiting it in the low season to enjoy it to the fullest.

reviews.title: Posto strabiliante
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful places I have ever seen.... Absolutely crazy. You swim among the fish, turquoise water. Once you enter the water you never want to get out

reviews.title: Il top in Italia
reviews.text: I would have liked to spend all my days here, but the rest of Lampedusa is also worth it! Never seen in Italy so much marine beauty, clear water even with deep seabed. However, there was little free space on the beach despite it being a weekday in mid-October!!!

reviews.title: meravigliosa!!!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach!!! You have to walk a bit to get there but it's worth it...the most beautiful in Lampedusa...nothing to envy of the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean!!!!

reviews.title: Splendida, ma...
reviews.text: The beach is enchanting, the path that leads to it is well maintained, the sea has crystal clear and very clean water and normally, when you go into the water, you are surrounded by fish that do not seem to fear man. A part of the beach is delimited by ropes fixed to posts: numerous signs prohibit going beyond the ropes. These are stretches of beach that caretta caretta turtles prefer for laying their eggs. Despite this, many tourists climb over the ropes and lie down calmly in the sun, indifferent to the prohibitions. There are those who come to pitch tents and umbrellas. We know well that incivility and lack of respect for rules and animals are unfortunately very widespread; It makes us indignant that no one takes action on the merits by sanctioning transgressors. It is useless and ridiculous to write the rules if they are not observed!

reviews.title: Magnifica
reviews.text: What can I say, the most photographed, beautiful and famous... obviously unmissable. 15' walk, uphill a little steep but nothing special.

reviews.title: Il paradiso in terra
reviews.text: .. Seeing is believing.... a wonder of the world... One of the most beautiful beaches if not the most beautiful I have ever seen!!! Fish swimming right next to the. shore... very clean water, breathtaking landscape... TO Keep in mind that the dirt road descends for about a quarter of an hour and very importantly requires trekking shoes or tennis shoes, the only lunch stand is at the top as soon as you park. PAYMENT scooter parking. I highly recommend it to everyone!!!

reviews.title: SPETTACOLARE!
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, crystal clear water and breathtaking colours. I recommend arriving at the opening to choose where to settle. If you go to Lampedusa it is mandatory to visit this beach!

reviews.title: Visita in giormata
reviews.text: Paid car parking: €7.5 per day or €1.5%h. We are activated at 9.45 and half the beach was already full of people; the other half was delimited by a rope and signs prohibiting access due to the danger of falling rocks from the coast above. At 11.30 even the forbidden part of the beach was overcrowded with tourists. However, the beach is beautiful and has surreal colours. As an experience, I recommend visiting the small bay on the left side of the island with respect to Conigli beach itself, crossing the tiny inlet (it is only half a meter high and you have to crawl into it while swimming) which can be glimpsed about ten meters from the end of the island (towards the coast).

reviews.title: Unica
reviews.text: What can I say....? The most beautiful beach on the island. I hope people have more and more respect for it.

reviews.title: Quando la vedi te ne innamori
reviews.text: I haven't yet come across a person who hasn't been enraptured by this pearl. Crystal clear waters, very fine sand, while you are in the water you are surrounded by fish... wonderful, unique

reviews.title: Una delle più belle spiagge del mondo
reviews.text: The view from above of Conigli beach, the first time you reach the end of the path, leaves you breathless due to the impact of the beauty and the colors that fill your eyes. Also reachable by mountain bike from the town if you are fit with cardio (by bike then you won't even have to pay for parking), the beach is obviously a protected area and therefore it is imperative to take care of this oasis of wonder. Smoking is obviously prohibited on the beach. From the road there is a downhill path, sometimes unpaved and sometimes with steps. I recommend sneakers if you don't have full mastery of flip-flops. At the top of the path, on the road, the Blue Oasis offers breakfasts, lunches and aperitifs and also umbrella rental.

reviews.title: unica!
reviews.text: Even if you've already been there it's still a spectacle!!! The shades of color and the sea that looks like a swimming pool are dazzlingly beautiful.

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: Difficult to describe, you have to go there. In mid-September it is crowded but you don't need to arrive at 8.30 like in August. An area would be closed due to the risk of falling rocks but people go there anyway. I absolutely advise you to go up and down wearing trainers, the route is not very easy but nothing difficult unless you live on the sofa for 11 months a year. Paid parking (the only one on the island) 3.5 euros for scooters, 7.5 euros for cars or payment by the hour. The only kiosk is on the street near the entrance and they also rent umbrellas.

reviews.title: Quella bella
reviews.text: Like every year for 20 years now, we have been advised to go swimming and I must admit that for us at least this is the most beautiful beach in the world... what else can I say... to see at least once in a lifetime

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, a wonderful sea surrounded by nature. Crystal clear water and white sand are very reminiscent of the Caribbean. It's just a shame that the descent is a bit tiring but it's worth it.

reviews.title: Ti piace vincere facile?
reviews.text: 5 stars are few, it is the most beautiful beach in the world. 20 minute path to get there, arrive early in the morning (8:00) to enjoy the view alone. Equip yourself with everything, there is nothing down there. But when you arrive, you will notice the best sea in the world. Every effort will be worth the show!

reviews.title: Oltre le aspettative
reviews.text: I recommend arriving at 8, parking and paying 7.50 for the whole day at the stand, taking an umbrella (if you don't have one) at a cost of 5 euros (you need to leave a deposit of 10 euros which will be refunded) and wait for them to open at 8.30. Follow the path (trainers or Birkenstock-type flip-flops are recommended). It will take about 20 minutes to reach this breath-taking beach with its soft white sand, the colors of the sea and sky and the peace that will welcome you. Enjoy the day. Bring food and drinks because the only refreshment point is at the beginning of the path. A true paradise

reviews.title: The Best Beach in the Mediterranean Sea (Italian island, Africa island on geographic point of view)
reviews.text: The best beach of the island by far, but also the busiest one. By walk it takes about 15 minutes from the street down to go there. It opens at 8.30.If it is constantly rated the best beach in 'Europe' it must be a reason!The water and colour of the sand are so unique. Speechless.Lampedusa has also the advantage of having a convenient airport to travel from Catania or Palermo, and the norther airports on summer time.

reviews.title: Bellissima come sempre
reviews.text: Now accustomed to the place... This beach is always enchanting as if it were the first time. Try it to believe it :)

reviews.title: Bella ma quanta genteeeeee
reviews.text: A uniquely beautiful beach But it should be managed with a limited number of people. You can't see crazy sun umbrellas, like Rimini.

reviews.title: Una bellezza rara
reviews.text: To access the beach you walk along a path for about 20 minutes, let's say 30 uphill, but the walk is rewarded by the wonder of the beach and the colors of the sea, transparent and full of fish. Highly recommended and preferably go early in the morning to choose the place by the sea.

reviews.title: SPETTACOLARE
reviews.text: What can I say... one of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen! Crystal clear water, fine and clear sand. Spectacular to watch the sea bream swimming in the sea close to the swimmers. It takes a quarter of an hour to reach it but it's absolutely worth it. Few services but this is the best way to enjoy the beach in all its wild magnificence.

reviews.title: Senza parole
reviews.text: Very busy beach where it is recommended to arrive early to find a place. To reach it you have to park on the street (paid parking which requires the inclusion of the license plate in the ticket) and you have to go down a not very easy path. Fine white sand and crystal clear water repay the effort made. Absolutely worth seeing

reviews.title: La piscina di Dio
reviews.text: A magical beach, which instills unique sensations... from the Belvedere the view is breathtaking. Too bad it's crowded but it's absolutely worth a visit

reviews.title: UNO SPETTACOLO......
reviews.text: It's a spectacle, right from the first terrace where you can see it from afar, then as you go down despite the somewhat bumpy road you find yourself in front of a wonderful scenery, the sea of ​​various shades, it looks like a mirror, the only flaw if I can find it is that there are too many people who have access to it, at a certain point you can't see the beach anymore because it's covered with towels....but in any case when you enter the water it's a real spectacle....worth trying.....

reviews.title: Paradisiaco
reviews.text: Crystal clear waters and very clean sea Natural landscapes I recommend it to those who love to experience uncontaminated nature

reviews.title: incanto
reviews.text: Words cannot describe the enchantment of this place... Crystal clear sea, Caribbean sand.. breathtaking colors.. A paradise for those who love the sea..

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: A truly beautiful beach, the only flaw is the route you have to walk, about forty minutes downhill. The biggest problem is the ascent. There is no refreshment point on the beach. I recommend bringing something to eat and drink.

reviews.title: La più bella
reviews.text: It is certainly the most beautiful beach in Lampedusa. An incredible sea. White beach with crystal clear water. The only advice is that I would limit access to avoid overcrowding. But it's definitely worth it.

reviews.title: Spettacolo della Natura!!
reviews.text: A fantastic beach! Had a fantastic day in this spectacle of nature with my family! Highly recommended!

reviews.title: I Caraibi in Italia
reviews.text: If it was voted the most beautiful beach in Europe, well there must be a reason. We arrived at Spiaggia dei Conigli full of expectations, which fortunately were not disappointed. The twenty minute walk to reach the beach is not difficult (I have always done it with flip flops, no difficulty). The view from the top is absolutely spectacular. Before arriving at the beach you can admire the old house of Domenico Modugno (which overlooks this paradise). Bring an umbrella and food for the whole day because they will be needed. There are no refreshment points (except the one in the car park). Don't forget your mask or goggles, the underwater landscape is wonderful. Lots of fish, of various species, then urchins, crabs... in short, a real Eden for those who love snorkeling. The only sore point is that the walk taken downhill in the morning will have to be done uphill again in the afternoon. It becomes challenging and a little tiring. But don't let that scare you. It's absolutely worth it! Rabbit beach will win you over!

reviews.title: paradiso tropicale
reviews.text: I have always considered the Mediterranean Sea to be the most beautiful sea in the world, for its villages, culture and history. food and wine and the beauty of the coasts and islands. The rabbit beach is the best, it competes with the best Greek, Salento, Menorcan, Corsican and Sardinian beaches but it also has spectacular seabeds and fish fauna, not only groupers and starfish but fish with bright colors and in such quantity that they seem like an open-air aquarium, the fact that there are no bathing establishments, boats and that the beach is as fine as talcum powder makes it perhaps the most beautiful beach in the entire Mediterranean

reviews.title: Meraviglia della natura!
reviews.text: Spectacular, there are no words to describe it. It alone is worth the trip to Lampedusa. Beautiful beach, crazy water. The beach is not very large, part of it is not accessible and access is limited, so it is advisable to go early, even if during the day we went some people were leaving, so others arrived and entered in the afternoon. There is paid parking on the street (for scooters, €3.50 all day). To reach the beach there is about a 10 minute walk downhill, but the route is well done. The bar is located on the street so either you take something to the beach, or then you have to go back up for food/bathing.

reviews.title: Spettacolare!
reviews.text: Absolutely worth visiting... wear a hat because the route is completely under the sun but it is definitely worth it! Beautiful, beautiful, beautiful!

reviews.title: Una meraviglia
reviews.text: We managed to catch a day where the beach was not very crowded even though at 8.20 there was already a crazy queue to enter. The sooner you leave, the better.  A true spectacle of nature, a walk of about 20 minutes to get down, wonderful water, it looks like a swimming pool. We left our hearts there. The beach is not equipped. There is the possibility of renting an umbrella at the kiosk before going down. Parking for the scooter at €3.50 for the whole day. A real show.

reviews.title: Troppa gente
reviews.text: I haven't been there except on the boat, but my traveling companions complained about too many people!!!

reviews.title: Spiaggia
reviews.text: Beautiful beach to be safeguarded, thank goodness that smoking is prohibited in all the coves of the island 🚭

reviews.title: Spettacolo
reviews.text: The beach and the islet are a spectacle of nature. Stunning colours, let's remember that it is a nature reserve with maximum attention to the environment!

reviews.title: bellissima!!!
reviews.text: in August it was poorly managed due to the safety distance regarding Covid-19. For the rest, the beach and sea were beautiful

reviews.title: Un paradiso
reviews.text: Having stayed in Lampedusa for two weeks we managed to visit this splendid beach twice. My advice to fully enjoy the day is to arrive around 8 in the morning and queue to get the coupon to apply to the car or scooter. In fact, parking costs €3.50 for scooters. There is the possibility of renting an umbrella for €5, giving a deposit of €10, as the Spiaggia dei Conigli is not equipped. At 8:30 they open the passage to go down to the beach and you walk along a dirt path for about 15 minutes. The sea is clean with a vast marine fauna and a very wide beach. I highly recommend going there.

reviews.title: Un must se si va a Lampedusa
reviews.text: The place is enchanting from its natural and landscape aspects, it is not for nothing that a few years ago it was defined as the most beautiful beach in the world! The organization of Lega Ambiente proves necessary for its protection. The flaw is the abundant tourist presence that inevitably flocks to the best-known attraction of Lampedusa. You have to go there to appreciate the out-of-place beauty but for those seeking tranquility it is not the right beach. However, it is undoubtedly worth it!

reviews.title: Isola conigli
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches you can see. It's a shame for the stupidity of many people who frequent it who don't respect the bans and it's a shame for the mayor who doesn't enforce them. To access you already have to queue at 8 in the morning. You are crowded one on top of the other, there are no safety distances despite the Covid period, areas considered dangerous with a ban, invaded by tourists. Lega Ambiente calls those responsible for an intervention and no intervention is done. An ecological disaster from every point of view. Parking for 1.5 euros per hour. If you are close to the barriers you can't see the sea at all... A shameful situation. A shame, a real shame.

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: Dream beach and sea, the Caribbean in Sicily not to be missed, remember to bring an umbrella as the sun is really strong.

reviews.title: Meraviglioso!
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Italy, (perhaps Modugno wrote "Marvelous" when he looked out the window and the enchantment lay before him). Obviously on this beach you have to arrive very early to get a seat. The route to reach it is a little tortuous and takes about 15/20 minutes. under the sun. It is possible to rent umbrellas at the bar located before the descent. I recommend drinking water. The sea is crystal clear and the sand white and soft.  A true paradise! ...Wonderful..what gifts they gave you: they invented the sea....

reviews.title: La spiaggia più grande
reviews.text: Definitely the largest and most beautiful beach in Lampedusa, you need to arrive early, especially in August, to secure a place, parking on the street is paid, you pay at a stand near the bar at the entrance, you go down a path with steps but it can be done in about a quarter of an hour, the sand is clear and the water crystal clear, you can get to the rabbit island on foot, the bottom is all sand and the water reaches waist height. Definitely a reference place for holidays in Lampedusa.

reviews.title: La più bella di Lampedusa
reviews.text: Splendid beach, reachable on foot with a journey of about 15 minutes. Wonderful sea which, when calm, allows you to reach the rabbit island in front. Obviously crowded, so it is best to be there at 8.30, when the beach is open. Lampedusa nature reserve.

reviews.title: Semplicemente fantastica
reviews.text: View from the sea by boat, enchanting landscape. We got there by swimming from allamoarca with fins and mask: super seabed, super sea....

reviews.title: L'isola che non ti aspetti
reviews.text: Every year I travel around the world for a week but I always come back to Lampedusa for a week. The rabbits? Number one ever and we have it under our noses, let's hope they don't asphalt it with wild tourism

reviews.title: la più bella d'italia  e .. forse del mondo ..
reviews.text: unique, wonderful, magical, unforgettable...a wonder of nature, when you look out you are stunned even if it is crowded...I imagine what it might have been like in the 60's when Modugno had just bought the villa...it's a shame that to reach it you need a walk of about a quarter of an hour...which becomes a bit tiring on the way back up, the vegetation that accompanies the walk is beautiful and the water is indescribable both for its color and temperature the bay enclosed by the two promontories is photonic, better seen from above than from the sea. for me the best in Italy and perhaps in the world..

reviews.title: Tutti ammassati, nessuna distanza
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful just like in the photos that advertise it. It's a shame that they don't tell you that there is a 10 minute walk downhill on the way there and uphill on the way back (with an umbrella in tow because they don't rent them downstairs) which isn't a walk in the park. Everyone crowded together, no one respects distances despite Covid! But this depends a lot on the managers who should reach a maximum entrance limit, but instead they sit there doing nothing.

reviews.title: La più bella di Lampedusa
reviews.text: Beautiful and wide white beach! You can get there with a descent of about 10 minutes on foot, with a very beautiful and panoramic view! Suitable for everyone! It is not equipped so either you go early in the morning to take a seat or after 3pm it gets quite empty! Clear and beautiful sea. It deserves it!

reviews.title: Lo spettacolo della natura
reviews.text: What can I say...the most beautiful beach on the whole island! It is a natural reserve therefore devoid of any kind of service which fortunately we find above as soon as we arrive. I recommend bringing food and an umbrella from home if you don't want to spend anything, otherwise before starting the descent towards the beach (15 minutes) the delicatessen has everything and will even rent you an umbrella for only 5 euros. Parking is paid, we with the scooter for the whole day spent 3.50... excellent! There are some “stray” dogs that will want to share some of your shade, it can be a bit annoying after a while because they park themselves there and don't move anymore!

reviews.title: Una delle spiagge più belle d' Italia
reviews.text: This beach is truly beautiful, wonderful colours, sea full of lots of little fish, ideal for those who love snorkelling. It's best to go early in the morning because unfortunately it fills up easily.

reviews.title: Spiaggia da favola invasa dai turisti
reviews.text: The beach is a marvel. Unfortunately, however, it was invaded by hordes of swimmers despite social distancing! Umbrellas everywhere, even where there are signs warning of rockfall... They should make access limited and limited in number... It's no surprise that the turtles haven't nested for more than four years... Tourists who feed chips to the fish... others who sneak into the garden of Modugno's former house... Legambiente has now lost control and it's a real shame.

reviews.title: Paradiso mediterraneo
reviews.text: Nothing more beautiful in the Mediterranean! Beach with very white and soft sand, crystal clear water and a quantity and variety of fish that I had never found in the Mediterranean. The only flaw, a little crowded in the high season.

reviews.title: La più bella del mondo
reviews.text: Even though there is a 20 minute walk downhill, it is a splendor like perhaps few in the world. At least once in your life you have to go.

reviews.title: Una favola
reviews.text: Fabulous place Lampedusa is a wonderful island especially for couples and for those who love the sea for those who just want to have fun I recommend changing your stage

reviews.title: Stupenda come sempre
reviews.text: Number 1 beach in Italy, even if too crowded. Crazy colors. Paid parking €7.50 for cars and €3.50 for motorbikes.

reviews.title: La più bella del mondo?
reviews.text: I don't know if it is the most beautiful beach in Italy and the fourth in the world, but it is a fantastic place and experiencing it from the house in Modugno was the best

reviews.title: Bella ma...non andateci con lo scirocco.
reviews.text: The beach is wonderful even if unfortunately you have to leave your car and motorbike in the paid parking (7.5 euros for the whole day, otherwise 1.5 euros an hour) and then walk 800 meters along a stone-paved path under the sun on foot. Naturally, being one of the most famous attractions on the island, it is overcrowded and there is only a trace of social distancing due to Covid in the large hanging signs that remind you of the rules. In any case, wonderful colors and white sand in a cove worth taking away breath.

reviews.title: Riccione in Paradiso
reviews.text: I give only one star only for the fact that, despite being in a protected area, the site is absolutely not controlled and access is not monitored at all. We therefore find ourselves in hundreds of people, almost one on top of the other, making this wonderful experience absolutely unliveable. I left after only an hour, despite the effort to get there, because it was definitely overcrowded.

reviews.title: Un isola da sogno
reviews.text: I was there more than 30 years ago and it was a fabulous beach!!! Getting there from above and seeing that view is a memory that will remain indelible in my beautiful memory...... breathtaking!!! And then on the beach there was the turtle nest which was obviously fenced and protected!!! Wonderful Lampedusa and the people of Lampedusa are wonderful!! ❤️

reviews.title: Bella ma.....
reviews.text: We visited this beach several times in the first week of September, the colors are beautiful but too, too crowded, you will find yourself in the middle of a crowd of people who do not care about the prohibitions and distances, ready to do anything to grab a place. They should limit access to a limited number!

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: A paradise, fantastic explosion of colours, undoubtedly the most beautiful sea in the world, sandy seabed suitable for everyone, fish swimming up to the shore seems like bathing in a natural aquarium

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: And once you've seen it, you understand why it's the most beautiful beach in Europe! It's true, it takes a bit of walking and the beach isn't equipped, but that's also the beauty of it! The walk isn't anything impossible, I did it in flip flops. Better to go in the afternoon!

reviews.title: Un must a Lampedusa
reviews.text: The beach is fabulous but in my opinion entry should be limited to truly appreciate it. Access to the beach is easy and well maintained

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: A wonderful lagoon to visit. Easier route than they say. A little too many people but absolutely not to be missed

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Paradise beach, the most beautiful in Italy in my opinion with white sand and fantastic sea. I recommend it to anyone

reviews.title: Vacanza
reviews.text: If you go to Lampedusa you cannot miss going to the rabbit beach, to get there you have to take a small piece of dirt road which may seem tiring.... but when you arrive you are left speechless by the beauty of the sea and the beach... transparent water and you swim among fish.... it feels like being in the Caribbean but with only 2 hours by plane....

reviews.title: Bellissima e unica, semplicemente.
reviews.text: For me it is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, with all due respect to the Caribbean and the Maldives, which however I have never visited. In summer I recommend going in the afternoon after 5.30pm and for various reasons: 1) you don't pay for parking on the street; 2) there are much fewer people and it is quieter; 3) there are some fantastic colors; 4) you don't roast in the sun, since the beach is not equipped and you have to bring your own umbrella; 5) it takes much less effort to get there, because it is less hot and you have to walk a good kilometer to get down to the beach. However it is worth it in any case.

reviews.title: Vista panoramica
reviews.text: Very suggestive "Maldivian" sea. I recommend going in the morning before 10 because then it fills up

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: The nature of this beach is stunning the walk (with flip flops the climb is a bit difficult) it became pleasant with the mistral wind a bit too crowded the crystal sea fresh water in this period seems like paradise

reviews.title: Meraviglioso
reviews.text: We were lucky enough to catch the right wind... we stayed in the water all day, we had the impression of bathing in an aquarium...

reviews.title: Paradisiaco!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach. Unfortunately too many tourists. It should be preserved. The walk is much easier than what they describe in complete safety

reviews.title: Una perla
reviews.text: Simply wonderful! By land, a maximum of 250 entries are allowed at the moment, so it's best to go early. There is about a 5-10min walk from the road to the beach. Absolutely doable even in flip flops (sneakers were recommended to us). Perhaps challenging if there are high temperatures and little or no wind. It can also be easily reached by swimming from the boat (which in any case must be moored beyond the buoys, since it is a nature reserve). An unmissable spectacle of nature.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in Italy. Crystal clear water, fish, nature. Nothing else to add. Well done to the guys from Lega Ambiente who discreetly monitor the observance of a few rules that should be taken for granted, such as not trampling on the vegetation at the edge of the beach

reviews.title: Che meraviglia
reviews.text: Beautiful, beautiful beach, it's worth it, it's a 15-minute descent from a well-maintained mule track and a few more minutes for the ascent. Lega environment, in addition to monitoring, you could do something about mass access, I found the whole of humanity!!!!

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: An open-air paradise... Incredible colors that I had never seen... If you don't go there in person you won't believe it. Go and you will see.

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: I was born and raised in a place by the sea, and for me holidays are the sea... I couldn't choose any other destination... I've seen enough seaside places and I thought I'd seen some beautiful ones but then she arrives... Rabbit Beach... you walk... you walk... looking for her, something that before you saw you thought you'd seen dozens and dozens of times... but that's not the case... you've never seen a place like this and it's so beautiful that you can't believe it part with it when you leave. I don't think the words would always be too banal in the face of its magnificence. Goodbye Lampedusa

reviews.title: Semplicemente emozionante!
reviews.text: Sea that leaves its mark, where the shades of blue multiply up to the horizon. Swimming to the other side of the island is a heavenly experience! Convenient downhill path (lasting about 15 minutes), to be done in the cooler hours on the way up (but still doable). Crowded beach, I recommend settling on the rocks at the bottom. Scooter and car parking available both by the hour and for the whole day. Refreshment area at the entrance.

reviews.title: Vacanza 2020
reviews.text: Breathtaking beach and sea in the true sense of the word. The approximately 20 minute walk to reach it paid off in a big way. With the spectacle being enjoyed I would walk under the sun for hours. Be careful, the sea on Rabbit Island is addictive. You won't want to leave anymore. The photos don't do it justice, they are liars. It's much prettier in person.

reviews.title: La più bella !
reviews.text: If you go to Lampedusa you cannot fail to visit it at least once. It is the most beautiful beach on the island, in Sicily, in the South and I would even venture in Italy. As soon as you see it when you look out after having done 15-20 minutes of descent, that view satisfies the effort made: white beach with very fine sand, water so crystal clear that it looks like a swimming pool and the echoing seagulls that glide over the water perform a sort of dance. The water is very shallow for several meters and gives even those who don't know how to swim the opportunity to stay calm and enjoy the coolness. I recommend bringing an umbrella even to those who intend to stay for only a few hours as there are no bars or refreshment areas on the beach as it is a nature reserve.

reviews.title: Da togliere il fiato
reviews.text: As beautiful as they say, a little crowded but in August I'd say it's fine. The path to reach the beach is feasible and well indicated, but it's important to get water and an umbrella before going down. A paradise on earth!

reviews.title: Un paradiso
reviews.text: The rabbit beach is always an excellent reason to get up early and set off along the path. It is always full but the beauty of the sea goes beyond everything Lampedusa is waiting to be discovered...

reviews.title: Una sola parola: divina
reviews.text: Wonderful beach with its contours. Half an hour to get there on foot but mandatory stop in Lampedusa. Unfortunately very crowded for these reasons.

reviews.title: Il meglio, il mare che ti lascia a bocca aperta
reviews.text: Simply wow, it's hard to understand whether it's the sea or the pool. Accessible to all, the return climb is a little tiring but it's worth it

reviews.title: Da sogno
reviews.text: The best beach in Lampedusa. Short but steep walk to get there but really worth it.

reviews.title: Ineguagliabile.
reviews.text: I don't like long reviews. The Rabbit Beach in Lampedusa is the best you can find on the face of the Earth. Clear, fine sand, crystal clear sea, fish of numerous species floating calmly and chasing each other while dancing. And not far away is the rabbit island. All in an amazing geological context.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: It is difficult to find words to describe the wonder of Conigli beach. To reach it you have to walk for about twenty minutes, and the walk allows you to enjoy an incredible landscape: you see the colors of the sea like you've never seen, and a beautiful landscape. And when you arrive on the beach, you can enjoy very fine sand and crystal clear, super transparent water. The only problem is the ascent. But I followed the advice of a local: I went around 4pm, and if you go back around 6/6.30pm the temperature is acceptable

reviews.title: Altro che Maldive!!
reviews.text: I was in the Maldives this winter and I have to admit that the rabbit beach beats them 10 to 0... heavenly!!

reviews.title: Il Paradiso
reviews.text: I honestly believe that the award of the most beautiful beach in the world is fully deserved. When you arrive on the balcony overlooking the island and the beach your heart will open before the surprising colors that you will be lucky enough to see. You will hear that in August it is crowded, that you have to go early and many other things. Obviously in August there are a lot of people, obviously if there were fewer it would be better, but still ask yourself where you saw those colors and then everything will pass by

reviews.title: PARADISO
reviews.text: Wonderful place and the 15 minute walk to reach it is worth it. Enchanted place with crystal clear water (the pools are dirtier). An umbrella is recommended although you can rent it in the refreshment area and sun cream. Once you get to the beach there are no services! I won't add anything else because there are no words to describe such beauty!!!

reviews.title: spiaggia dei conigli
reviews.text: without words the boats fly on the crystal clear water!  If you are lucky you can spot the turtle nest protected by volunteers

reviews.title: Peggio di una discoteca. Legambiente che fa ?
reviews.text: Wonderful place, accessible without too much difficulty. I have no idea if they can assist disabled people in any way. Legambiente is present on site but in fact non-existent. No one controls the influx of swimmers onto the beach, much less the areas designated for turtles. At 11 it was impossible to lay down just the sheet, let alone the anti-Covid distances. Discussions between bathers and Legambiente workers calmly under their gazebo. When the situation was reported to them, they offered responses that were, to say the least, ridiculous and nonsensical. I regret not having called 112. A place of such beauty does not deserve this treatment. Lampedusa is a worthy location and should not be defaced in this way.

reviews.title: Che meraviglia della natura
reviews.text: A beautiful beach.. A clear sea that I have never seen anywhere else at the moment... We were truly enraptured...

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella del mondo
reviews.text: There aren't many words to describe it, I would say Breathtaking, you can't go to Lampedusa and not take a bath in the crystal clear waters of Rabbit Island

reviews.title: Vacanza
reviews.text: Rabbit Beach is an open-air swimming pool. Sneakers and a hat are required for the route. You can admire various quantities and qualities of fish there. It is among the most beautiful beaches in the world. The water is splendid, ranging from light blue to a myriad of turquoises and blues. Absolutely worth seeing with both the elderly and children, it is suitable for all ages

reviews.title: La spiaggia migliore del mondo
reviews.text: The 15 minute "path" that you have to do to get to the beach is worth doing 100 times. Crystal clear water and free beach, nature reserve.

reviews.title: Senza parole!!
reviews.text: It is impossible to remain indifferent in front of such beauty; the color of the sea is fantastic and varies according to the time....a wedding invitation for those who want to swim at breakneck speed.

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. Every time I see it it gives me different emotions and colors.

reviews.title: Caraibi ? No ! Lampedusa
reviews.text: Without words... a bit of healthy movement to get there... but it's really worth it... crystal clear water, suggestive scenery... emotions...

reviews.title: Unica vera spiaggia di Lampedusa
reviews.text: Beautiful but not in August. Worse than Rimini. It's worth going just for an hour, two photos and a trip to tabaccara.

reviews.title: Bella.....ma troppo affollata (ad Agosto)
reviews.text: We certainly couldn't enjoy the beauty of this corner of paradise due to too much crowding (a few minutes after opening in the morning the access was already closed due to having reached the limit of 300 people), so we abandoned the queue for the parking ticket and tried again a couple of days later in the afternoon around 4pm. We managed to get down but on that day the wind was not favorable, there were waves which did not allow us to admire the vaunted clarity of those waters.

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: Dream place. In August 2014 I found enough people but it was still good. To return as soon as possible

reviews.title: Must see
reviews.text: Spectacular place that undoubtedly deserves all its popularity. Be prepared for a long descent (and ascent), but it is absolutely worth it! The advice is to go in the afternoon (after 3pm), when many people have already left, because in the morning, even when it opens, there is incredible confusion. A round of applause to the volunteers who help keep this wonderful place clean!

reviews.title: Lascia a bocca aperta
reviews.text: Seeing her was an immense pleasure. A natural swimming pool, white sand and fish everywhere. It's a shame that at a certain time you have to go back up a climb that seems interminable

reviews.title: Spiaggia conigli
reviews.text: Enchanting beach and suggestive islet. The crowding in August does not allow it to be judged as it deserves. Lega Ambiente volunteers monitor and remedy the incivility of tourists. Definitely one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. 🐇🐰

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei conigli
reviews.text: Of an enchanting beauty! Don't be scared by the walk, it's not impossible, it takes about 15 minutes, but the scenery is worth a minimum of effort. The sea is simply fantastic, the beach is beautiful but impassable due to the excessive number of people... too many people, often disrespectful of the simple rules imposed by the environmental league, dampen the charm of the place a bit.

reviews.title: Unica
reviews.text: Not much to say, simply fantastic. An obligatory stop for anyone passing through Lampedusa, the only negative point is the descent, but it's worth it.

reviews.title: Spettacolo della natura
reviews.text: White sand, blue water and uncontaminated nature. Bring plenty of water and an umbrella because it's a nice walk. I recommend it in the afternoon at 2pm because there is often a quick turnover and because it is better to do the descent in the heat and the ascent in the cool around 6/7pm. Instead, those who went back up at 2/3pm were visibly tired and tired.

reviews.title: Paradiso terrestre
reviews.text: Extremely pure, transparent, crystalline, Caribbean water. Flat, calm and hypnotic sea. To reach this beach you have to face a very hard and exhausting descent on a bumpy road that is difficult to navigate, especially in flip-flops, which lasts about half an hour. But it's worth it: you will be rewarded with an exciting and authentic experience. It is advisable to go down equipped with closed shoes, water, food, umbrellas and sun cream and, above all, very early. At 9am the beach is already super crowded and there is a risk that it will be closed. Paid parking is quite expensive. There is a single refreshment point before the descent which also rents umbrellas. Definitely recommended beach and worth seeing at least once in your life!

reviews.title: Location da favola
reviews.text: A fairytale natural location, perhaps too "humanized" in recent years. To go down to the beach you have to take a path which, at rush hour and especially under the sun, is quite trying but it's worth it. Truly a fairytale location with a clean and clear sea, you will swim among lots of fish!

reviews.title: Paradiso ad occhi aperti
reviews.text: This place really has no words to describe. It is unique in the world. It's like knocking on the doors of heaven.

reviews.title: Senza uguali
reviews.text: Unparalleled beauty. It leaves you breathless with the clarity of the waters, the colors and the surrounding landscape. Be careful, however, as the nearby car parks all require a fee and there are long queues to pay. Arriving in the morning by 9 is the only way to find a place to put your towel. In any case, it absolutely must be seen

reviews.title: Unica
reviews.text: You can't miss this beach! The cost of moped parking is €3.50 per day, umbrella rental €5 for those who don't have one. Open from 8am to 7pm, there is a queue at the entrance. The reserve is protected and unique in the world!

reviews.title: Lampedusa nel cuore per questa meraviglia
reviews.text: I love Lampedusa, I love this beach where I returned years after my first visit. Always magnificent. When the sea is rough it loses its charm a little because the sea is less clear.

reviews.title: La piu’ bella del mondo
reviews.text: I have never seen a sea like this, not even in Sardinia... very clear and clean water, we spent 8 hours just soaking in the sea! There are no kiosks except at the beginning of the arduous climb so you have to bring a cool bag with you

reviews.title: Il posto più bello del pianeta
reviews.text: Awesome place! Unique water! Stunning colors! The only flaw is that when you return from holidays it makes you feel sad not to see the rabbit beach anymore! Going down that stretch on foot and then finding that view will leave you thinking for a lifetime! I fell strongly in love with that place! It leaves you breathless! It's worth going and seeing it before you die! I don't recommend going in August because of the crowds!

reviews.title: Fantastica
reviews.text: A sea in a spectacular context... unfortunately, being August it was really full of people, and the climb back up was tiring but it was worth it... an umbrella is a must!!!

reviews.title: Unica
reviews.text: Having returned after more than 10 years, I have always found it wonderful, the route down has been much improved.

reviews.title: Davvero stupenda
reviews.text: I had the shameless luck of arriving on the beach by swimming, by sea, during a boat trip. It's beautiful. View from the sea. And it's the same when walking on the shore. The water is a turquoise that takes your breath away and gives the place that magical atmosphere that characterizes it

reviews.title: Posto fantastico
reviews.text: Wonderful place, nothing to say. The only flaw: general disorder, umbrellas planted very close to each other, unbearable heat... but these are avoidable factors if you don't visit in August! 😅

reviews.title: Bellissima da vedere
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful things to see on the island, it's a pity that in August, there is no social distancing, you are all stuck together... unfortunately, services are non-existent, no bathrooms or showers. The ascent is very difficult....., those who arrive after 4pm and leave at closing time (7.30pm) have understood everything.

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: Wonderful beach to absolutely visit! Be patient because the descent is pretty tough but the climb is harder! You will be absolutely rewarded because the sea is truly beautiful! You can get there by bus that leaves you right there or by motorbike. It opens at 8.30 and the queue is absurd. I definitely recommend going there in the afternoon because there are so many people in the morning but also because the sun burns!

reviews.title: Mare favoloso
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. Very transparent turquoise water even with rough seas (outside the cove).

reviews.title: Distanziamento inesistente
reviews.text: Needless to say, the beach is the best Italian beach, but during the period of social distancing it becomes the most dangerous beach that exists. Furthermore, the prohibitions on access to the reserved area are not respected. Too many people, really too many. I recommend getting there by sea.

reviews.title: Paradusuaca
reviews.text: As I described in the title, a paradisiacal beach... you can understand just by seeing it, because they have said it has been the most beautiful in the world for two years now... an obligatory stop for a tour of Lampedusa... p.s. It is advisable to go early in the morning! I absolutely recommend!

reviews.title: NO
reviews.text: BEAUTIFUL beach. Too bad there were really, really too many people! The controls? Non-existent. You just limited yourself to hanging a sign saying 'beach full' and as a result people came down anyway.

reviews.title: Wooooooooooow
reviews.text: What can I say...perfection. The best beach on the whole island (and perhaps in Italy) for colors and atmosphere. I recommend wearing sneakers to reach the beach easily in about 15 minutes.

reviews.title: Mare fiabesco ma un carnaio
reviews.text: Breathtaking sea but the small beach is a charnel house, one on top of the other. If I can give some advice, go in the afternoon, take a nice swim, enjoy the sea and escape

reviews.title: STUPENDA
reviews.text: Not to be missed, a beautiful beach, stunning water like you've never seen, as clear as a swimming pool

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei conigli
reviews.text: Access to the beach opens at 8.30am and requires a walk of approximately 15/20 minutes. At the bar before the descent you can rent umbrellas (5 euros plus a deposit of 10 euros). It is essential to bring water and food (there is no bar downstairs). The beach and the waters are simply a dream

reviews.title: Un angolo di paradiso.
reviews.text: Do you know paradise? Here you will find it. It is an incredible place, breathtaking. The view from the top is priceless. You can access the beach after a short walk, about ten minutes of descent. The only flaw is that there isn't a wisp of shade. Once you arrive on the beach, you will easily find a large amount of people. Bring an umbrella with you or rent one at the kiosk that you will find at the entrance to the beach, on the road. The cost is €5 with a deposit of €10. It is best to arrive very early, you can park your vehicle there on the street, the cost of parking is €3.50 for the whole day, for scooters and €7.50 for cars.

reviews.title: Colazione fantastica
reviews.text: Excellent fresh and tasty products. Both sweet and savory. I tried several places, but for me this was the best on the island

reviews.title: ...”Meglio non spargerete la voce“
reviews.text: The view of this sea is something unique that I personally will never forget! For the first time in my life I had the same type of holiday for two years in a row. The island makes you enjoy the sea in every way even while traveling by car, truly fantastic!!!

reviews.title: Acque cristalline
reviews.text: A paradise! Crystal clear waters, white sand, nothing to envy of the exotic postcard seas!

reviews.title: Sporca
reviews.text: Disorganization... Dirt and neglect of a beautiful island and a Caribbean sea... Truly a shame. Let's not talk about the assault of non-EU citizens who can be seen circulating peacefully in a Covid period

reviews.title: Indimenticabile
reviews.text: What can we say about this place, we come back every year and it always surprises us positively. One of the most beautiful sea views I've ever seen

reviews.title: 5 stelle per il mare ma.....
reviews.text: You can't help but give 5 stars to one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, you get to the beach and the guys from Lega Ambiente immediately make some rules clear: Don't move stones to place on the umbrella because there could be turtle eggs, but then you can put a beach towel on it and lie down and the first question you ask yourself is does the half kg stone weigh more or me? flaps are absolutely forbidden because the noise scares the fauna, but then you look around and there are a thousand screaming people.... If you rightly want to protect the beach, start putting an access limit because I have been there 4 times and the last time it was even difficult to stand upright and not lie down on the beach towel.....Shocking sea but we know that....

reviews.title: Che dire....
reviews.text: What should I say about this wonder, when you reach the halfway point and see it from above there are no words.

reviews.title: Senza dubbio la spiaggia più bella d’Europa
reviews.text: A wonder of nature. The walk to reach the beach can be difficult for the elderly and children, but the spectacle that awaits you upon arrival is worth every single step!

reviews.title: Bellissima ma troppo affollata
reviews.text: Enchanting place, certainly one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, with water of a unique transparency, with fish swimming between your legs, but too crowded. Zero anti-Covid distancing. It should be with controlled access, but Lega Ambiente, which manages the integrated reserve, does not control the number of people who crowd into it. It's a real shame.

reviews.title: Spiaggia più bella d italia
reviews.text: Fantastic beach where the water is very transparent. Not a very tiring walk to go down or even to go up with various stops along the way.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: One of The best beach in Europe, you can lost to visit that! It suggests to visit with child during afternoon.

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: To get to the place from the center it takes about 15 minutes by scooter. Once you reach the Onda Blu refreshment point, parking on the street you need to get a parking ticket costing €3.50 for scooters (€7.50 for cars) per day. From the Onda Blu bar you can rent an umbrella for €5 (+€10 deposit), which I highly recommend you take. From here to go down to the beach you have to face a path of stones and rocks for about 15 minutes (20 minutes uphill) I recommend wearing sneakers! Once you get there you realize how this is one of the 5 most beautiful coastlines in the world. I advise you to arrive very early in the morning like 8/8.30 to make sure you choose the place to stand.

reviews.title: 3 giorno ISOLA DEI CONIGLI
reviews.text: Seen from the boat the day before, we couldn't help but go. Stunning place with crystal clear waters. The Maldives of Lampedusa. Leave your cars or scooter in the parking lot and go down a path for about 15 minutes. Gorgeous photos. It's worth it. A day on Isola Dei Conigli can't be missed if you come to Lampedusa. Bring your rock shoes.

reviews.title: Incantevole
reviews.text: A more unique than rare experience. The descent is not even very tiring, considering the view that can be admired once you reach the staircase. Practically crystal clear sea and enchanting beach. The water is knee-deep for quite a few metres, creating a magnificent effect. Probably best beach in the world too.

reviews.title: Spectacular view
reviews.text: Crowded, long walk, but definitely worth to visit! Prepare yourself with snack and water, plan to stay longer as the walk is quite long. Better if you have a closed shoes with you for the walk. Spectacular view, crystal clear water. Few jellyfishes, but you need to be careful with the transparent ones, the big browns with blue dots are harmless, so much that you can actually touch them (not sure how much they like that though...)

reviews.title: stupenda, ma c'è troppa gente
reviews.text: the beach is truly one of the most beautiful in Italy, the problem is that there are really too many people. It is almost impossible to find a square meter to spread out your tarp

reviews.title: Il paradiso sulla terra
reviews.text: A wonderful and heavenly corner of the splendid island of Lampedusa that I was lucky enough to enjoy without the crowds that I read about in many comments and which I was told was very frequent on the island itself. Crystal clear sea in which you can see yourself in the company of many fish, white sand, shallow water that allows you to take long walks with your feet soaking. And then the breathtaking view that can be enjoyed from above extends over the beach, the Isola dei Conigli and the Tabaccara. I still have a world of things to see and places to visit but I'm sure that I will always remember this place and the emotions it made me feel, so far one of the most beautiful seas I've seen!

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: This beach is very beautiful, often very crowded because it is so beautiful... so it is better to go there early.  Path with somewhat difficult access, especially if you have children or if you are well-loaded. 15 minutes to go down and on the way back a nice climb and under the sun it becomes tiring! But it's worth it....

reviews.title: Non ci sono parole per descriverla
reviews.text: I don't have many things to say, it's paradise... you can't live without being there at least once! Get ready for a journey under the sun, the problem is not so much the descent but the ascent. If you want to find a place you have to go early in the morning by 9am or after lunch around 2.30pm when someone has already left. At the entrance they rent umbrellas for 5 euros and there is a bar where you can get something to drink or eat before starting the descent. A beach that has remained in my heart!

reviews.title: Nel mare cristallino di Lampedusa
reviews.text: Why go abroad? The Caribbean sea is here in Italy in Lampedusa: the rabbit beach must absolutely be seen and experienced. The path to get there is easy, you can easily do it in flip flops. The show is guaranteed.

reviews.title: Bellissima spiaggia da visitare
reviews.text: It's a bit of a walk, but it's really worth it... Swimming pool in the middle of the seaNature, fishOnda Marina Onda Cocomero....

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella d'Europa
reviews.text: White sand beach with side cliff and the famous Rabbit Island. Stunning sea, very clear water. Very crowded considering the notoriety. Possibility of paid parking (€7.50 whole day). Very hot beach which requires an umbrella which you can eventually rent and take from the kiosk before traveling along a slightly rough stretch of road lasting around 15-20 minutes. The ending is wonderful!  Bring lots of drinks and food as there are no services on the beach...

reviews.title: Magia unica
reviews.text: I believe there are no words to describe the beauty of this beach and the colors of its sea with different shades every day... it stays with you... magical!!!

reviews.title: Caraibi
reviews.text: Truly not to be missed. The Caribbean in Italy is here. Be careful of the really powerful sun. Equip yourself with an umbrella, food, water and sunscreen then you can enjoy the Italian Caribbean.

reviews.title: Tra l'isola e l'isolotto
reviews.text: Enchanting place out of this world, easily accessible in 15 minutes on foot from a well-built path. Large free beach although very crowded but this is normal in July. Islet reachable from the sea in a few meters without even needing to swim. Almost uncontaminated wonder.

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: What can be said about this enchantment that hasn't already been said? That you have to see it at least once in your life, then you'll definitely return! I remind those who reach it by car that you have to park on the left of the road, on the sea side: if the car is parked before accessing the downhill path, you won't have to pay for parking (but you have to respect the spaces reserved for scooters. Remember to bring plenty of water, even if you don't bring much food (you can go a few hours without eating but without drinking). no) and take away all rubbish, including cigarette butts BUT IF YOU CAN AVOID SMOKING

reviews.title: Uno dei motivi per cui vale la pena visitare l’isola
