reviews.text: Long hike but worth it. Not seeing her is like visiting Rome and not going to the Pope. The Maldives are in second division by comparison.

reviews.title: Meraviglia delle meraviglie
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world. The rabbit beach deservedly attracts many tourists for this reason and also because it was chosen by the caretta caretta turtle for nesting its eggs. It is a nature reserve. Its calm and crystalline waters are also shallow and you can walk up to the isthmus where they are even warmer. We went in the afternoon and there weren't too many people.

reviews.title: Incantevole bene  della.natura
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Europe, the third in the world, what more can I say, simply enchanting and surrounded by Tabaccara

reviews.title: Bellissima!
reviews.text: Reachable in 10 minutes on foot. Beautiful beach, but a little too busy, taking into account that it is a nature reserve. In my opinion we need more restrictions.

reviews.title: Incantevole
reviews.text: Truly beautiful but too frequented by uncivilized people who do not respect the rules of a natural and protected park. People should pay 50 cents. to appreciate and respect it more and perhaps they would take responsibility

reviews.title: Peccato.....
reviews.text: Oh yes, it's a shame that when you get to the beach you find a modern building a few meters from the sea (who knows how they managed to build there?). Apart from this mess, the whole Reserve is beautiful and during the descent to the sea you can smell the thyme and as you go down you begin to see the sea with its colours, indescribable because of how beautiful they are! I have been to a Maldivian atoll but I assure you that it is not comparable to this sea and this view. It is worth all the effort that goes into going up and down. Don't miss it!

reviews.title: fantastica spiaggia e acqua maldiviana
reviews.text: a pearl in the Mediterranean sea the mirror of sea has nothing to envy of the Caribbean or Maldives watersamazing

reviews.title: IL PARADISO È QUI
reviews.text: It is absolutely worth walking down a steep path to reach this beach

reviews.title: Le.parole non bastano
reviews.text: We hear about it a lot but if you don't see it you can't understand the absolute beauty of the place. Rocky surroundings, fine sand, incredible sea... a paradise. Even a lot of people don't disturb. Congratulations to LEGAMBIENTE which monitors and guarantees

reviews.title: Spiaggia meravigliosa
reviews.text: Rabbit Beach is so wonderful that it's hard to describe. You need to park for a fee on the main road (3 euros/h or 7.5 for the whole day) and then walk along a dirt path in the sun. It is possible to rent an umbrella in the kiosk located at the beginning of the route. You must bring food and drinks. The beach is white and the sea is crystal clear. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!

reviews.title: giornata a mare
reviews.text: Beautiful white sand beach. To reach it you have to walk for 15/20 minutes along a path. It is located in a nature reserve so there is nothing. I advise you to bring everything you need (water, food and umbrella). Only at the top of the path is there a bar with plenty of umbrellas.

reviews.title: Paradiso....ma...
reviews.text: What can I say?? When you reach the end of the descent and this spectacle of nature opens up before your eyes you can't help but say WOW!!!! Too bad that at 8.30 (opening time) it's already packed with people coming down with inflatable crocodiles and various dinghies... Luckily on the beach there are Legambiente volunteers who limit some people who in my opinion shouldn't move beyond Rimini. I've heard people complain because it's forbidden to play rackets or smoke in beach.🤦🏻‍♀️There are no public services, the bar is at the top of the hill and also rents umbrellas. I recommend arriving at 8.30 to admire the colors and leaving right after a swim and some photos or around 5.30 to enjoy a little more peace. However, you can't miss it.

reviews.title: Mozzafiato
reviews.text: Beautiful and evocative place. Absolutely worth visiting!! The route to get there is a bit challenging, but it's worth it.

reviews.title: Strepitosa
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with very white, fine sand like the Maldives and a pristine sea with amazing shades. You don't go there between 7.30pm and 8.30am to respect the turtles.

reviews.title: Non si può non andarci
reviews.text: It's certainly surprising to see a beach in a reserve with all the people crammed there. ... however you can't miss seeing it and going down on foot is the only way to swim or snorkel .. I highly recommend bringing an umbrella or renting one at the bar on the street .... bring plenty of water because there is nothing on the beach ... and arm yourself with good patience for the ascent ...

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei conigli
reviews.text: Beautiful to see both from land and sea. Parking is paid on the blue lines and the umbrella can be booked above. There are no sunbeds and there are approximately two km of descent and then obviously ascent. Crystal clear sea and breathtaking views

reviews.title: Sempre Favolosa
reviews.text: A must for anyone going to Lampedusa, a unique place, the sacrifice to get there on foot is justified. We got off at 2pm like crazy but in the end everything was rewarded.

reviews.title: Vacanza

reviews.title: I Caraibi sono qui.
reviews.text: Simply Wonderful. Well looked after by volunteer staff. It did not disappoint our expectations, perhaps a little crowded, but everyone has the right to see such beauty. One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited in my life.

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: A true paradise on earth, Caribbean beaches, crystal clear sea and Caribbean scenery. Mandatory stop in Lampedusa

reviews.title: Relax in paradiso
reviews.text: A must go if you are in Lampedusa because it is truly enchanting. We stayed yesterday July 21st. However, be careful about the descent on partly stone and uneven terrain, and above all the tiring climb (15 minutes to go down, half an hour to go up if you are not at all sporty like me), therefore: 1) for me, sneakers are essential even if I saw many people going down and up in flip-flops. But why risk a fall and ruin your holiday? 2) It is highly recommended to arrive early in the morning (I arrived at 9am and there were already many umbrellas, but still plenty of space) or in the afternoon after 5pm (because the sun is no longer so strong for the descent). Many people have already left after lunch (but it is highly inadvisable to make that climb in that sun!!!!). The opening hours are 8.30-19.30.3) the rules say that you can only stay on one part of the beach, due to the risk of rocks falling on the other part. This is what a guy from legambiente told us, and it is what is indicated on a sign outside, so apparently no causes related to turtles as I read somewhere. Clearly, once the first part was occupied, the others who arrived later all occupied the "forbidden" part. However, this meant that there was a good space each for an umbrella and beach towels. 4) essential to have an umbrella. If you don't have it you can rent it at the bar at the entrance. The sun beats down really hard. 5) high protection sun cream!! Don't worry about tanning because I saw people with protection 50 tanning on this beach! We always wore protection 20 and we were NEVER in the sun except when in the water and we risked getting burned. 6) for the reasons above, don't go there on the first day. Better to already have a minimal layer of tan or already dark skin.7) bring lots of water (in addition to food), we didn't have a fridge but freezing it the night before was enough to keep it cold all day. Once you get there you won't find anything: drinking, bathrooms, etc. 8) ideal to get there by scooter (as well as go around the whole island with this means). Paid parking, at the entrance they issue the receipt with the relevant license plate. 3.50 euros full day or 0.70 euros per hour. I don't know the prices for cars. There is also a bus stop. 9) snorkeling mask highly recommended, you will see fish even of a certain size swimming around you as soon as you enter the water. The water is quite shallow, making it ideal for children or those who cannot swim. We didn't see any jellyfish. Despite the crowd of people, the sea space in front of it is large and we enjoyed a lot of tranquility. 10) no stray dogs on the beach. It seems like trivial advice but for those like me who have been to other parts of Sicily and have had nightmares about taking out a sandwich due to the appearance of a dog looking at you with a ravenous gaze on your towel, I would say that you can feel at ease here. I had read articles from a couple of years ago that it seemed like it was a big problem here in Lampedusa but it also seems like they have pretty much resolved it. And so far apart from a couple at the end of the day in another cove I haven't seen many.

reviews.text: Everything seems to have been mixed by the expert hands of a painter, everything is perfect from the colors of the sea, the shades of blue, the colors of a wild and exciting nature. reviews.title: da rimanere a bocca aperta
reviews.text: beach which can be reached after a short fifteen minute walk, there is paid parking: for scooters it is 70 cents. per hour or daily 3.5 euros. reviews.title: La più bella spiaggia del mondo

reviews.title: Assolutamente da vedere

I recommend shoes for uneven terrain. Go down for about 15 minutes, go up for 40 making stops. The fatigue of the road is the price to pay for the most beautiful beach. I recommend mask and fins.

reviews.title: Il paradiso esiste
reviews.text: The route to reach the beach is very doable even with flip-flops. Of course, if you have shoes, even better! You will be faster :) It's really worth it, it's a paradise!!! White sand and crystal clear water, fish swimming undisturbed very close to the shore. It's a nature reserve, a protected area, well monitored by Legambiente volunteers <3

reviews.title: La Spiaggia più bella

reviews.title: MERAVIGLIA
reviews.text: To get there there is a descent of more or less a quarter of an hour, but the road is accompanied by a wonderful panorama and the beach is worth it. It is advisable to bring food and drinks because once down there are no refreshment points or any type of service. Also bring an umbrella as there are no shaded areas and it is necessary to protect yourself from the scorching sun. There is the possibility of renting an umbrella at the only refreshment point that you will encounter before starting the descent. Parking for cars and motorbikes is paid, but walking a little further you will find free parking along the road. The beach is entirely sandy, it is very small but there is a change of people so there is space.

reviews.title: Paradiso terrestre
reviews.text: Even in winter it offers a natural landscape of rare beauty. Truly a paradise on earth, a natural treasure to be preserved and enhanced.

reviews.title: stupenda spiaggia

reviews.title: Paradiso

reviews.title: IL PARADISO
reviews.text: Simply, paradise 2 hours from my house. Breathtaking. The route to get there is not very demanding as many say..... 15 minutes maximum including a stop for photos. And it's absolutely worth it!!!!

reviews.title: I Caraibi in Italia
reviews.text: I went to the rabbit beach in mid-June, a true paradise that we were able to fully enjoy because due to the few flights there were no tourists yet. The transparent water with a thousand shades of blue and behind it the Mediterranean scrub with the capers in bloom is a spectacle

reviews.title: Un paradiso sulla terra
reviews.text: This beach has nothing to envy of Caribbean beaches, those who come here live in an Italian dream, without traveling thousands of kilometers by plane, warm water, colors of natural pools, there are lots of fish floating around you, be careful of the very few red jellyfish. The beach is not equipped and you cannot bring deckchairs, you cannot listen to music on the speaker, and you cannot play. The beach is supervised by Legambiente for the protection of turtles which however we have never seen. It is always super crowded, but there is always a little hole for the umbrella that you have to bring from home. The descent is 1km and takes about 20 minutes, also taking into account the photos you take for the breathtaking view. For the descent, it is advisable to use sneakers or closed sandals. The climb is the same km and must be done in reverse, doing it calmly (taking a breath) for about 40 minutes, a little heavy after a day in the sun. At the entrance there is the only kiosk with a bar and toilet. A pleasant experience, the effort is rewarded, there are many paid car parks, and 2 for disabled people and pregnant women which however are occupied by crafty people.

reviews.title: Vacanza memorabile
reviews.text: Fantastic beach great spectacle of nature 😍 rabbit to use tennis shoes to reach it

reviews.title: Spiaggia molto bella
reviews.text: Beach worth visiting for sure, but early in the morning as it is always crowded, the bus gets there, then there is a 20 minute walk on a dirt road, comfortable shoes are recommended. Bring water or food because the bar is at the top of the road.

reviews.title: Gli incomprensibili divieti dei Vigilantes di Legambiente
reviews.text: Beautiful is Beautiful. Perhaps one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. How can we not agree in wanting to live with this earthly paradise and its fauna, following a few but indispensable rules of civilization such as not smoking, not littering and zealously observing the timetables that allow, especially turtles, to continue their life cycle undisturbed. But the line from common sense to fanaticism is blurred. Specifically, finding out firsthand that - to prevent the beach from becoming a social destination with all its attendants (ipse dixit of a Vigilantes of Legambiente) the use of harmless games such as, for example, a 10 cm diameter aquatic fresbee to be thrown into the middle of the sea is not permitted - is truly disarming. Rather than rules for nature, a veil of recreational recreational obscurantism seems to have fallen onto the beach. Therefore today moments of joy are prohibited, tomorrow we will most likely find an airport-style scanner at the entrance to the beach aimed at requisitioning toys from 0 to 90 years old. And who knows if in the not too distant future shy outpourings of affection or exchanges of words between people will be allowed without the Praetorian Guard in the yellow shirt rushing in to scold and bring the social state back to the Middle Ages. The defense of nature is certainly a primary value but making the rabbit island an open-air sanctuary gives the feeling that the friends of Legambiente live a more realistic self-referentiality than the King. Ad maiora.. hopefully.

reviews.title: Limitare l'afflusso
reviews.text: The beauty of the place is partially obscured by the massive presence of tourists. It is possible to appreciate the sea, its clear seabed and characteristic ravines, but certainly not the beach, literally invaded by hundreds of tourists. It is advisable to limit their presence given that it is a natural reserve.

reviews.title: SPETTACOLARE MA.......
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. Sea with truly unique turquoise shades. Turtles come to lay their eggs on this beach and the local Lega Ambiente takes great care of their nests by cordoning them off to prevent people from damaging them. For this reason, umbrellas cannot be planted on the beach except in one portion. To reach the beach you need to take an equipped path that winds downhill for about 1,500 metres. Once you arrive near the beach, a breathtaking panorama opens up before your eyes. On the right the coast of the Tabaccara bay with its turquoise sea, in front you can see the "rabbit" islet and on the right the beach. The thing that pushes me to give only three stars is the excessive crowding of the site. Especially in the month of August, there is not even a place to hang out a bidet towel. Lastly, there is the problem of parking. Anyone who goes to visit the place must go with a means of transport which must park on one side of the two-way road that goes to Capo Ponente.  To reach the entrance (on the way out) or the car (on the way back) people are forced to walk in the lane even for stretches of over 200 metres. To avoid possible accidents, given that the stretch is a straight stretch, it would be desirable for the Municipality to provide a parking area in one of the many abandoned fields in the area.

reviews.title: INCANTO
reviews.text: Absolutely worth seeing at least once in your life. Once you reach the middle of the long path that leads to the beach, you witness a spectacle of nature. The beach is a well-kept nature reserve. The only flaw was the amount of people in the week of August, even if we were aware of what awaited us... One day I will return, but certainly in a month like September, when the amount of people decreases and it is possible to enjoy this corner of paradise to the fullest. It is a perfect beach for swimming where it is possible to touch the bottom (for those who are not skilled swimmers), and it is a pleasure to dive with a mask and observe the numerous fish.

reviews.title: La cartolina dell'Isola
reviews.text: Extraordinary. Leave your vehicle at the paid car park (moped or car), reachable after a twenty minute walk. Shallow and transparent water with lots of fish. Bring everything you need (umbrella, water and food) before heading down. It is undoubtedly worth returning two or three times during your holiday.

reviews.title: No
reviews.text: Well certainly the view is magnificent and the water too. But I'll stop there. After a descent and then an ascent on the road which is impossible to face with beach slippers, (they say 10 minutes... but when ever? perhaps in a rush and not in the heat of the day, in fact there are 3 stages with benches for resting) and then arriving at a patch of beach which doesn't suit me given that I love beaches that are as deserted as possible like the very long beach of Rimigliano in Tuscany which is fabulous, certain beaches in Sardinia and Sicily, or Morocco or Portugal. And I don't understand how you can go to the rabbit hole with children, strollers, umbrellas and cooler bags, loaded like Sherpas and then be almost prisoners in a strip of sand, albeit white and beautiful, crowded as if you were in Rimini. Certainly if you are in Lampedusa you have to go there once so as not to have regrets, but no more. Anyway tasteful..

reviews.title: la meraviglia assoluta
reviews.text: We all dream of the Maldives and the Caribbean... but this one so close to us has nothing to envy... the path to reach it is a bit steep and would almost make you give up, but at the first sight of the sea the amazement makes you change your mind!! As soon as you are on the beach the desire to immerse yourself in those colors is so strong that I looked like a little girl who no longer wanted to get out of the water... I was so struck by that corner of paradise that I have already planned my next trip, Lampedusa the I highly recommend it for anyone who wants a beautiful sea without traveling too many hours.

reviews.title: Plage des lapins de Lampedusa
reviews.text: Breathtaking! With its schools of fish swimming among us, the water was 22 degrees from 10/17 to 22/19!!!! Crystalline! A bit of a change in altitude but plenty of shelters all along the way! We'll be there in 20 minutes if we walk well! But breaks are possible because there are benches under the shelters. Very clean beach! No migrants like the old videos on Google say! Not much to do on the island in October. The island is a large limestone rock that is rather flat because its highest point is 130m. Do not stay more than 5 days! Food is expensive because everything is imported, in cafes you eat well and cheaply. Very expensive restaurants! The amicizia café is great with their pizzas 🍕! On the way back, if you can spend a few days in Palermo, it's great and what's more you will be bathed in Sicilian life, its colors, smells, the brilliant markets and the crystal clear Mondello beach (20 minutes from the center by car) Don't try to take the buses in Palermo, it's the m....! They come whenever they want and take an infinite amount of time to get to your point of arrival! Take a car but be careful even when driving Sicilians and instead put yourself on the right so that they can overtake you even on one-lane roads, that's how it is! Have a nice trip 🧳! Under the sun exactly! 🌞🇮🇹🍕🐠🌶🐚🎁

reviews.title: Stupendamente!!
reviews.text: Definitely, absolutely and without any doubt.. The best beach I have ever seen!! 😍😍😍😍

reviews.title: spiaggia dei conigli....
reviews.text: wonderful strip of sand surrounded by a sea that has nothing to envy of the Maldives and simply fantastic rocks...

reviews.title: Un paradiso
reviews.text: What can I say, it is a paradise in every sense. Take a little walk to get there and then the splendor of the beach and water. Never seen a paradise like this

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world... I recommend visiting it in the slightly more off-season periods

reviews.title: La spiaggia più conosciuta e gettonata di Lampedusa!
reviews.text: This is the best known and most popular beach in Lampedusa... if you don't pass by here you can't say you've been to Lampedusa!

reviews.title: Bellezza nei toni del blu
reviews.text: We stayed there three times during our week-long stay in October, and I have to rate it as a favorite place in my heart. The path you have to take is really nothing, about 15 minutes, when you can enjoy a place like this... On the last day, October 12th, there weren't as many people as some people complain about in the reviews in this period; perhaps a little courage would have been enough for them and when they came into view of the beach from above, if it was too crowded for them, to turn around and start looking for some other cove suited to their needs, thus leaving more space for others without sterile complaints. Everyone likes beauty. I disagree with those who also propose a toll for entering the beach. Problems are not always solved by paying, in my opinion it is more by collaborating. A sort of "shift" could be established, i.e. allowing access to the beach for a limited period of time, e.g. 3/4 hours. I know, there aren't many, but we could all take turns enjoying this beauty without suffocating it, or even worse that the usual paying people can do it!

reviews.title: Paradisiaca
reviews.text: It is not even remotely imaginable how beautiful this beach is. It has nothing to envy of the best Caribbean and Maldivian beaches. A very white seabed and crystal clear water with a wealth of extraordinary fauna... During a holiday it is worth at least a couple of visits. I will always go back

reviews.title: UN VERO PECCATO
reviews.text: It's sad to give a negative rating to such an enchanting and particular place, it should be protected and prevent people from invading this wonder in the name of a selfie. The attempt by the Lega Ambiente volunteers to contain the crowd that climbs everywhere to look for a minimal space to lie down in defiance of all the recommendations that are written everywhere is almost touching. I wonder, where the turtles should lay their eggs given that in mid-September, during the week and at 9.30 in the morning, there isn't an inch free?

reviews.title: Spiaggia fantastica
reviews.text: beautiful beach to reach on foot with about 15 minutes of walking with spectacular views. Fantastic sea. Absolutely not to be missed

reviews.title: Solito spettacolo!
reviews.text: Absolutely a spectacle of nature... To be experienced with respect and tranquility... The beach belongs to everyone!

reviews.title: Natata al tramonto
reviews.text: Enchanting place, unfortunately to be kept away from the uncivilized locals... You can't smoke but the islanders do.. Everything else is spectacular... A fixed stop

reviews.title: Che bella!
reviews.text: Truly splendid beach... The walk is definitely worth the "prize"... Even on the way back 😂😂😂

reviews.title: Unico
reviews.text: Wonderful place, almost unique in the world. The view from above is breathtaking, when you go down to the beach you isolate yourself on the island and find yourself in a fairytale place. The reserve solution is excellent, it is kept intact. Worth seeing and swimming at least once.

reviews.title: una delle più belle davvero
reviews.text: one of the most beautiful beaches indeed. very white sand. free beach supervised by Legambiente. small restaurant at the top for lunch or snack... crystal clear water, good for snorkelling

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei conigli
reviews.text: Spectacular beach, even if after 4 years it has "worsened" due to too much tourism which is not exactly well behaved.. so much so that this year the turtles have not changed.. whoever intends.. understands!!

reviews.title: Spettacolo puro!!
reviews.text: If you decide to spend your holidays in Lampedusa it is an obligatory stop, an earthly paradise which turns out to be the most beautiful beach in Italy. Worth visiting!!!

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: They told us it was one of the most beautiful beaches in the world... Well... It's definitely like that after seeing it in person!! Quite full of people.. But really always beautiful

reviews.title: Stupenda Spiaggia!!
reviews.text: Probably the most beautiful beach in Italy... Seeing is believing... Fish swim between your legs!!!!

reviews.title: Stupendaaaaaa!!!!
reviews.text: A wonderful bay... A crystal-colored sea and lots and lots of peace... Seeing is believing :)!!

reviews.title: Non siamo ai Caraibi ma in Italia ... a Lampedusa
reviews.text: Our welcome return to the rabbit beach gratified us on Sunday 6th October and Thursday 10th. Sand that doesn't burn, emerald sea, easy access to the sea... Splendid, is that an understatement?

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: Well what can I say... the photos speak for themselves. Respect nature pls 🐢♻️ crystal clear water Today the Conigli beach is the only Italian site where ovipositions are regular, so much so that in the last 25 years the site has hosted from 1 to 7 nests a year. On summer nights, between May and August, the sea turtle reaches Conigli beach and, after digging a hole, lays around 100 eggs which it covers with sand. Egg incubation lasts over sixty days. After hatching, which generally occurs at night, the young emerge from the sand and immediately head towards the sea.

reviews.title: Sarà anche bella ma..........
reviews.text: We returned to Lampedusa after a year and I couldn't wait to go to this wonderful beach. If only I had never gone there!!!! The beaches of Rimini or Riccione are nothing in comparison, a mess and even though people didn't know where to stand, (standing room only) people kept arriving. ....insert the limited number, right?

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella d'Europa
reviews.text: What can I say, the photos are enough...in my opinion, access to the beach should be limited not only in terms of times, as it is a natural reserve and a place where the Caretta Carettas nest

reviews.title: Spiaggia incredibile
reviews.text: Defined as one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, it is certainly the most beautiful in Lampedusa. Comfortable shoes and a hat for the road down to the beach.

reviews.title: solo un difetto
reviews.text: they should impose a limited number and charge an entrance fee to finance the preservation of this paradise from the absurd overcrowding of too many humans (but few civilians...) even in September...

reviews.title: Vacanza
reviews.text: Rabbit Island a true paradise! Splendid sea while you bathe swimming with the fish, nothing to envy of the Maldives! Always recommended

reviews.title: Un Mare MERAVIGLIOSO!!
reviews.text: The 3 of us left, me, my wife and my 7 month old baby. At first I was a little skeptical having visited the most beautiful seas in the world and I can assure you that the most beautiful I have ever seen is this one!!! it leaves you breathless... certainly not as comfortable as a beach but this too has its charm!! Then as an island obviously it offers very little besides the sea but those who go to Lampedusa go for the sea... the people are extremely hospitable and always available. The only flaw is the prices...increased considerably due to tourism obviously. And if someone, unlike me... is afraid of immigrants, rest assured that you won't see even 1. I prefer immigrants to some Italians 😅.

reviews.title: Paradiso terrestre
reviews.text: Rabbit Island is a true earthly paradise. The crystal clear water allows you to look at the enchanting seabed with the naked eye. Swimming with the fish that accompany your strokes is a unique sensation.

reviews.title: Paradiso quasi tropicale
reviews.text: one of the most beautiful beaches in the Mediterranean with very soft sand, absolute tranquility and an emerald sea

reviews.title: Weekend
reviews.text: Beautiful, don't miss the beauty of the sea and the breathtaking sunsets. To be seen again at least once a year

reviews.title: Da non credere
reviews.text: Arriving by boat, a unique and unrepeatable spectacle opened up before us. There are no words or photographs to describe it, you have to visit it.

reviews.title: Lampedusa
reviews.text: You can't forget this island! Unfortunately we found days of "difficult" weather, so let's search from the ground!

reviews.title: La più bella
reviews.text: Definitely one of the most beautiful beaches in the world... Natural and crystal clear like very few other places. Wonderful :)

reviews.title: Il Paradiso
reviews.text: There are no words to describe this place, it's heaven! Extremely clear sea, you can see the fish on the shore passing by you.

reviews.title: Show della natura
reviews.text: From this special place man comes and goes but cannot put his hand there: "look and pass"! Here you don't see anything but you experience evocative moments that are fixed in your mind forever.

reviews.title: Spettacolo !
reviews.text: Splendid beach. The path to get there is also beautiful and evocative. Always clean and cared for also thanks to the guys from Legambiente. Indescribable colours, very thin sand. Natural reserve so there are no facilities on the beach. It is best to bring everything you need to spend the day. Smoking is prohibited.

reviews.title: Spettacolo
reviews.text: This natural oasis deserves all the attention that is dedicated to it. Exceptional panorama, clear waters with fish swimming even close to the shore. To get down to the beach there is a well-defined route, with some benches to rest especially after a day of sun and sea. Near the access point, along the road, there is a paid car park and the Ondablu bar where you can stop for a breakfast and an honorable lunch with a good variety of foods on offer

reviews.title: Traumhaft ...
reviews.text: ..difficult to get to..30 minutes up ..and 30 minutes down ..no toilets ..no water... and in the end you can only stay for a short time ..because you can't pee in the water ..but even when you get to the top ..there's only one terrible toilet dare ..what do people who have children actually do??

reviews.title: Meraviglia!
reviews.text: Beautiful beautiful beautiful, including the path! Unique for its indescribable colors. Congratulations to the Lega Ambiente volunteers who protect the territory.

reviews.title: La ragione di venire sin qui............
reviews.text: This top beach in Europe and among the first in the world is the reason why Lampedusa is so loved by tourists. Anyone who comes to the island cannot fail to come here even if some sacrifices must be made to reach it. Then when you enter the clear, crystalline waters of the nature reserve you will have the feeling of being in paradise, wake up you are really there.

reviews.title: La più bella al mondo!
reviews.text: The beach is simply the most beautiful sea in the world! An oasis of peace and beauty, where nature is still uncontaminated!

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: I expected a paradise... and I was actually satisfied. Beautiful beach, crystal clear sea, cleanliness and care everywhere

reviews.title: Spettacolo Olio Su Tela
reviews.text: A heavenly beach, with a blue sea, but so blue that it makes Celentano's afternoon envious.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: After a short walk of about 20 minutes you will reach the most beautiful beach on the island (and also the most crowded). There is constant environmental protection on the beach (even though the turtles have not nested on this beach for 2 years now). The beach is divided into 2 areas, one half where you can plant your umbrella and the other half where you can only spread out your beach towel. There are no services on the beach, but at the start of the path there is a refreshment point with drinks, food and the possibility of renting an umbrella. The beach is open from 08.30 to 19.30. Paid parking for cars and motorbikes.

reviews.title: La numero 1
reviews.text: Certainly the best and cleanest thanks to the presence of the volunteers from the environmental league. However, you have to take a nice 15/20 minute walk.

reviews.title: Mozzafiato
reviews.text: After about 15 minutes of walking you arrive at Spiaggia dei Conigli..... What can I say!? Breathtaking, an almost moving show. It is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world and you immediately understand why! Sea of ​​such an intense blue that it seems to merge with the sky, clear and transparent water and very white sand! The beach is part of a nature reserve area so there are no kiosks or structures on the beach. It is necessary to be equipped with everything you need to spend the day, always respecting the rules and nature. We must preserve these places and therefore be careful not to litter, not leave plastic or paper and above all cigarette butts (especially as smoking is prohibited). I went at the end of September and it was liveable but July and August are certainly months in which the beach is taken by storm.

reviews.title: STUPENDA MA TROPPO AFFOLLATA ANCHE A SETTEMBRE
reviews.text: There is no arguing about beauty: it is one of the most beautiful Italian beaches (and in the world) there is. It is located within a nature reserve and the work carried out by Legambiente volunteers is impeccable. However, it is really too crowded: it would be advisable to include limited entrances to allow users to enjoy it to the fullest but above all to protect the ecosystem. Opening hours: 8.30am-7.30pm Instagram: iviaggidiema

reviews.title: "Caraibi"
reviews.text: Beautiful beach seems to be in the Caribbean, wonderful sea and a swimming pool....... not suitable for heavy smokers, it is prohibited

reviews.title: Che spiaggia!
reviews.text: Simply fantastic! Too bad there are always so many people! A path to reach it downhill to be done with tennis shoes, not at all tiring.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: What can I say... Heavenly in every sense!! It is better to go early in the morning so as not to find it immediately full... Superb 10+

reviews.title: La più famosa
reviews.text: It is a beach that cannot be missed. At the beginning of September it is difficult to find a place to spread a towel, I imagine in July and August. Sea that leaves you speechless!

reviews.title: Piscina naturale
reviews.text: Beautiful! Unfortunately as a very crowded hyper tourist location, but it deserves above all between 5 and 7.30 that people move out! The sunset is wonderful! It's a 10 minute walk! For swimming with a mask it is best to reach the calla nearby on foot and in the water! Heavenly!

reviews.title: Vacanza.
reviews.text: Paradise without comparison, what can we say, the blue painted in blue, an area protected by the environmental league, the only white sand, it can be reached after a walk of a quarter of an hour, the return is a bit tiring as the road is uphill and under the sun, but you are abundantly rewarded by the view that presents itself upon arrival.

reviews.title: Il paradiso deve essere più o meno così...
reviews.text: We were in Lampedusa in September and a visit to the SPIAGGIA DEI CONIGLI could not be missed. There is parking to pay... negligible cost. We were there at 8 and there were already people SKIPPING to get to the beach first (and I'm already getting nervous). The walk is beautiful and at certain points opens up to breathtaking if not moving views. The beach is white and seems unreal. It is divided for those who have an umbrella and those who don't. If you want to smoke you leave the beach. They should put up a sign because it's not clear that you can't smoke. We were prepared and knew what we had to do but there are people who don't care about anything... RUDE! Legambiente supervises everything and tries to enforce the rules... but I repeat: It's full of RUDE people who don't even deserve to go near such places. The sea is dreamlike... excellent for snorkelling. There are lots of fish to see. I don't give 4 stars just because there are too many people. Being a PROTECTED AREA they shouldn't let so many people arrive on the beach. I would propose a CLOSED NUMBER or perhaps a mega payment to enter. TOO MANY RUDE PEOPLE LEAVING DIRT and then complaining that they don't see the turtles or that it's dirty (woke people). BUFFONS! This is not the place for you. It would be PARADISE.. the place is MAGNIFICENT. Bring water and food... otherwise you will have to trek to the BLUE WAVE.

reviews.title: Come nelle foto 😁😁
reviews.text: Spectacular as expected!! It's a quarter of an hour walk to get there. If you intend to spend the whole day, an umbrella is mandatory 😅

reviews.title: Superlativa !!!!!
reviews.text: Beautiful!!!!!  However, I think it should be open to a limited number of people because it is too crowded in the middle of the day.

reviews.title: Vacanze
reviews.text: Visited on the last day before leaving. A unique beach of its kind. An enchantment. For those who visit it, I recommend bringing an umbrella or renting one from the kiosk before starting the descent. Equip yourself with everything you need as there are no refreshment points down there. Rightly so as it is a nature reserve. Decide a day and go there... Paradise awaits you!!! MAXIMUM RESPECT FOR NATURE.

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella del mondo
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and maniacally maintained by legambiente volunteers. If you come to Lampedusa you must visit it at least once. I recommend you pay for the very cheap parking, otherwise you will be fined.

reviews.title: Che dire..
reviews.text: What hasn't already been said... The photos speak for themselves... A bit of effort to go down and above all to go up but it's absolutely worth it...

reviews.title: In mezzo al mar... 🎶🎶
reviews.text: The beach is fabulous, clear and warm water, soft sand and little fish swimming here and there... However, be prepared for a nice walk, especially on the way back which will be all uphill and wear comfortable shoes (flip flops at your own risk: you also walk on live rock!) and above all water (there are no kiosks on the beach and it is a long walk back to the car park). The best choice is to be able to go without umbrellas: there is no shelter from the sun, but in the part excluded from umbrellas there is more space.

reviews.title: Strepitosa!
reviews.text: Definitely the beach that sticks out the most in Lampedusa! Stunning sea and sand, to be preserved despite the stupidity of the people who constantly pick up stones and place anything on the ropes. IT IS FORBIDDEN.

reviews.title: un paradiso troppo affollato
reviews.text: I was in Lampedusa in the first week of September 2019, in September you expect to find few people but the Conigli beach was super crowded! A paradise with the turquoise sea and white sand, kept very clean also thanks to the constant presence of Lega Ambiente volunteers who dictate the rules and supervise it. The only sore point is the large amount of people who frequent it!

reviews.title: Meravigliosa!!
reviews.text: Maybe it really is the most beautiful beach in the world... Full of people, yes.. But how wonderful!!! We hope to return as soon as possible...

reviews.title: Meraviglia delle meraviglie
reviews.text: Words or hyperbole are not needed and are not enough to describe the beauty of this beach which is already visible in its splendor when seen from above. The colors are indescribable: this is a treasure of nature!

reviews.title: Un luogo favoloso
reviews.text: A breathtaking landscape, a blue sea and huge fish swimming alongside you. Don't forget your packed lunch because fortunately there is no possibility of buying anything down there.

reviews.title: Non a caso per anni "spiaggia più bella d'Europa"
reviews.text: Without a doubt the most beautiful and largest beach on the whole island. Once you reach the entrance to the beach, there is a large road car park where you can leave your vehicle and then proceed on foot. Access to the beach is possible from 8.30am to 7.30pm (protected marine area). Closed shoes are recommended for the route, although it is easy and suitable for even the littlest ones. The descent to the beach takes about 10-15 minutes, and after the first stretch, it immediately offers breathtaking views. The beach, of very fine white sand, is divided into two parts: a first area where you can put up an umbrella, and a second where you can only spread out your towels. Recommended especially on days when the sirocco winds aren't blowing, to be able to admire it in all its splendor. At the street parking there is a kiosk where you can drink, eat and rent umbrellas (which you then have to carry yourself down to the beach)

reviews.title: Vacanze a Lampedusa
reviews.text: Excellent beach, perhaps the largest on the island. Stunning sea and very fine sand. 15 minute walk but worth it

reviews.title: Una vera piscina!
reviews.text: Gorgeous beach visited twice! Crystal clear and warm water. Fine, white sand. The beach is patrolled by legambiente which monitors those who do not observe the rules. I highly recommend

reviews.title: Da sogno
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I have ever seen, crystal clear sea and very fine sand... The caretta caretta turtle nests there

reviews.title: Top......
reviews.text: Definitely the most beautiful beach in Lampedusa, as everyone says. Crystal clear and wonderful sea, fine sandy beach. Absolutely worth visiting even if it takes a half hour walk to get there. Better in the late afternoon due to the daily crowds.

reviews.title: Questo è mare!
reviews.text: Since I saw this beach and above all this sea for the first time I have forgotten everything else and I always go back there this is the sea I am looking for, clean, transparent and warm, magnificent!

reviews.title: Decisaamente da non perdere
reviews.text: Lampedusa is full of suggestive views and places. Among the most beautiful and usable (assuming you walk with appropriate footwear for a good half hour along a 'light' trail, between descent and ascent) is this famous beach, which takes its name from Rabbit Island, separated by a few dozen meters from Lampedusa. the enchanting scenery and the crystal clear water, populated by fish that touch you when you walk in the water make it an unusual place. The Legambiente unit monitors compliance with the rules and provides a bag for willing plastic collectors, which now represent an unpleasant and disturbing constant in the sea.

reviews.title: Incantevole!
reviews.text: The first obligatory stop is breakfast at the little bar at the top of the path. 15 minutes to go downhill, quite comfortable. We recommend a cooler with plenty of water and food for the day. Halfway through the journey you are fascinated by the stupendous view of the rabbit island (a sea with a thousand shades of blue). Just a few more steps to reach the famous former villa of Domenico Modugno on the right, and on the left the wonderful rabbit beach, a natural and uncontaminated reserve of Lampedusa. Caretta caretta turtles lay their eggs at night and this is why there are several prohibitions that rightly need to be respected to safeguard this wonderful island.

reviews.title: Da vedere in bassissima stagione...
reviews.text: Beautiful, undoubtedly... and something to see once in a lifetime. It's a shame that in mid-September it is crowded beyond belief (you have to set the alarm and get there at 8.30 to hope to find a place)... and it is also the only real free beach on the island (the other coves, many very small, are covered with umbrellas and sunbeds right up to the rocks)... maybe try in October....

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Beautiful and characteristic, it feels like being in the Maldives. The only flaw if you get windy days there are jellyfish and you have to be careful when swimming. I recommend going in the afternoon after 4pm and enjoying the free part of the beach because if you leave in the morning you might want to go back up by 3pm because it's too hot, and the way back is all uphill so it would be tiring. In any case it is absolutely worth seeing and experiencing.

reviews.title: Una certezza, una meraviglia
reviews.text: It is the only beach that can compete with Balos and Elafonissi. The problem is not so much getting there, but rather the hike to get away, which is demanding under the sun... Wonderful and always in the heart

reviews.title: Paradiso in terra
reviews.text: You arrive at this wonderful beach after a path of about 15-20 minutes, which can be done by everyone. The view is wonderful and the beach even more so. Crystal clear and warm water. A spectacle of nature, closed shoes are advisable for walking the path.

reviews.title: Unica
reviews.text: Although not very large, it remains unique when it comes to the transparent sea and the panorama. Once you reach the entrance, parking is subject to a fee (car €7.50 / moped €3.50 for the whole day). We took advantage of the convenient urban bus (ticket €1), thus avoiding the stress of parking and helping to reduce pollution. Once you arrive you have to do almost 30 minutes of descent (and ascent at the end of the day) with sections of "natural" path and other more comfortable ones. Only the last part has a wooden walkway.  Comfortable shoes recommended, but it's worth it. Breathtaking panorama, and the closer you get, the more you want to get there. Only one flaw, we were on September 12th and we found such a quantity of people that we couldn't even spread out towels on the beach (what we would have found in the month of August). The guys from Lega Ambiente should regulate entry and use so that everyone can enjoy the beauty of the place. One piece of advice, bring your own food and drink because the beach is not equipped.

reviews.title: UNICA
reviews.text: No words are needed to describe it, they would be superfluous as the place speaks for itself. One of the most beautiful places I have ever seen.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Paradise on earth is here. You immerse yourself in spectacular water, a beautiful landscape, nature in its pure state

reviews.title: DA VISITARE SICURAMENTE
reviews.text: You can't go to Lampedusa and not have seen the rabbit beach. Arm yourself with comfortable shoes and a little patience to reach the beach by foot (about half an hour) but in the end your efforts will be rewarded. After Tabaccara, reachable only by sea, this is certainly the most beautiful beach in Lampedusa. Go there

reviews.title: Spiaggia meravigliosa ma troppa gente
reviews.text: Definitely the most beautiful of all when it comes to the white sand, the transparent sea and the view. To reach it you have to pay (in our case daily for a scooter) €3.50 and about a 15 minute walk under the sun (comfortable shoes for going up and down are highly recommended). There is the possibility of buying an umbrella before going down but if I can afford it I would not recommend it, given that once you get down you will be scared by the amount of people you will find. We opted for the beach part "free" only with towels because it is more peaceful. For those who will be traveling with their dog like us, I warn you that it is the only one where you cannot take it (there is environmental protection for the caretta-caretta turtles). The last piece of advice is to bring something to drink and eat because the beach is not equipped and the only supply there is is the kiosk before you get off, which should absolutely be abolished.

reviews.title: PARADISO
reviews.text: A spectacle of nature, protected from the destructive hand of man, protected by Legambiente! One of the most beautiful seas ever seen, reachable in 10-15 minutes on foot via a path accessible to all, in one half of the beach there is a ban on planting umbrellas (thank God so most people stay on the side designated for them), a ban on smoking and touching anything inside the natural park, home of the caretta caretta turtles. Precisely because it is home to this splendid animal contains a large quantity of jellyfish, easily sightable through the crystal clear water, but you still need to be careful. Bring something to drink or eat because this wild wonder, rightly, has no human settlement (except before traveling the 10 minute descent).

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: I think it really is the most beautiful beach in the world!!! Breathtaking water and colours.. A natural reserve where it binds the environment, rightly enforces certain observations to preserve the environment.. to be seen absolutely once in a lifetime.. The only negative sides, the rough road to be covered on foot and the overcrowding.. from 12 onwards the water gets drastically dirty and people are crowded together on the beach.,

reviews.title: splendida... ma...
reviews.text: The rabbit beach is beautiful, defined as one of the most beautiful in the world and there must be a reason! It has fantastic colours...is the sea defined as one of the most beautiful in the world or is everything in context? I have to understand this because in reality the stretch of beach is not large, it fills up with people in record time, and when you leave you have to be careful not to run into someone lying on the ground sunbathing. I'm talking about the early September period. We arrived at nine and luckily we chose the part without umbrellas because after a few hours it was indefinable, one on top of the other is an understatement. Clearly the time passes mostly in the water, the return is slightly more tiring than the outward journey but doable, I recommend sneakers or closed shoes especially for women and not flip flops. There is a bar at the entrance which at the exit is like an oasis in the desert. Scooter parking 3.50 euros all day. Bring plenty of water. Turtles have been choosing Linosa to lay their eggs for two years now... the reason is still not clear according to experts.

reviews.title: Il paradiso sulla terra
reviews.text: Describing this beach is an understatement. Uncontaminated place, warm water in an unobtainable naturalistic context. With a little sacrifice you arrive after 15 minutes of descent with a breathtaking view. The return uphill is more difficult. I recommend hats and stopping at the dedicated points. Opening at 8.30 am and closing at 7.30 pm. Umbrella can be rented at the entrance for €5. Parking for motorcycles €3.50 all day. There is no type of service on the beach, no umbrellas, no bar.

reviews.title: Mare bellissimo ma non la metto al primo posto
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful and if you talk to someone about Lampedusa they will surely tell you about the rabbits. The water is beautiful, but in my opinion it is not in first place or even in the top 3 for one reason: too many too many people!! I was in Lampedusa for the first 12 days of September and you can't move with the rabbits!! Although the water is crystal clear, in my opinion Cala Pulcino, La Tabaccara and Cala Pisana are even better. Having said this, Lampedusa is beautiful everywhere and the Rabbits are no different

reviews.title: Colori intensi e acqua trasparente
reviews.text: It is one of the most famous beaches in the world, certainly the most beautiful and largest on Lampedusa. Great effort by Legambiente for conservation. Unfortunately, the former villa in Modugno next to the white beach says a lot about how unequal the battle is, as does the handful of glass on the beach that I collected in just one day. Too many people, not even paid parking and parking fines discourage you. At 10 in the morning in September it is already saturated. On the other hand, it's addictive, if you try it you'll want to go back, even facing the descent (and the ascent) without a tree. It is important to bring water, something to eat and an umbrella if you plan to stay for the whole day. The umbrella is rented near the bar, as are the parking tickets.

reviews.title: Sopravvalutata
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, large, with very fine white sand and a really clean sea. Parking (for a fee) costs €3.50 all day for scooters and around €7.50 for cars, after a short 10 minute downhill journey you arrive at the beach which unfortunately in the summer months is unlivable, or at least due to overcrowding it doesn't show off its beauty as it should.

reviews.title: meglio dei caraibi ma dipende dal periodo
reviews.text: highly appreciated and splendid from the end of May to mid-June. In August you would have a distorted feeling and you would avoid it. I was there twice in May-June and once in August.

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei conigli 12 settembre 2019
reviews.text: A stunning beach to say the least. The sand looks like talcum powder. The sea ranges from white to shades of turquoise to blue. A true enchantment. To reach it you have to follow a path and the walk takes about half an hour. The beach does not have any bathing facilities because it is a protected area. You can swim among the fish right from the shore. If you go on holiday to Lampedusa it is absolutely worth going there.

reviews.title: Excellent Trip Advisor !
reviews.text: The choice to appear on the first page of the most beautiful beaches in the world is the comment of someone who...has never set foot there! and who says it... with surprising French

reviews.title: Incantevole
reviews.text: It's a wonderful beach! Obviously worth seeing, although the journey to get there may seem a bit tiring, but it's worth it. Practically the Caribbean! I recommend visiting it not first, but last, precisely because it is very beautiful and after having seen this one the others could be less beautiful and disappointing.

reviews.title: una delle spiagge più belle del mondo!
reviews.text: a natural paradise with a sea like that of the Maldives or the Caribbean! wonderful...only flaw....too many too many people...

reviews.title: Meravigliosa ma estremamente affollata
reviews.text: Getting there by swimming from the Gulet passing first through Rabbit Island is like feeling like DiCaprio in the film The Beach

reviews.title: Fantastico
reviews.text: Truly enchanting place... the initial walk is very special as it prepares you to respect nature. Being a free beach you have to deal with people who are not very polite.. but the place is really worth it..

reviews.title: Posto fantastico
reviews.text: Worth seeing at least once in your life, the only negative thing is that there isn't much room, or at least we went in early September and there were really a lot of people.

reviews.title: Vacanza estiva
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, very fine and white sand, constantly kept clean by the wonderful Lega Ambiente volunteers. The only flaw is that they allowed umbrellas on half the beach... it's no longer as wild as I remembered. Absolutely not to be missed. Better to go with sneakers or rubber shoes.

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, a little too crowded but worth experiencing. It can be reached via a walking route so bring comfortable shoes as slippers are unsuitable. Very fine white sand, crystal clear water. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Strepitosa.
reviews.text: Fantastic beach, crystal clear sea, a corner of pure paradise. I hope to return as soon as possible. Spectacular.

reviews.title: Bellissima spiaggia!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach... Not for nothing mentioned as one of the most beautiful in the world... It can be reached after a descent of about a quarter of an hour with a spectacular view that certainly repays the effort... Transparent water... swimming next to the island you can snorkel and see many fish... The only negative note, unfortunately, is the many people... but on the other hand it is inevitable... we are in a unique place in the world! Hard to forget!

reviews.title: Bello
reviews.text: Magnificent view and beach certainly well kept by the local civilization. Excellent for those who love the sea

reviews.title: Posto magnifico
reviews.text: ....Speechless, crystal clear sea and very fine sand, a beach that is nothing short of fantastic, a wonderful landscape.

reviews.title: Da senza fiato
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever seen. Crystal clear water. The only flaw is that you have to be equipped with everything (water, food) because underneath after a nice 15 minute walk there are no bars. But it's not worth it, it's simply a paradise 😍

reviews.title: Bellissima ma affollata
reviews.text: Wonderful beach and sea, but a charnel house. Descent feasible in 10 minutes from which you can enjoy a beautiful panorama, definitely an obligatory stop for those staying in Lampedusa

reviews.title: The N.° 1!
reviews.text: What can we say beyond everything they have already written? Equip yourself with comfortable shoes and start climbing all the steps, little by little as you get closer, you will start to run out of breath, first of all due to the effort of carrying the umbrella with you, and then due to the spectacle that will appear before you, then.... leave a little breath for the return. But believe me, it is so beautiful that you will want to return, it is truly unique in the world!!!! If you are a good swimmer, go and visit the Madonna underwater, you will be amazed!

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: We saw this beach both by sea and by land, after a nice hike we arrived at one of the most beautiful beaches in Lampedusa and perhaps in Italy.

reviews.title: Soffocante
reviews.text: Yes, it's true, we already knew it before coming. But there are so many people that it prevents any form of relaxation. (And it's September 9th, no mid-August) You're constantly worried that someone won't come and stand in front, behind, on the side, above, below. Uncivilized people regardless of the fact that you exist or how long before you had to get up compared to them, to enjoy that piece of beach that you jealously keep under your towel.

reviews.title: Un paradiso!
reviews.text: What can I say...this beach, this sea...they are unique. Very wild, beautiful water, seabeds waiting to be explored! It really is a paradise.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: Beach that can be reached from a path from where you can appreciate the beautiful panorama of the nearby rabbit island, very clean beach thanks to the legambiente volunteers who check that all visitors respect the few essential rules, crystal clear water and wonderful seabeds rich in biodiversity that can be appreciated with a simple mask

reviews.title: Auspicabile il numero chiuso
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world, best looked after by Lega Ambiente. However, the amount of people who literally invade it every day is unacceptable. In order to better enjoy this corner of paradise, it would be desirable for a daily limited number to be applied, covering the costs of managing controlled access with the payment of a minimum entry fee.

reviews.title: Bellissima 😍
reviews.text: What can I say about this beach! Too beautiful! Truly gorgeous! A bit of a walk and if you arrive very early in the morning, a swimming pool full of fish with white sand is even more beautiful! A spectacle, let's go around the world and Lampedusa is a jewel in Italy ♥️

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei conigli
reviews.text: Magical place, crystal clear sea, breathtaking beach. Crowded beach, but worth going. I'll be back soon!!!

reviews.title: Il Paradiso esiste davvero!
reviews.text: Never seen water like this! To leave you breathless. The path that takes you to the beach through wild and uncontaminated nature is beautiful.

reviews.title: Bellezza affollata!
reviews.text: A wonderful panoramic view coming down the path that leads to the beach! Unfortunately, once you reach the seaside...difficulty finding space to spread out a towel to lie down...wonderful sea!

reviews.title: UN GRAZIE A LEGA AMBIENTE
reviews.text: Thanks to the Lega Ambiente volunteers who guard the beach, keeping it a paradise, as unfortunately all the others should be, which unfortunately are invaded by the ignorance of mass tourism. What else can I say, the beach and its panorama speak for themselves, Fantastic

reviews.title: Magnifica
reviews.text: It is a magnificent beach that can be reached after a walk of about 20 minutes. Crystal clear water and very fine white sand. Great attention from everyone to respect the habitat also thanks to the constant presence of Lega Ambiente. Obviously it is very full

reviews.title: Meraviglia della natura
reviews.text: Stunning beach to say the least, with water ranging from white to turquoise to blue! The beach can be reached after a walk of about half an hour, but when you get down, the effort is rewarded by the view of this wonderful beach! P.s. the beach is in a nature reserve and I hope people don't ruin it, because there are really uncivilized people who don't know how to respect anything about nature. There are the guys from Lega Ambiente, but there's no point in doing checks if one day they're there and two days they're not! I won't say anything else.

reviews.title: bellissima ma
reviews.text: splendid location, among the most beautiful in Lampedusa, should be protected even more by limiting the number of people, you are in close contact and there are uncivilized people. The only real disappointment was the excessive presence of plastic fragments in the sand. Advised

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach ever seen. To get to the beach, you have to take a nice walk of less than 20 minutes.

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: They say it's a nature reserve, but there were thousands of us, why?? Having said that, the beach and sea were beautiful!

reviews.title: Bellissima ma.......
reviews.text: Definitely the most beautiful beach in Lampedusa, even if not easily accessible to everyone. But it's worth walking more or less 15 minutes to reach it... In my humble opinion, however, they should put a limited number of accesses, because the chaos reached after a certain hour from which you can't even walk on the beach given the number of people present is not acceptable.

reviews.title: splendida spiaggia mare cristallino
reviews.text: a beautiful beach with an exceptional sea a little tiring to get there but the game is worth the candle the beach was clean and there were Legambiente volunteers watching over

reviews.title: LaSpiaggiaPiuBella
reviews.text: A beach with such wonderful water I've never seen!! A spectacle of nature! 15 minute walk and you reach paradise! Open from 8.30am to 7.30pm. Go there!!

reviews.title: Mare imcredibile
reviews.text: I believe that at least once in your life you need to come and see this spectacle of nature... Caribbean sea and location... There are no words... And it's worth a 10 minute walk to get there.... Oscar

reviews.title: CHE CAOS
reviews.text: beautiful beach in one of the most beautiful coves of Lampedusa, shame about the overcrowding that characterizes it in August and the 20 minute walk under the baking sun that you have to do. Worth seeing outside high season

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Splendid beach, on par with the beaches of Sardinia. Crystal clear sea you swim among the fish. Clean and controlled by Lega Ambiente volunteers, you cannot smoke, no rubbish! So perfect better than the Caribbean!! The only flaw is a lot of people!

reviews.title: paradiso
reviews.text: The rabbit beach is a unique place, where the colors of the sea combine with those of the vegetation and rocks. You have to walk at least a kilometer to get there but there are places in the shade to sit and rest for a moment. It's a shame that in August the beach is very crowded and the average stay is around two to three hours, because it's unliveable. It's a shame that it also loses its charm a bit.

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: Beautiful I highly recommend a beautiful walk but very crowded the pab which is located above the walk I recommend it after the hard walk

reviews.title: passeggiata lunga ma ne vale la pena !!1
reviews.text: You can't go to Lampedusa and not go and see one of the most beautiful beaches in the world and with a bit of luck see Caretta Caretta the beautiful turtle laying her eggs, don't miss it, it's a paradise!!!

reviews.title: una seiimana di ferie ai primi di luglio e stato fantastico- La spiaggia e un incantesimo.. Da visitare assolutamente...
reviews.text: Go to Lampedusa and it is a wonderful island.. especially around with the guided and exceptional boat...

reviews.title: La spiaggia numero uno al mondo
reviews.text: All previous reviews describe this beach best. Yes, it's true you can get there after twenty minutes of descent, half an hour if you stop at the first panoramic point to take photos, but the shoes seem excessive to me as there are comfortable and wide steps. YOU MUST ARRIVE EARLY, or rather very early, we only managed to put up a mini umbrella at 3pm. Plenty of sun protection, because the burn is guaranteed and then enjoy the show. Fine sand, wonderful sea. Be careful, it is a nature reserve, so it must be treated with gloves. Furthermore, if the beach is too full you risk not being able to get off.

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: You have to go early in the morning. Opens at 8.30. On half of the beach it is possible to plant umbrellas, on the other half it is not. It is not suitable for people with walking problems, to reach the beach you need to walk for about 20 minutes. A beach dream is absolutely worth it

reviews.title: Love Lampedusa
reviews.text: The best island you will find in Italy... they are all very beautiful but Lampedusa is the most beautiful, above all it is all Made in Italy... 🇮🇹

reviews.title: Vacanza Agosto 2019
reviews.text: It's a truly wonderful beach! everything you see and read is absolutely true! Personally, I have only seen such crystal clear water a few times.

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: Really amazing place. I think it's heaven on earth. I highly recommend going there to anyone who is in Lampedusa. You can get there in 10/15 minutes of descent, while the climb is a little longer but has shaded pitches for resting. Around midday it is a bit overcrowded.

reviews.title: Splendida!
reviews.text: Reachable after about 20 minutes of walking, it is advisable to reach it in the cooler hours. The beach is supervised by Lega Ambiente volunteers as it is the nesting area of ​​the caretta caretta turtle, therefore smoking is not allowed and it is possible to use umbrellas only in about half of it.

reviews.title: spiaggia incantevole
reviews.text: beautiful beach like few in the world... you can get there from a path of about 1 km. I recommend comfortable shoes... the climb back up is a little more tiring especially in the sun.

reviews.title: Paradiso terrestre
reviews.text: I was in Lampedusa from 24 to 31 August, in my opinion it is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Not only for the color of the water which you can appreciate to the fullest with the mistral but for the whole scenery which is enchanting. The water is crystal clear and it feels like swimming in an aquarium full of fish.  The light rock seems to embrace that stretch of fantastic sea, it is one of the few beaches where caretta caretta sea turtles nest. I recommend visiting it in less crowded periods, it was recommended to me by the people of Lampedusa at the end of June, beginning of July. In the month of August the crowding is wild and people line up on the beach without any criteria and it becomes impossible to even walk on the beach and you often find people walking on the towel. There is no entrance fee and you can enter from 8.30am, you only pay for the parking. I recommend going to the beach very early in the morning because you have to walk for 15 minutes before arriving, furthermore the beach is divided into two parts, one where you can put umbrellas and the other part where you can only spread out your towel. The beach is very clean thanks to the guys from legambiente and smoking is prohibited, there is an area where you can go and smoke. The beach is not equipped and there are no services so you have to bring food and water. It is also possible to purchase them at the entrance before starting the descent and it is also possible to rent the umbrella. You cannot fail to come to Lampedusa and not dedicate a day or several days to this enchanting oasis where you can spend a relaxing day. A true earthly paradise

reviews.title: Incantevole ma da organizzare
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with crystal clear water that is the envy of the Maldives. The commitment of the Lega Ambiente volunteers to preserve such a delicate place is admirable. In my opinion, access to the beach could be better organized and, if I may, advise a limit of people, perhaps with online booking too.

reviews.title: INCANTEVOLE
reviews.text: Upon arrival you can enjoy an enchanting panorama. One of the most beautiful beaches in Italy, clear and transparent sea

reviews.title: Luogo suggestivo 100%
reviews.text: What you start to see when you take the very short route to get to the beach (10 minutes on foot) is indescribable. A truly unique place, and I have seen some beautiful seas, in fact it wins a beautiful place in the top ten beaches in the world. It's a shame about the large amount of swimmers... But it's enough to stay either only in the morning or only in the afternoon and everything will be resolved.

reviews.title: Ineguagliabile
reviews.text: Rabbit Beach is very famous and now that I've visited it I understand why. Clear, fine sand, degrading crystalline sea, turtle protection, fish swimming ashore between the tourists' ankles. A paradise

reviews.title: Wow!!
reviews.text: The sea is fabulous, the only thing I didn't like is the walk down, especially if done under the sun...

reviews.title: Da vedere
reviews.text: A wonder of nature that should be protected even more than what happens today. Descent and ascent feasible. Endless work of volunteers

reviews.title: Schildkröten?
reviews.text: What puzzles me is the question of when the turtles lay their eggs. Is the beach closed during this time? I really hope so, otherwise I wouldn't go there again. In short, about the beach: five stars! But just take a towel with you. There's no room for more anyway! You could definitely say that in high season. That's why I think it's overkill to hype it up as the most beautiful beach in Europe. I've already seen beaches in Sardinia that can compete.

reviews.title: Qualche informazione per goderla al massimo
reviews.text: We are early risers, this is a great advantage for enjoying the deserted beaches before they fill up with holidaymakers until they can't. The rabbit beach is open from 8.30am to 7.30pm. At night it becomes the property of the turtles, in case they decide to lay their eggs here (July-August). Already in the first half hour, up to 350 people descend on the beach (counted by those from Lega Ambiente), so arriving very early is the safest way to be able to plant your umbrella on the beach. Umbrellas can also be rented for €5. Parking for motorbikes €3.50, for cars €7. The beach is divided in half for umbrellas, half for towels only. No smoking, play ball or rackets. Gorgeous beach, water is a dream, but more than 5000 reviews have already been written on this topic

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella del mondo ??!!
reviews.text: I don't know if it is the most beautiful beach in the world as many sites say, but it is truly very very beautiful. Even this beach, which can only be used in the morning between 08.30 and 19.30, can only be reached after a long walk under the sun. My advice is to be there at 08:00 ready for the gates to open, so as to be able to enjoy the unique view of the beach at its maximum splendor. If there is a mistral wind, even better. Before starting the path it is possible to rent an umbrella to take down to the beach. The beach is divided in two. One part, right, for umbrellas and the left for the daredevils who don't use it. It must be said that the left side, i.e. the part closest to the island, manages to maintain its beauty even in the early hours of the afternoon. It is the only place on the island where you pay for parking, albeit minimal.

reviews.title: La spiaggia
reviews.text: There are few sandy beaches on the island, this one with rabbits is the most beautiful on the island. It takes a long walk to get there, but it's worth it both for the view of the bay and the color of the sea. Very popular.

reviews.title: Un vero spettacolo della natura
reviews.text: Beach divided into two parts. A part where you can put the umbrella and the rest only with the towel. The sea is so crystal clear that it seems to be in a swimming pool, Caribbean sand.. there is a 20 minute walk, but it's worth it..

reviews.title: Bellissima riserva naturale
reviews.text: There is a bit of a walk to cover... about 20 minutes... on a fairly tortuous route which is quite quiet on the way out but on the way back I recommend stopping in the designated shaded spaces to avoid collapse... the reserve is heavenly... If there wasn't a hive of people it would certainly be more beautiful... Equip yourself with both an umbrella and food because there is only one kiosk at the beginning of the descent... Pay for the parking because unfortunately they don't save money fines

reviews.title: Paradiso terrestre
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, a little tiring going down and going back up but it's worth it. Clean and crystalline water... the only flaw are the bees

reviews.title: Fantastica
reviews.text: Small, but very beautiful! Clear water, the only flaw is there isn't a kiosk nearby to go to the services you have to climb all the stairs again with the attached path

reviews.title: La spiaggia e rada  più bella che abbia mai visto
reviews.text: A fairytale place. With calm seas, in the early morning the colors are crazy. The beach is very crowded in August, but it is still worth going. Better early in the morning as soon as the entrances open.

reviews.title: spettacolo
reviews.text: wonderful place, a little difficult to get there, I do not recommend it for children and pregnant women, bring water...

reviews.title: Un sogno
reviews.text: There is a reason there is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world and you won't regret it! The descent but above all the climb with the children in your arms is a bit tiring but it is absolutely worth it

reviews.title: Un angolo di PARADISO, da salvaguardare
reviews.text: A wonderful place, but too crowded in August. Perhaps a limit on tourist access should be considered, considering that there are those who are not respectful of others and who have no problem placing their umbrella on top of yours when the space on the beach is full. An excellent job done by FAI volunteers to safeguard and enforce this natural reserve.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: A breathtaking beach that is worth visiting. Clear and transparent water. The first beach to visit when you arrive in Lampedusa.

reviews.title: NON CI SONO PAROLE
reviews.text: It takes about 15 minutes to walk at a good pace, but it's worth it. Since the road is entirely in the sun, I went there in the afternoon. The beach does not have umbrellas set up, so if you do, you have to bring your own or rent one at the entrance to the beach.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: To reach this beach, counted among the 10 most beautiful in the world, you have to walk for about 15 minutes under the sun. But the show that appears already halfway through is truly priceless!!!! Crystal clear water, very white beach...a unique spectacle

reviews.title: TOP IN ASSOLUTO
reviews.text: the most beautiful and colorful beach. Being the most beautiful, it is the most visited. You cannot smoke on the beach, there is a special area. Although I saw people hiding to smoke.

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella
reviews.text: Without a doubt the most beautiful beach in Lampedusa! You have to go there early in the morning to be able to put up an umbrella. Unfortunately at the end of the morning it is already packed with people, but the place is really beautiful, it feels like being in a swimming pool, and the fish swim near you...

reviews.title: Finché c'è LEGAMBIENTE c'è speranza
reviews.text: A paradise on earth. The best hour is certainly the last before closing, when the beach empties and few people remain to admire the pink sea and the noise of the seagulls. Beach with precise rules. Half the beach for umbrellas, half for towels only. You can only smoke in a specific area. Very clean beach thanks to the Legambiente volunteers and certainly not due to the civic sense of those who bathe. The only flaw is too many people. In a paradise like this it's a shame to even swim. And I recommend bringing a mask and snorkel because near the rocks there is an aquarium!!! Marvelous!!!!!!

reviews.title: Molto bella ma...
reviews.text: Stunning beach if you arrive in the morning as soon as it opens, but as the morning goes on too many people arrive and you don't move anymore!!!!

reviews.title: Quanta gente.....
reviews.text: The beach is very beautiful and can be reached after a 20 minute walk. It is advisable to arrive at 8.30am when it opens so you can find a place in front for an umbrella or towel. Recommended.

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: Phenomenal beach and crystal clear sea. Absolutely worth seeing. It takes a while to get there on foot but it's worth it. I don't give the 5th star because once you get off you are practically stuck together like sardines given the hundreds of people. Still not to be missed

reviews.title: Meraviglia della natura
reviews.text: Exceptional place out of time and space... only flaw: excessive crowding in the month of August! ...if you can, go in other months

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Caribbean beach seems to be in paradise! It is inside the reserve so it can only be reached on foot and it is not an organized beach... This is for the benefit of the environment!!!!

reviews.title: STUPENDA!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, a true spectacle of nature, enchanting sea. Well-kept beach also with the help of Lega Ambiente volunteers; divided into 2, one part where you can access with your umbrella and one where you can only bring your towel because turtles nest there.
