You can get there by walking along a path for about 15 minutes, under the sun, especially on the way back it is a little more challenging, but it's worth it! In my opinion it's too crowded in this period, you can't fully enjoy this enchantment. I renew my congratulations to the Legambiente volunteers who do an excellent job in managing this place wonderful.

reviews.title: CELESTIALE!
reviews.text: Beach, reachable with a 20 minute descent. Clean, there are Legambiente volunteers, who check: VERY GOOD! Went twice, always come back

reviews.title: 4 stelle e non 5 solo per la confusione
reviews.text: The place doesn't need many comments: it is truly a spectacle of nature that is almost a must see if you visit Lampedusa. Unfortunately, however, it can be a truly burdensome experience: the place opens at 8.30 and at that time it is already full of people in line. At 9.30 the beach is already a carpet of tablecloths. Personally I have never seen such a crowded beach. Any movement is difficult because there are no centimeters of sand on which to walk. In August it is almost certain to have people a few centimeters apart on all sides. However, all this is forgotten due to the beauty of the place. Not recommended for those looking for something "relaxing"

reviews.title: FANTASTICA
reviews.text: I have no words to describe this famous beach: FANTASTIC Shades of enchanting blue, a spectacle of nature.

reviews.title: 非常美的海滩
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful. The natural small harbor and white fine sand are very beautiful! The sea water is a deep and shallow blue ~ but the road to this beach is not easy to walk, it is a gravel road and a stone road. The way out is downhill and the way back is uphill. Each one-way trip takes about 30 minutes. If you need to stay for a longer time, it is recommended to bring your own drinks and food.

reviews.title: Vacanza
reviews.text: An amazing island, I recommend it to couples without children. Rent dinghies to visit the coves in every corner of the island and in the evening walk on the legendary Via Roma which feels like being in the center of Rimini.

reviews.title: Incantevole
reviews.text: Beautiful but too crowded. Reachable only on foot (about 15 minutes walk). There are no services or refreshments on the beach as it is a Nature Reserve. Thanks to Legambiente H24 which protects this magnificent place

reviews.title: Ottimo
reviews.text: What can I say... splendid... fantastic beach... tranquility first... we hope to meet again.

reviews.title: Mare
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world. A fusion of colors. It is no coincidence that the famous singer-songwriter Domenico Modugno chose it as the setting for his wonderful villa!! The descent to the sea is challenging and the beach is very crowded. However, just for this reason you cannot give up a bath in this slice of Paradise.

reviews.title: Il posto più bello di Lampedusa ma...
reviews.text: They spoke to me about Lampedusa as if it were a paradise... perhaps because, for those who live in Agrigento, that's all they see of the sea... so Cala Creta and all the other coves and beaches, they didn't excite me more than the Zingaro reserve, Capo Zafferano, Ustica, Favignana and so much higher up that I'm used to seeing. Rabbit Island did it, it made me emotional, there, from above, in front of that landscape. It made me admire the immensity of its nature and its sea, feeling that all that road was worth it because this was a place I had to see. The presence of legambiente which protects the territory (despite the complaints of ignorant bathers) is important to ensure that a part of the beach remains intact and hopefully remains or rather returns, territory for the beloved turtles... who this year, alas, have chosen Linosa to lay their eggs. The only negative note for which I don't give 5 stars is precisely this.

reviews.title: Stupenda!
reviews.text: Too beautiful to seem fake. I must say that if they continue like this they will be able to keep this wonder of nature intact. I congratulate the municipality of Lampedusa for the work done.

reviews.title: Spiaggia Caraibica
reviews.text: Ferragosto definitely on a beautiful beach where even if crowded you find that unexpected tranquility. Congratulations to the volunteers of Legambiente who do an excellent job in managing the place. Lampedusa without seeing rabbit island is like going to Rome and not seeing the Colosseum, it is worth the 20 minute walk to reach it.

reviews.title: FAN TAS TI CA
reviews.text: It is a dreamlike, enchanting place. The water has a color that has nothing to envy of tropical seas... on the contrary. In August there are a lot of people and the space becomes limited... you have to be prepared. For sea lovers it is simply a must...

reviews.title: Favoloso
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful places in the world, incredible and unforgettable colors... to see at least once in your life!

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: A splendid beach that is worth the effort to reach it! Clear waters and swimming in the company of fish that repay the effort you put in to reach it!

reviews.title: 😍😍 Stupenda!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, very clean, clear and transparent water. Suitable for everyone, children, elderly, everyone really! I would recommend wearing comfortable shoes for the descent (about 10 minutes) to the beach. Rabbit Island is dangerous, in fact you must CAREFULLY read the prohibition signs for falling rocks. 🐰 First in the ranking of the most beautiful beaches in Lampedusa 😍

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: Wonderful, unforgettable beach, white sand and crystal clear sea in the true sense of the word. I consider it superior to the Pelosa beach in Stintino.

reviews.title: Spiaggia incantevole
reviews.text: The beach, which can be reached with a pleasant walk, is an unmissable stop for anyone passing through Lampedusa. It is wonderful and super natural.

reviews.title: Bellissima ma LEGAMBIENTE NO!!
reviews.text: Granted and not granted that it is one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, they could put some rubbish and some showers to rinse off, and above all plant numbered umbrellas to ensure that beyond a certain number people can no longer plant others, in short equip it better! It's a shame all these limitations set by LEGAMBIENTE such as: Don't move stones, don't smoke, don't plant umbrellas and limit navigation of the island with ropes but everyone is free to think as you see fit.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Wonderful beach located in the Lampedusa reserve, to get there you have to walk a bit, but it's worth it. One of the most beautiful beaches I've seen, worth seeing at least once.

reviews.title: LA SPIAGGIA DEI CONIGLI
reviews.text: Previously this beach was intended for turtles to lay their eggs, now it has become a beach open to the public and obviously the beloved turtles are no longer found. On the other hand, the sea is crystal clear with Caribbean colors

reviews.title: Vacanza a Lampedusa
reviews.text: Between one bag or another it is impossible not to stop in Via Roma da Martorana for a snack. Everything on display from pizza, arancini, pasta, fish and meat is excellent... there's something for everyone... courtesy, gluttony and... a lot of queues... distinguishes the place.  There are places to eat out or take away.. reasonable prices.. I highly recommend it

reviews.title: Il paradiso va guadagnato
reviews.text: A corner of paradise, but like all prizes you have to earn it! after a short stretch of rocks to which you must pay attention during the walk (closed shoes recommended) especially if you are with children, a pleasant stone pavement begins but you still have to keep your eyes open until... after about a few hundred meters the first finish line, a panoramic terrace in the middle of the tobacconist on the left and the panorama of the rabbit beach on the right where you can start looking for 1 m2 available to place the umbrella, exclusively on the right side of the beach and for the bravest only a tarpaulin on the left side, the one dedicated to the caretta caretta turtles! so once you arrive you can dive into a wonderful pool with a white seabed full of fish, to admire this spectacle of nature, a beach dedicated to everyone and especially for the little ones

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: Go up early in the morning they open at 8.30am But you already have a queue to get in... you have to walk a little on a rocky road but with slippers you can walk well... 10 minutes and then you see this panorama which takes your breath away because of how wonderful it is... The water, what can I say, is spectacular... in August however it is super crowded and there isn't even room to pass... but it's really worth going... I recommend it

reviews.title: Giornata no!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: Unfortunately I had a negative impact with this beach considered "the most beautiful in the world"!!!!!!! Descent lasting about a quarter of an hour where at a certain point a fantastic scenario opens up, and so far everything is ok!!!! We proceed with the descent and arrive at the beach which unfortunately cannot be seen because it is covered with bathers and umbrellas!!! The sea was a bit rough, so I don't recommend going when it's windy because you might not be able to understand the beauty of the water! There are many coves in Lampedusa that have nothing to send to this beach.

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella del mondo
reviews.text: The water is so crystal clear, even offshore, that it feels like swimming in a pool. It's worth the 15 minute walk to reach it from the main road. There are no services, so you have to bring both food and drink. I recommend staying all day because, depending on the sun, the color of the water changes, going from transparent to turquoise to deep blue. Half of the beach can be occupied by umbrellas while in the other half, where turtles nest, you can only spread out a beach towel.

reviews.title: spettacolo unico
reviews.text: there are no words to describe this natural spectacle. we should remember that we are only passing through and therefore respect everything that surrounds us.

reviews.title: La regina
reviews.text: Little to say: a natural paradise like this is difficult to find. Breathtaking beach and sea. The only downside, obviously, is the flood of people pouring onto the beach making it very crowded. Half of the beach has the possibility of putting up your own umbrella, the other half without. Avoid going back up in the middle of the afternoon because the sun is beating down, make sure you have a drink with you.

reviews.title: Caraibi
reviews.text: the only thing missing is the palm trees to feel overseas, enchanting beach, I recommend a boat trip to admire the show from the sea!!

reviews.title: Regina del mediterraneo
reviews.text: In my opinion it is one of the most beautiful beaches that exist in the Mediterranean. Beauty does not only consist in the color of the water. It's all the scenery that is lovely. A valley of light rock that seems to embrace that wonderful stretch of sea, it is no coincidence that caretta caretta sea turtles often nest in that place. However, there is a flaw but it doesn't depend on nature, she is always perfect. During the weeks of August the crowds are wild. People line up on the beach without any criteria and it becomes impossible to reach the sea. It is often unavoidable to step on other bathers' towels with your feet. I recommend going to the beach very early in the morning to get a spot not too far from the shore. I don't recommend leaving the beach early in the afternoon. In the month of August it is really unnerving to go up in all that heat. For the rest, you cannot fail to come to Lampedusa and not dedicate a day to this unique place

reviews.title: Paradiso infernale
reviews.text: Probably one of the most beautiful places in the world, the journey to get there is tiring and breathtaking in every sense, all ruined by the management of this beach, hundreds of people crowded together like Rimini in August, hunting for the free square meter to stick in your umbrella, human carpet, consequently you can't even enjoy the beauty of the sand and wonderful water, I find it absurd for Legambiente to preserve and monitor all this, when access to a decidedly smaller number of people.

reviews.title: Spettacolo puro
reviews.text: Arrival: €3 scooter parking 20 minutes of descent Half of the beach with umbrellas Half of the beach without umbrellas Legambiente to monitor Wonderful Only downside: the ascent at the end of the day...

reviews.title: Palato soddisfatto
reviews.text: Very good value for money, feature. I recommend aubergines parmigiana, excellent, arancini.

reviews.title: Il paradiso esiste
reviews.text: An enchanting oasis where you can spend a relaxing day. Paradise exists, the water is crystal clear and it feels like swimming in an aquarium full of fish. On a positive note, the van at the top of the nature reserve rents umbrellas for €5 plus a €10 deposit.

reviews.title: Il paradiso esiste....è qui!
reviews.text: After 10 years I returned to Lampedusa, a fixed stop on Rabbit Island. I was overwhelmed by an indescribable emotion in observing breathtaking colours, sea and sky blending into an intense and spectacular blue. The reserve can be reached on foot in about 15 minutes, the road is beaten and has rest areas with shade. Bring food because down there only sand and lots and lots of crystal clear sea await you!

reviews.title: Una spiaggia da sogno
reviews.text: We came to Lampedusa and we couldn't help but come to the first beach in Italy, second in Europe and seventh in the world for beauty.....even though it was late August, i.e. the boom week, I must say that we managed to experience it to the fullest at least in the morning since the world then arrives for obvious reasons, it opens at 8.30 so if you are an early riser like us I would say no problem, pearly white sand, water with all the colors of turquoise cannot be described in words you have to be there, huge fish that will let you they swim next to it because it is an oasis, in short a paradise that's why the turtles come there 😏

reviews.title: PARADISO
reviews.text: There must be a reason why it has been repeatedly elected the "most beautiful beach in the world". A paradise on earth!

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: The view from the top is breathtaking, the TOP in the Mediterranean. Access is a little inconvenient and the site is very basic. It's all forbidden but that's right. watch out for jellyfish!!!

reviews.title: PARADISO TERRESTRE
reviews.text: When God created the sea he certainly thought of the island of rabbits. A splendor.... I'll post some photos for the rest, come and see this sea!!!

reviews.title: Almeno una volta nella vita!
reviews.text: It's useless to stay here and say how beautiful this place is, I think the title and the photos that I'm going to attach are enough to understand it. In this review, however, I want to give you some useful advice to be able to make the most of this paradise: 1) the descent to the beach opens at 8.30 but I advise you to go to the gates at least at 8, so that you can have a nice place on the beach. 2) park near the entrance using the appropriate tickets, write down the license plate of your vehicle so when you fill out the scratch card you won't have to make another trip. The cost varies according to the parking time and the vehicle, I had a scooter and for the whole day I paid €3.503) go to the beach with sneakers, the beach is beautiful, but the route to reach it is much less beautiful! In fact, it is a particularly steep route and not always with uniform paving which on average takes 20 minutes to cover.4) bring lunch and a drink or at least buy them at the kiosk at the entrance, that is the only refreshment point in the whole area, so if you were to go down without anything to eat or drink you would be forced to climb back up to the top.5) it is possible to rent an umbrella for the whole day, at the kiosk that is there at the entrance at a cost of €5 + €10 deposit which will be returned to you upon delivery. I think I've said everything, now you can enjoy this corner of paradise!

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: Beautiful even if super crowded.  The descent is not difficult at all.  I had read reviews that spoke of difficulty. That's not true at all. Cala chick, that's difficult.

reviews.title: Sempre bella!!!
reviews.text: From the main road, the beach can be reached in 10 minutes on foot! The sea is truly the TOP of Lampedusa!!

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: Place not to be missed...If you don't go to the rabbit beach.. You haven't gone to Lampedusa..The route is the price you pay for the location... Magical!

reviews.title: Affollatissima!!
reviews.text: The place itself is very beautiful! But: the beach is large and divided in two, on one side you can put an umbrella and on the other half you can't. So you have to: get up at dawn and run to get down to the beach early to grab a square meter of space, which will be invaded very shortly after by a wave of people who continue to arrive at all hours, until there isn't even space left to go from your towel to the beach! For the rest, the beach is very clean, thanks to Legambiente which continuously walks around the beach. Nice place, but I preferred others to this one honestly.

reviews.title: Lampedusa beaches
reviews.text: Amazing place. We walked about 20 minutes to get the beach. The walter is turquoise and warm. You can swimming all day. You can not get any bother to be in the beach. Only relax. There is a caffè where you can buy food and drink to take away or eating inside the restaurant. The price is quite expensive but the food is good. The best beach in lampedusa.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I have been lucky enough to see. Spectacular on a scenic level because after having followed the path of about 10 minutes that crosses the reserve you arrive on a promontory from which the view is marvelous and offers the entire vision of this little corner of paradise. Then going down to the beach, swimming in these crystal clear waters makes it seem like you are in the Caribbean. To admire the beach in all its beauty I recommend arriving when the reserve opens at half past 8.

reviews.title: Bellissima!!
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach, one of the most popular on the island of Lampedusa. To get there you have to follow a path that is not too complicated. Trekking shoes and off you go. As soon as you arrive enjoy the sea, fish everywhere, crystal clear and clean water. Absolutely worth seeing. Go there early in the morning because otherwise you will find a lot of confusion!

reviews.title: Che vista ma solo quella
reviews.text: Nothing to say about the view you get when approaching the Isolotto. A magic. But then the harsh reality. Bans, bans and more bans. Of course we need to protect the place but at the same time it would be nice to be able to discover more. Morality relegated to the beach, watched closely by Legambiente volunteers (thank you but a smile wouldn't hurt) and without the possibility of taking a swim when approaching the islet.  I forgot: everything takes place near the most beautiful house in Lampedusa: a fantastic building abuse that has certainly been condoned and is in the process of being renovated because they tell me it will become an accommodation facility.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: Beautiful beach and gorgeous sea. I was in the area where you couldn't put umbrellas so it was quieter. The sea looks like a swimming pool, fabulous, we returned more than once despite the walk because it's worth it.

reviews.title: Il top
reviews.text: I have been to the island of Lampedusa several times and every time I have been there I have always gone to the fantastic earthly paradise of the rabbit island

reviews.title: La spiaggia perfetta
reviews.text: Finally an oasis of beauty protected and perfectly preserved (by Legambiente). Finally a beach with an absolute ban on smoking (not even the shadow of a cigarette butt stuck in the sand as per rude Italian custom). Going down and back up can also be tiring (especially with 40 degrees), but it's really worth it.

reviews.title: Senza parole
reviews.text: This little jewel of the world that fortunately we can boast of preserving in Italy leaves you speechless. You arrive from the main road towards Ponente and you can park your car (€7.5 per day) or your scooter (€3.5 per day). The descent leading to the beach opens at 8.30am. The descent is a bit steep and made of pebbles but can also be done in slippers. It seems like a guided tour as at every corner you discover the beach little by little. From above the view is breathtaking. Untouched and virgin, it is defended and protected by Legaambiente which monitors the beach to ensure it is respected. Very thin, white sand, transparent sea, it feels like being in the Caribbean. It is possible to rent an umbrella at the start of the descent for €5. Sunbeds cannot be placed. The advice is to visit it and stay for half a day. There is no shade and 8-9 hours can be challenging in the sun.

reviews.title: top
reviews.text: wonderful place, I will definitely go back, it's worth it, uncontaminated place and very beautiful view from above

reviews.title: Vacanza
reviews.text: Beautiful place but poorly equipped, a 15 minute descent and a 20 minute ascent being a reserve. The place is beautiful, I recommend it but you have to arrive at 8.15 in the morning to get the first row.

reviews.title: Una Meraviglia, lascia senza fiato
reviews.text: What can I say, one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. There is no need to say anything else, just look at the photos I attach. An enchantment.

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: If you have children it's a bit hard to do, especially the return trip... but it's worth it. Recommended 1/2 day

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful places in the world. A view you will never forget. I would only recommend it to families with small children due to the stretch of walk not accessible with a stroller.

reviews.title: ASSOLUTAMENTE splendida
reviews.text: For years I have been reading and hearing about this place as unique! I confirm!! Despite the crowding of the beach (I recommend arriving at opening time at 8.30), the sea is incredibly clean and transparent. We swam around the island and the seabed is always visible and full of fish!! NOT TO BE MISSED

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: Spectacular.... The only negative note is this villa in the middle of nowhere... Good route to get there... bring water...

reviews.title: Da togliere il fiato
reviews.text: Indescribable beauty in words and photos, it must be experienced and that's it!!! We really appreciated the presence of the Lega Ambiente volunteers who politely enforce the rules that allow us to preserve such a unique and magical place

reviews.title: Incanto
reviews.text: Enchanting beach and sea. It is recommended to get there in the mid-afternoon to avoid the crowds of people.

reviews.title: Fantastica
reviews.text: Amazing beach. Really exciting to see it as soon as you arrive from above. The climb up is a bit tiring but it's absolutely worth it. I recommend being there before opening. Well done to the boys and girls of Legambiente who go around to enforce the rightly imposed rules.

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: You can summarize everything with the title of my review. I was moved when this uncontaminated wonder appeared to me from the panorama. It's nice to think of having bathed in one of the most wonderful beaches in the world. I agree with the fact that the beach has a timetable (open from 9.30am and closed at 7.30pm) and that you cannot smoke on the sandy strip but only on the walkway. The guys from Legambiente keep it very clean and when the mistral blows, nothing but the Caribbean!

reviews.title: Che meraviglia
reviews.text: My wife and I visited this beach. I recommend arriving early in the morning to find a place to put an umbrella. The place is really very beautiful, characteristic, a natural swimming pool 🏊‍♂️ Must do!

reviews.title: Una certezza
reviews.text: If you go to Lampedusa you cannot miss visiting this fantastic beach with crystal clear water where you can swim with some fantastic fish. You can get there via a route that takes approximately 20 minutes. I recommend bringing everything you need (food and drinks) down as the beach, rightly, is not equipped and for any need you will have to go back up the 20 minute route. The beach is divided into two parts, in one you will have the opportunity to put up an umbrella, in the other to lie down with your beach towel. The only negative point is the presence (but rather absence) of the guys from the environmental league who should be there to supervise the correct attitude of the swimmers but who do everything except this.

reviews.title: Tanta Roba !!!
reviews.text: It is a marvel, breathtaking colors and water "to drink". The beach is divided into 2 parts: area with umbrellas and beach towels only area. Thinking of going to Conigli beach and spending the whole day is impossible in August; the umbrella area is unlivable, you get trampled even if you get to the opening first and you don't manage to have your minimal survival space. The first time I went with the idea of ​​an umbrella and the relaxation was less; strengthened by the first experience, when I returned, I went for a few hours, I brought the beach towel and I took my beach handkerchief from the "towels only" side; in this way I "enjoyed" the wonders offered by the sea and had moments of excellent relaxation when I lay down on the towel (without being trampled on), until, cooked by the sun, I decided to abandon it. The 15' walk down to the beach is pleasant and has an excellent view.

reviews.title: Spiaggia molto bella
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach but the really beautiful thing is that it is well looked after by the volunteers. Be well equipped to spend and recover. Under the Sicilian sun and very tiring 😉

reviews.title: Bellissima ma super affollata
reviews.text: Unique beach, but perhaps it would be worth seeing it in another period. Too crowded, not even a space to put your towel Bring a drink because the refreshment point is a 15 minute walk from the beach

reviews.title: Una Meraviglia
reviews.text: Located almost at the furthest point from the town, this beach can be reached after about 20 minutes along a path that is sometimes rocky but never too steep. The beach is protected by Legambiente and therefore it is possible to start going down only after 8.30 am. Half the beach offers the possibility of placing umbrellas (also rented at the beginning of the descent) while the other half does not. Clearly the half without umbrellas will always be less crowded. The beach is simply magnificent and the water is among the most beautiful ever seen. Depending on the wind there may be more or less jellyfish. NB: the only beach for which you pay for parking: 3.5 for the whole day on a scooter or 0.7 per hour.

reviews.title: MERAVIGLIOSA
reviews.text: A beach from a thousand and one nights, we went last week and in 7 days we went there 4 times, a beautiful beach, very well kept and clean, the volunteers are very nice and helpful. It takes about 20 minutes on foot to reach it, and believe me you won't regret it.

reviews.title: La più bella!
reviews.text: Nice walk in the sun, especially to get back up! Umbrella for €5 with €10 deposit. White beach. Gorgeous sea. Nice view for taking photos. Flaw: TOO MANY PEOPLE. Everyone attacked. The beach opens at 8.30 and at 8.10 there was already a queue. But you can't not go!

reviews.title: Spiaggia più bella d'Italia
reviews.text: You have to come to Lampedusa and Sicily at least once in your life! Beautiful beach, wonderful water

reviews.title: Bella esperienza!
reviews.text: Small beach, difficult to reach for a distance of at least 20/30 minutes with a winding path without cover or shadows! Once on the beach you feel bad because there is no service so either you come equipped with an umbrella and water or you will be left dry! In my experience I was a little upset because the sea was full of algae! ;-)

reviews.title: Come nuotare in piscina!
reviews.text: Definitely the main memory of Lampedusa. You have to get up early, be among the first at the entrance (I recommend renting an umbrella costing €5 as it is larger and more protective than the usual ones that are provided by the apartments) and at 8.30 am off at a brisk pace down the path, accessible to everyone, to be among the first to position yourself in the front row and be able to enjoy the beauty of this beach. If you arrive after the rearmost position, it will imply a fight for living space. Remember water and food. I recommend doing it all day to avoid climbing back up during the hot hours!

reviews.title: SPETTACOLO
reviews.text: The effort is worth it! One part of the beach is shaded and the other is not. Being a nature reserve there are no services of any kind. Not recommended for families with small children.

reviews.title: Bellissima
reviews.text: Beautiful, very crowded but crazy panoramic. Beautiful sea, small space even though it is a lot. 15 minute walk to reach it but it's worth everything, definitely worthy and exceptional. There is no comparison with Cala Pulcello.

reviews.title: Altro che i Caraibi!!
reviews.text: There isn't much else new to say about this magnificent beach. Having seen it empty upon our arrival, given the period of early June, allowed us even more to savor every little facet of it. Greeted by the singing of seagulls and the heavenly colours. Following the path on the ridge, you can see it from above to take your breath away. Continuing on that path it is also possible to see Cala Pulcino from above. The climb is nothing impossible. Done with my daughter in my arms without too many problems. We took the shuttle near the port bar, both there and back, and we arrived comfortably in 15 minutes maximum.

reviews.title: Uno spettacolo
reviews.text: The sea is crystal clear, super clean water. This is said by someone who lives in Agrigento and our sea is clean.

reviews.title: Silvia e Laura
reviews.text: A marvel.... Not in August! Sea of ​​all shades of blue... First seen from the boat with a tour of the island then by land.

reviews.title: Caraibi in Italia
reviews.text: The title is more than explanatory....a magnificent place....the most beautiful beach I have seen....wonderful, even if the climb is a bit tiring, it is better to go there with sneakers, so you will have less effort.

reviews.title: Il paradiso
reviews.text: Waking up early in the morning we went to this corner of paradise. There was already a queue at 8am to access the long path that leads to the beach.  Well positioned at the top of the slope is a refreshment point.... blue wave where it is possible to rent umbrellas at really super prices. The area is well equipped with the possibility of paying for parking for cars and scooters at reasonable prices.  The only flaw is 6 pieces of white pizza for 15 euros.... it seems a bit exaggerated to me. The advice is to bring something from home for lunch. What can I say about the beach... a paradise with crystal clear water, a magnificent place.  Suitable shoes required for descending the path.

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: Uncontaminated paradise where fish swim a few meters from the shore next to you. There's a nice walk to tackle before arriving, the uphill return is worse, but it's worth it

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: calling it a beach is an understatement, the photos don't convey the spectacle of this place. To visit at least once in your life.

reviews.title: Una spiaggia da sogno!!
reviews.text: A true paradise!!! Crystal clear water and very clear sand!!! The road to get there, impervious but not too much, thanks to recent changes make it even more fascinating!! Everything is kept under control by Legambiente volunteers, who do an excellent job of supervision! Impossible not to go more than once if you are in Lampedusa!!

reviews.title: Incantevole
reviews.text: The beach is wonderful, it's a shame it's a long walk but it's absolutely worth it. I advise you to go down with closed sneakers during the cooler hours, especially for the climb. Bring water and food with you as there are no bars or anything else down on the beach. For the rest simply fantastic! Going to Lampedusa and not going there is crazy. Not recommended for very young and elderly children

reviews.title: Gioiellino
reviews.text: A truly unique gem, you just have to happen on the day for the wind which can bring some algae to the shore

reviews.title: Spiaggia
reviews.text: It's beautiful and not tiring to get there, it's worth bringing an umbrella or renting one before going down as it's very hot.

reviews.title: Spiaggia da incanto
reviews.text: Simply fantastic, it really feels like being on another planet, pure nature, crystal clear, transparent water and a fabulous beach. You absolutely must come

reviews.title: Vacanza
reviews.text: Error 504 (Server Error)!!1504.That’s an error.There was an error. Please try again later.That’s all we know.

reviews.title: Megéri a sétát
reviews.text: Crystal clear water, beautiful view, sandy beach, rocks. Marine life that can be observed with the naked eye. Tranquility, infinity and a sense of possibility. You have to walk a lot to the Pati beach, but it's worth it.

reviews.title: Un dovere da preservare
reviews.text: We went to this wonderful beach, with a beautiful sea that no adjectives and no photos are able to describe. We all have a duty: to defend it! Thanks to the guys from Lega Ambiente

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei Conigli Lampedusa
reviews.text: Unmissable for those who go to Lampedusa, certainly one of the most beautiful beaches in the world, with the constant presence of Legambiente staff for the protection of the nature reserve. For access, both downhill and uphill, be prepared to walk (no flip-flops!!!)

reviews.title: Spiaggia dei Conigli nel tardo pomeriggio
reviews.text: We followed the suggestion of going there at around 4pm and it was excellent. (you can stay until 7.30pm) The morning is too busy and staying all day under the sun carrying an umbrella by hand was out of the question. 15 minutes of quiet walk and then there, in front of you, before turning right and going down to the beach, stop.....and admire the Isolotto dei Conigli and the spectacle from above and in front of you. breathtaking waters with multiple colors .... even more than the beach I was moved by this view from above .... how much beauty !!..... words are not enough and the sensations are always personal. For me one of the most touching moments experienced on this splendid island was the splendid Catamaran tour of the island with Salvatore (ask at the La Cambusa restaurant in the central area - very close to the famous Via Roma - excellent restaurant among other things)

reviews.title: Davvero un paradiso
reviews.text: Truly a paradise, a place that we are certainly envied throughout Europe and some even in the world. A breathtaking view, a wonderful sea and a very clean beach perhaps because it is managed by Legambiente which dictates quite strict rules but which maintains the ecosystem and the landscape is truly stupendous. Definitely worth seeing at least once in your life.

reviews.title: Tra le migliori al mondo
reviews.text: I won't stop to reiterate once again the beauty/perfection of the water in this piece of sea. I'm just saying that I have seen many beaches (from the Red Sea, to Zanzibar, from the Caribbean to Sardinia) and this is certainly one of the top 3. I will limit myself to providing some suggestions for those venturing into this very crowded corner of paradise for the first time (suggestions received in turn from those who have lived on this island for many years). First point: go there early, as soon as it opens (8.30 am) and go home or change the beach around midday when people will start planting umbrellas on you too just to find a place. As soon as you arrive you will have to park the vehicle (3.5 euros for the whole day), and rent an umbrella which you will have to carry down the slope with your arms (cost of umbrella 5 euros plus 10 deposit only which will be returned to you). The time to travel downhill to the beach is about 15 minutes, which will become 20 on the way back uphill. Bring your shoes. Then what can we say: enjoy one of the most beautiful beaches in the world. Congratulations to the Lega Ambiente staff who are responsible for preserving this little corner of paradise.

reviews.title: Meraviglia
reviews.text: This beach is an authentic wonder of nature and like all wonders it attracts crowds of visitors and not everyone knows what they are faced with. It is a nature reserve, which entails numerous and very reasonable limits to the use of the environment. Those looking for comfort, services, equipment and accessibility are on the wrong beach. It is objectively very crowded, but it is not clear why people complain about it: it is beautiful and attracts tourists. If someone hates crowds, change the beach. Nature is protected: Legambiente is there with its volunteers to monitor. For those who come to Lampedusa it is an obligatory stop as long as you approach it intelligently: there is no point in complaining about the difficulties in reaching it and above all about the pit if you are nothing more than part of the crowd itself.

reviews.title: spiaggia da sogno
reviews.text: the most beautiful beach in Lampedusa. Well served by bus service. The guys from Lega Ambiente are very kind. The staff at the refreshment point are very kind.

reviews.title: Come ai Caraibi ma in Italia
reviews.text: What about crystal clear waters, giant fish and lots of them, the point between land and island is called God's Pool for a reason... this wonder cannot be explained in words! Go there!

reviews.title: Stupenda
reviews.text: The rabbit beach was the place that made me re-evaluate the island. Almost uncontaminated and controlled by Legambiente volunteers, it is accessible from the morning until 7.30 pm, after a passage that is not too steep, but totally uncovered, lasting about twenty minutes. The view from above is spectacular, once you arrive at the beach the crystal clear water, the possibility of swimming with the fish make it a true paradise! The beach is quite spacious (compared to the other coves) and divided into two parts, one in which it is possible to plant the umbrella and the other only for the towels. To be seen, but not in August.

reviews.title: LA PISCINA DI DIO
reviews.text: This is how Modugno has named these waters in front of the Conigli beach. Made even more famous by the rankings which often place it at the top of the most beautiful beaches in the world. It can be reached after a 15-minute tortuous descent on foot from the asphalt road with free and paid parking. As you descend the ridge, the view becomes more and more postcard-like. As soon as you pass the only house present (the former home of Domenico Modugno), you arrive in the very white beach, divided into two areas. The first where you can plant your own umbrella, while in the second only towels. All this, as well as the imposed entry and exit time (08.30-19.30) aimed at protecting the turtles that have chosen this place to nest. I won't dwell on the description of the waters, on the variety of fish or simply on the thousand colors that you can admire, because it has already been done exhaustively in previous reviews. I'm just telling you that on the right days you will see such a beautiful sea that it appears unreal. Always pay attention to the wind forecasts, given that depending on where they blow from, the quality of the water is greatly affected. Applause to the volunteers of the environmental league who discreetly monitor to ensure that the place is preserved as much as possible.

reviews.title: luogo meraviglioso
reviews.text: Fantastic beach. It would be even better protected. It is unpopular but such a wonder must be protected from people's carelessness

reviews.title: Top
reviews.text: Fantastic beach and sea beautiful place is worth visiting. Really wonderful, I hope to be able to return

reviews.title: La spiaggia più bella d'Italia
reviews.text: An all-Italian wonder. It is accessed via a rocky path after a 20 minute walk, but it is worth it. The sand is white and you are surrounded by nature all around. The colors are fantastic, ranging from turquoise to emerald green. Opposite is the Rabbit Island, not accessible on foot, but beautiful to see both from afar and from inside the sea, swimming from the rabbit beach. What a show!

reviews.title: Plus ultra
reviews.text: There is no more poignant place from a naturalistic point of view, happy and satisfied to have also visited this Lampedusian wonder. A joy for anyone to be there.

reviews.title: La spiaggia dei sogni
reviews.text: Beautiful beach that can be reached after a walk of about 15 minutes (also considering the time for the obligatory photos!). In one part of the beach it is not possible to plant umbrellas, so I recommend arriving either early in the morning when they open or in the afternoon. Beautiful.

reviews.title: Meravigliosa
reviews.text: Spectacular beach. It is a nature reserve controlled by legambiente volunteers. You only pay a few euros for parking while entry is free. There is about a 15 minute walk from the car park to the beach. One part of the beach is used for umbrellas while another part without, only towels. It is the most beautiful on the whole island. I recommend going in the morning at 8.30 as soon as it opens, because then it gets really crowded. Thanks to the legambiente volunteers who take care of it.

reviews.title: Great beach on Lampedusa
reviews.text: Opens 8:30am to 7:30pm everyday. Enjoy this beautiful beach on the days when the Mistral “maestrale” wind is blowing. All the beaches on the southern side of the island are best visited on these days. On the “scirocco” wind days (wind blowing northerly from the African continent), the beaches on the northern shores have the calmer, cleaner waters.

reviews.title: Vale da sola il viaggio
reviews.text: Go early, it opens at 8.30 so be there it will be worth it. We went swimming among the fish which, when it gets crowded, go away. Paid parking, umbrellas to rent for 5 euros and a 10 euro deposit which will be refunded on your return (without an umbrella you will ruin the rest of the holiday if you are not already tanned black). Take good supplies of fresh water as the road back up is long and hot and is not recommended.For the rest, the most beautiful beach in the world.

reviews.title: Occhio all'orario della risalita
reviews.text: If they hadn't warned me I would have made the mistake of arriving at 9...and then?? Luckily I didn't make this mistake; I don't think I would have made it back up at 1 or 2 pm without having an umbrella, without feeling sick from the heat. I arrived after lunch and went back up at 6.30pm. The landscape is breathtaking, many shades of blue. The day before it was a sirocco wind and the day I went mistral. The sirocco dirty the water of the beaches facing south and arriving with many expectations and finding water that is not exactly clean is not the best. Having said that, that day the water wasn't great because it was immediately after 2 days of sirocco, but returning after so many years and finding a wild beach without kiosks and protected can only be a pleasure. Last tip, bring water so you don't die of thirst... it takes 15-20 minutes to go up and bring comfortable slippers so you don't slip.

reviews.title: Vacanza in famiglia
reviews.text: Beach in a truly wonderful setting... with sea of ​​various shades of turquoise to blue... the most beautiful is Lampedusa...

reviews.title: Niesamowity kolor wody
reviews.text: The water is stunning with its beautiful azure color. Fish swim very close to people, they are not afraid. As you swim further with a mask and a snorkel, you can admire wonderful views underwater. Definitely worth seeing.

reviews.title: bellissima
reviews.text: Crystal clear water, watch out for some jellyfish, bring some water because there are no drink shops on the beach and the return journey is uphill without shade

reviews.title: Magnifica!!!
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach on the island but I think also in Italy! To get there, be prepared for a 15 minute descent, and of course also for a challenging climb... But it's worth it!!! Protected beach with the presence of Lega Ambiente volunteers. A tip: rent an umbrella before going down because once you get down you won't find any service.

reviews.title: Troooopppaaa confusione
reviews.text: Disaster... the beach is wonderful, even if it takes about twenty minutes to get there on foot with a fair slope on a bumpy path. Then you arrive and it seems like you can see the whole world there.... with umbrellas, chairs, deckchairs etc..., the other half all towels scattered everywhere, where you will definitely be crushed. The wonderful and warm water is another overcrowded place, but at least you can go further out to sea. Fabulous special location, but too crowded

reviews.title: Tappa obbligatoria
reviews.text: Absolutely worth seeing! The amount of fish I saw here I have never seen in my life. It's true that it is very crowded but if you get there at 8.30 (as soon as they open) you will be able to sit wherever you want and enjoy it a little more. The walking route is not as difficult as I have read in other reviews... honestly I have seen worse! The return is certainly a little more tiring as it is uphill but we are talking about a 15 maximum 20 minute walk.

reviews.title: Bella e faticosa
reviews.text: Beautiful Caribbean beach, a little challenging for those with children, but the path is well done because there are wooden gazebos where you can stop. Downstairs there is a space reserved for umbrellas and a space where only beach towels can be placed. Definitely a must-see destination for anyone coming to Lampedusa.

reviews.title: Da vedere assolutamente
reviews.text: Highly recommended to see at least once in your life but I wouldn't go back. Too crowded with people makes you lose the magic of this place. Remember 20 minutes walk in the sun and you have to rent an umbrella at the kiosk (5 euros plus 10 deposit).

reviews.title: Vacanze
reviews.text: Excellent view and beach, clear water with fish surrounding you. The route to get there is a bit long but it's worth it.

reviews.title: Mare da favola
reviews.text: I agree that it's a park, but I was amazed by the variety of fish that swim around you, even in shallow water.

reviews.title: "La piscina di Dio"
reviews.text: ...the title says it all! Enchanted place! Go there if the mistral wind is blowing and not the sirocco. 20 minute trail (uphill on the way back but there are small shelters for parking). Bring fresh water, a mask and sun cream!

reviews.title: Paradiso
reviews.text: a paradise. we will return as soon as possible. a splendid sea. wonderful sand. unfortunately the fight against plastic must improve, and the awareness of beachgoers themselves must grow, even if Legambiente volunteers do a lot of work every day.

reviews.title: Bellissima e selvaggia
reviews.text: The walk of over 20 minutes to reach the beach is well worth it. The view is truly enchanting

reviews.title: Spettacolare
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world ❤️ breathtaking sea... a real spectacle. 20 minute walk to reach the place but totally worth it

reviews.title: Fantastica
reviews.text: A must if you come to Lampedusa. You will be amazed by the clarity of the sea and the cleanliness taken care of by the WWF volunteers. The beach is divided into two sectors: with umbrellas and without. I recommend sports shoes to reach it.

reviews.title: La spiaggia piu bella
reviews.text: To get to Rabbit Island you have to take a walk in the nature reserve. The show is magnificent! The beach surrounded by rocks and crystal clear water feels like being in the Caribbean! Beautiful

reviews.title: discesa al Paradiso
reviews.text: One of the 10 most beautiful beaches in the world, and for good reason. Very fine sand, crystal clear sea, big fish swimming around it. The descent from the road (and especially the ascent) is a bit arduous but it is absolutely worth it

reviews.title: bellissima
reviews.text: beautiful, fascinating, one of a kind, it deserves all the recognition it has received and all the awards. To be reviewed

reviews.title: Stupenda, piena di colori di odori, andate presto apre alle 8.30 e piantate il vostro ombrellone davanti nei primi posti
reviews.text: Absolutely one of the most beautiful things ever seen in the world, the reserve should however have a limited number of people every day because there is a risk of destroying the beauty of the landscape from the invasion of people who visit it every day, especially from July to August. The water, its colour, its smell and its clarity remain intact all day as if it were a postcard. Full of fish that come up to a few meters from the beach and touch your legs. Access by boats and dinghies is prohibited, so the landscape is truly evocative and breathtaking

reviews.title: Un paradiso in terra
reviews.text: Splendid beach, splendid sea, very crowded, better to visit early in the morning or late in the evening. Absolutely worth seeing because it has nothing to envy of a Caribbean beach. ...On the contrary!!!,

reviews.title: Niente di più bello...
reviews.text: There are no words to describe the beauty and uniqueness of this place... very white beach, crystal clear sea with lots of fish of all sizes... I fell in love with this place... I have never seen such a beautiful beach... half an hour's walk but it's really worth it... the beach is crowded but you can't give up its beauty and during a week's stay you can't help but want to go back over and over again (just like my boyfriend and I did). I still recommend the part without umbrellas much quieter and more livable. ..there are no services or bars but only the desire that you will immediately have to immerse yourself in those crystal clear waters!
